paper.title: Reduced Matrix Multiplication: Input-Adaptive Matrix-Product Reduction for LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Transformer-based language models achieve strong performance but incur substantial inference cost due to repeated high-dimensional matrix multiplications. We propose Reduced Matrix Multiplication (RMM), a training-free, input-adaptive inference method that reduces Transformer matrix products by selecting informative slices along their contraction dimensions, without modifying model weights. Under a simple retention-ratio control, RMM provides a smooth and predictable accuracy-efficiency trade-of

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作问的是一个更细粒度的推理冗余问题：Transformer 推理里，矩阵乘法共享收缩维上的所有分量是否都必须为每个输入完整计算。现有高效推理方法多从结构剪枝、低秩、token 压缩、KV 管理或激活稀疏化入手，但较少直接在每次矩阵乘法的 contraction dimension 上做输入自适应裁剪。作者试图给出一个训练后、无需改权重的统一近似框架，用来回答不同模型、模块和任务到底能容忍多少这类乘法约减。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值更多在分析和启发，而不是立即可用的通用加速方案。它把 attention 和 MLP 中看似不同的计算统一写成 AB 形式，然后研究 shared dimension 的可约减性，得到两个对模型设计有用的观察：一是 attention 侧通常比 MLP 更能承受约减，二是大模型往往比小模型更能容忍中等强度的 reduction。这些结果有助于理解推理时哪些内部计算更冗余，也提示未来若要把这种思想做成训练感知的架构或稀疏化方法，重点应放在 attention 子模块而不是盲目全局裁剪。
summary.technical_approach: RMM 的核心很直接。对任意矩阵乘 Y=AB，沿共享维 d 选择一个子集 I，只计算 A 的对应列与 B 的对应行，从而把完整乘法替换成 reduced product。与经典 approximate matrix multiplication 不同，作者不做随机采样，因为单次推理无法靠多次采样平均误差；而是采用确定性的、输入自适应的 Top-K 选择。具体地，用当前输入激活矩阵 A 在每个共享维度 j 上的列范数 ||A_:,j||_2 作为重要性分数，保留分数最高的 rho*d 个维度。这样做的直觉是：若某个维度在当前输入上的激活能量很低，它对输出贡献通常也较小，可以暂时跳过。这个框架可套到多种 Transformer 乘法上，包括线性投影、MLP、大致也包括 attention score 的 head feature 维和 attention-value 乘法中的 token 维。论文强调它不改模型参数、不需要再训练，只通过 retention ratio rho 控制精度-效率折中。工程上作者还实现了 Triton kernel，验证 reduced product 不只是理论 FLOPs 下降，而能转成一定 wall-clock 收益。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 1B 到 70B 的语言模型，以及部分多模态 VLM 推理场景。全文给出的主要结论不是某个单点数字，而是几条稳定趋势。第一，模型家族、任务类型、被约减的模块和 retention ratio 都会显著影响容忍度，没有单一全局最优配置。第二，在中等 reduction 下，大模型通常比小模型更稳，说明规模提升带来一定冗余缓冲。第三，attention 相关乘法明显比 MLP 更可约减，MLP 对精度更敏感，这一点在不同任务上都较一致。第四，方法在判别式、生成式和多模态设置下都能工作，但收益和退化曲线差异较大，因此更像一个分析工具和可控近似算子，而不是即插即用的统一加速器。作者还通过 Triton 实现展示 reduced matrix product 可以带来实际时延下降，不过真实收益会受 Top-K 选择开销、kernel 融合程度和具体硬件影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议按三步。先看方法部分最前面的统一表述，理解作者为什么把不同模块都写成 AB，并且为什么不用随机近似而改用确定性 Top-K。再看实验总表和分模块分析，重点抓 attention 与 MLP 的差异，以及不同模型规模下 retention ratio 的容忍区间。最后看 Triton 实现和 wall-clock 结果，判断理论 reduction 与实际加速之间的差距。若只想获取研究启发，20–30 分钟足够；若想评估能否用于生产推理，需要额外关注 Top-K 本身的代价、prefill 与 decode 是否分开处理、以及不同矩阵形状下 kernel 是否仍高效。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether every index along the contraction dimension of Transformer matrix products must be evaluated at inference time for every input. Prior efficiency work usually targets pruning, low-rank structure, token compression, KV-cache management, or activation sparsity. RMM instead studies input-adaptive reduction directly inside each matrix multiplication, without changing model weights.
summary_en.importance: Its value is more diagnostic than definitive. The paper provides a unified lens for measuring reducibility across attention and MLP computations, and the main takeaway is structurally useful: attention-side products are often much more reducible than MLP products, and larger models tend to tolerate moderate reduction better than smaller ones. For foundation-model researchers, that suggests where inference redundancy may actually live and where training-aware sparsification or architecture changes might be most promising.
summary_en.technical_approach: RMM rewrites Transformer computations in the generic form Y = AB and reduces the shared dimension d by selecting a subset of indices rather than evaluating the full product. The selection is deterministic and input-adaptive. For each shared-dimension index j, the method computes an importance score from the current activation matrix, specifically the column norm ||A_:,j||_2, and keeps the top rho fraction of indices. The reduced product is then formed using only the selected columns of A and rows of B. This differs from classical approximate matrix multiplication, which relies on randomized sampling and expectation over repeated draws; that is a poor fit for single-pass inference. The method is training-free, weight-preserving, and controlled by a simple retention ratio. The same idea is applied to multiple Transformer products, including attention-side and MLP-side multiplications. The authors also implement Triton kernels to test whether FLOP reduction can translate into wall-clock gains.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans language models from 1B to 70B parameters and also includes multimodal VLM inference. The main findings are trend-level rather than centered on one headline number. Reduction tolerance depends strongly on model family, task, component, and retention ratio. Larger models are often more robust under moderate reduction. Attention-related products are consistently more reducible, while MLP computations are much more sensitive. The method works across discriminative, autoregressive, and multimodal settings, but the quality-efficiency curve varies substantially, so RMM looks more like a controllable approximation tool than a universal acceleration recipe. The Triton implementation shows that reduced products can yield practical speedups, though realized gains depend on selection overhead, kernel quality, and hardware specifics.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, first inspect the method section where all Transformer computations are cast into the same AB template. That is the conceptual core. Then go to the component-wise experiments and compare attention versus MLP sensitivity under different retention ratios. Finally, check the Triton and wall-clock sections to see how much of the theoretical reduction survives in practice. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to extract the main message. If you are evaluating deployment relevance, pay special attention to the cost of Top-K selection, whether prefill and decode behave differently, and how robust the kernels are across matrix shapes.

recommendation.zh: 免训练的矩阵约减思路干净，重点看§4结构不对称性消融和不同层保留率的敏感性曲线，可作为推理侧稀疏化的baseline参考。
recommendation.en: Clean training-free matrix reduction idea; focus on §4 structural asymmetry ablations and layer-wise retention sensitivity as a baseline for inference-side sparsification.

paper.title: Ripple-Pivot Search: Active Parallel Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a competitive alternative to autoregressive language models, offering the potential for substantially faster inference through parallel decoding. Existing parallel decoding schedulers typically commit positions only after they meet a per-position criterion, overlooking how early commitments may benefit subsequent decoding. We identify a ripple effect in dLLM decoding: proactively committing a mid-entropy pivot position can induce a pronounc

summary.core_problem: 提升 diffusion LLM 的并行解码效率，避免现有调度器只按单位置置信度保守提交 token。
summary.importance: 这是 diffusion LM 推理机制与高效解码工作。它提出的关键观察是 ripple effect：主动提交一个中等熵位置，可能降低其他 masked positions 的不确定性，从而让后续步骤一次解码更多 token。对关注非 AR 语言建模的人来说，这直接关系到 diffusion LM 相对 AR 的速度优势能否兑现。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Ripple-Pivot Search，一个 training-free decoding 方法。方法不只选择最低熵位置，而是寻找中等熵 pivot，并通过 lookahead evaluation 评估不同 token assignment 对后续整体不确定性的影响。它把“当前位置是否足够确定”改成“当前位置提交后是否能让剩余位置更容易解码”。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、数据集、baseline 名称或速度提升数字。实验应围绕 diffusion LLM 的并行解码调度，与现有按位置置信度提交的 parallel decoding scheduler 对比，评估总解码步数、并行 unmask 数量和生成质量保持情况。
summary.authors_note: Hong Kong Baptist University、A*STAR CFAR、Nanyang Technological University。作者列表包含 Bo Han、Ivor Tsang、Yanfeng Wang、Bo Zheng 等机器学习研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to accelerate diffusion LLM decoding by avoiding conservative per-position commitment rules in existing parallel schedulers.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficient decoding and diffusion-LM inference paper. Its key observation is a ripple effect: proactively committing a mid-entropy position can reduce uncertainty over the remaining masked positions, enabling more tokens to be unmasked in later steps. For researchers following non-autoregressive language modeling, this matters because inference speed is a central part of the diffusion-LM value proposition.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Ripple-Pivot Search, a training-free decoding method. Instead of only committing low-entropy positions, it searches for mid-entropy pivots and uses lookahead evaluation to choose token assignments that create the largest downstream uncertainty reduction. The decision rule shifts from local confidence to global decoding benefit.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baseline names, or exact speedups. The experiments are expected to compare against existing parallel decoding schedulers for diffusion LLMs, measuring decoding steps, parallel unmasking rate, and quality preservation.
summary_en.authors_note: Hong Kong Baptist University, A*STAR CFAR, and Nanyang Technological University. The author list includes Bo Han, Ivor Tsang, Yanfeng Wang, and Bo Zheng.

recommendation.zh: dLLM 推理值得看这篇的 pivot/ripple 设定；若实验数字扎实，应在内部 masked decoding baseline 里复现。
recommendation.en: For dLLM inference, the pivot/ripple setup is worth reading; if the numbers hold, it should be reproduced in internal masked-decoding baselines.

paper.title: CORA-Diff: Confidence-Oriented Residual Acceptance for Efficient Diffusion Language Model Inference
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) update many tokens in parallel, yet practical decoders often use a fixed denoising horizon. Many predictions stabilize early, but blockwise decoding continues until all positions are resolved, causing repeated dense forward passes. Existing accelerators often rely on learned filters, modified scores, dependency models, or cache-specific mechanisms. We ask whether native trajectory signals can identify residual positions likely to match the deterministic dense end

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（DLM）推理通常采用固定去噪步数，每步执行全量Transformer前向；但很多token预测很早就已稳定，仍需等待所有位置解算完成，造成计算浪费。现有加速方法多依赖额外训练组件、修改分数函数、显式依赖模型或专门系统支持。论文探索能否仅用原生去噪轨迹信号，在无需训练、不改模型、不修改logit的前提下提前接受稳定token，跳过剩余步数。
summary.importance: 扩散语言模型是自回归范式之外的重要建模范式，推理效率是其落地的核心瓶颈。CORA-Diff作为训练-free的加速方案，仅用置信度和持续性两个原生轨迹信号即可工作，无需修改模型或新增模块，对DLM推理优化有实用价值。其揭示的去噪轨迹稳定性规律，也为理解扩散语言模型的生成动态提供了实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: CORA-Diff（置信度导向残差接受）完全保留原始DLM转移规则，仅对原始规则未解决的位置施加门控。一个位置被提前接受需要同时满足两个条件：一是top-1预测的置信度足够高（衡量瞬时支持度），二是预测结果连续m步保持不变（衡量轨迹稳定性）。被接受的token会作为上下文参与后续计算，当一个块内所有位置都被原始规则或CORA-Diff解决后，立即停止解码、跳过剩余全量前向步。论文还给出了接受token与稠密解码终点一致的基于margin的充分条件，以及阈值选择的有限样本界；阈值仅需在独立校准集上选一次，可跨任务、跨骨干复用。
summary.experiments: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上评测GSM8K、MATH、HumanEval、MBPP四个任务，并在Dream模型上测试跨骨干迁移能力。阈值（δ_p=0.65, m=1）在1000条GSM8K校准子集上选定后，所有测试均冻结该配置。结果显示：8个LLaDA测试设置中CORA-Diff运行时间均为最低，其中5个设置的任务分数与稠密解码相当或更高，最大分数下降仅1.22分。在带EOS感知控制器的设置下，相比EOS感知稠密解码，GSM8K上加速2.70倍，HumanEval上加速3.32倍；固定1024/1024的机制隔离协议下加速达13.14倍。跨骨干迁移到Dream模型时无需重调阈值，实现3.18-3.53倍加速，任务分数最大变化仅0.006。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看Introduction部分的核心观察（Figure 1展示的置信度+持续性与终点一致性的关联），再关注门控机制的设计逻辑，重点看跨骨干零调参迁移的结果和加速比数据；理论推导部分可跳过。预计阅读时间15分钟左右。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion language models (DLMs) typically use a fixed denoising horizon for inference, running a dense Transformer pass per step even after many token predictions have stabilized. Existing acceleration methods often require learned auxiliary components, modified scoring functions, explicit dependency models, or specialized system support. The paper asks whether native denoising trajectory signals alone can identify stable positions for early acceptance, without training, backbone modifications, or logit changes.
summary_en.importance: Diffusion language models represent a major alternative paradigm to autoregressive language modeling, and inference efficiency is a key bottleneck for their deployment. CORA-Diff is a training-free acceleration method that uses only two native trajectory signals, requiring no model changes or extra modules. It also reveals empirical stability patterns in DLM denoising trajectories that inform understanding of DLM generation dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: CORA-Diff (Confidence-Oriented Residual Acceptance) preserves the original DLM transfer rule entirely, applying gating only to positions left unresolved by that rule. A position is accepted if two conditions are met: (1) its top-1 prediction has sufficiently high confidence (instantaneous support), and (2) the prediction has persisted for m consecutive steps (trajectory stability). Accepted tokens remain visible as context. Once all positions in a block are resolved either by the original rule or by CORA-Diff, decoding stops and remaining dense passes are skipped. The paper also provides a margin-based sufficient condition for accepted tokens to match the dense endpoint, and a finite-sample bound for threshold selection. Thresholds are calibrated once on a held-out set and reused across tasks and backbones.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LLaDA-8B-Instruct across GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, and MBPP, with cross-backbone transfer tested on the Dream model. Thresholds (δ_p=0.65, m=1) are selected on a 1,000-prompt GSM8K calibration subset and frozen for all tests. CORA-Diff achieves the lowest runtime across all 8 matched LLaDA settings, with task scores matching or exceeding dense decoding in 5 settings and a maximum score drop of 1.22 points. Under an EOS-aware controller, it delivers 2.70× speedup on GSM8K and 3.32× on HumanEval over EOS-aware dense decoding; under a fixed 1024/1024 mechanism-isolation protocol, speedup reaches 13.14×. Without retuning thresholds, it achieves 3.18×–3.53× speedup on Dream with maximum task score change of 0.006.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the Introduction and the key empirical observation in Figure 1 linking confidence + persistence to endpoint agreement. Then focus on the gating mechanism design and the cross-backbone zero-tuning transfer results, along with the speedup numbers. The theoretical bounds can be skipped. Estimated reading time: ~15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Diffusion LM 推理效率的 training-free 优化，利用置信度做 early exit，关注非自回归生成效率的研究员可以扫一眼其 gating 机制的设计。
recommendation.en: A training-free optimization for Diffusion LM inference efficiency using confidence for early exit; researchers focusing on non-autoregressive generation efficiency should skim its gating mechanism design.

paper.title: Test-Time Hallucination Control in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Object Hallucination in large vision-language models (LVLMs), where models generate non-factual content about input images, remains a critical barrier to their reliability in real-world applications. Existing mitigation strategies can be categorized into training-based and training-free methods. Training-based methods often achieve strong performance but are costly, requiring extensive computational resources, large-scale data, and time-consuming fine-tuning. Training-free approaches are particu

summary.core_problem: 大视觉语言模型（LVLM）的物体幻觉问题，现有训练基方法成本高，训练无关方法存在多轮解码开销大或损害预训练知识的缺陷
summary.importance: 提出了一种新的训练无关测试时幻觉缓解方法，属于方法创新，解决了现有训练无关方法的两大痛点
summary.technical_approach: 提出测试时幻觉缓解方法TTH，用零样本多模态分类器（MMC）作为token验证器生成辅助logits，引导解码过程抑制幻觉token，无需多轮解码也不修改模型内部权重
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验设置、模型参数量、基线模型及量化提升幅度，仅说明方法为训练无关且无需多轮解码

summary_en.core_problem: Object hallucination in large vision-language models (LVLMs); existing training-based methods have high costs, while training-free methods suffer from either high multi-round decoding overhead or damage to pretrained knowledge.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel training-free test-time hallucination mitigation method, which is a methodological innovation solving two key pain points of existing training-free approaches.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Test-Time Hallucination mitigation (TTH): uses a zero-shot Multi-Modal Classifier (MMC) as a token validator to generate auxiliary logits, guiding decoding to suppress hallucinatory tokens without multi-round decoding or modifying model weights.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental setup, model parameter scale, baselines or quantitative improvement margins are disclosed in the abstract; only notes the method is training-free and requires no multi-round decoding.

recommendation.zh: 属于LVLM测试时幻觉缓解的增量方法，无预训练或后训练侧改动，仅了解思路即可，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Incremental method for test-time LVLM hallucination mitigation with no pretraining or post-training modifications; grasp the core idea only, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: VERDICT: Training-Free Step-Wise Verification of Multimodal Reasoning via Disagreement-Aware Consensus
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models often generate reasoning chains containing subtle errors that lead to incorrect answers. Current verification approaches have notable limitations. Existing approaches either require expensive labelled supervision with inconsistent cross-task performance or aggregate scores from multiple sources by simple aggregations, missing a key insight: when these scores disagree, that disagreement itself carries important information about whether a reasoning step is truly v

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是多模态推理链的“逐步验证”问题：MLLM 生成的中间步骤常带有细小但致命的视觉/逻辑错误，导致最终答案错。现有做法要么依赖训练出来的 critic/PRM（标注贵、跨任务不稳），要么用多个打分源做简单聚合（平均/投票），但忽略了“分歧本身就是信号”。作者要做的是：在不训练、不开新标注的前提下，把多源 verifier 的分歧结构显式建模成可用的 step-level 选择准则。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身关联较弱，更偏 post-train/推理时验证与搜索；但它对“训练信号质量”和“用冻结评审器组合出更稳的监督/筛选信号”有启发：如果要做过程监督数据合成或 PRM 训练，VERDICT 这种分歧感知的共识分数可以作为更干净的伪标签/过滤器，减少跨任务退化。另一个价值是工程可落地：不训练、闭式解、可插拔，适合快速做 ablation 或作为强基线。
summary.technical_approach:
VERDICT 把 step-wise verification 写成“耦合打分”问题，而不是把多个分数做独立聚合。
- 多视角冻结评审：三个冻结 judge/agent 分别从 Visual、Logical、Contextual 角度给每个候选推理步骤打分。
- 分歧感知共识：作者把这些分数的相互影响建模为一个协调博弈（coordination game），并声称存在唯一的闭式 Nash equilibrium。共识计算把原始分数变成“共识调整后的分数”：每个 judge 的最终立场会考虑其他 judge 的意见，因此不仅看均值，也看谁在和谁冲突、冲突是否可被协调。
- 双重接受准则：先做 mean confidence check（整体认可度要够），再做 dispersion check（跨 judge 的一致性要够）。通过这两道门的候选步骤才被接受；在接受集合内再按共识置信度排序，选最稳定的 continuation。
- 关键对比点：平均/方差过滤是对称且丢结构的；VERDICT 的耦合使“固执的视觉 judge”与“易被说服的上下文 judge”产生不对称影响，这类模式用固定权重或简单统计量很难复现。
summary.experiments:
作者在 6 个 benchmark（覆盖空间推理、视觉 grounding、多模态抽象）上评估，报告相对基线最高提升 +5.95%，并强调一个性质：在所有测试 benchmark 上都不低于 baseline（无退化），而若干需要训练数据的 domain-specific critic 在跨任务上会出现明显波动甚至负增益。论文摘要与引言未给出各基线名称对应的逐项数字表；需要在实验章节核对：
- 使用的 base MLLM 与生成候选步骤的策略（beam/采样/多候选数 K）。
- 三个 judge 的具体实现（是否同一个模型不同 prompt，或不同模型）。
- dispersion/mean 阈值如何设定、是否需要调参。
这些细节决定它能否作为“训练数据过滤器”迁移到别的任务。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读目标是抓住“分歧=信号”如何落到闭式共识与筛选规则上：
- 先看方法章节里共识的闭式解推导与博弈解释：这是 VERDICT 与平均/投票的本质差异。
- 再看 acceptance criterion（mean + dispersion）与 ranking 规则：这是它保证“不退化”的主要来源。
- 最后看实验里跨任务稳定性的表格：重点不是单点提升，而是哪些 critic 会退化、VERDICT 为什么不退化。
预计 40–60 分钟可完成有效泛读；若要用于数据合成/PRM 伪标签，建议额外精读 judge 设计与阈值敏感性消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets step-wise verification for multimodal reasoning chains: MLLMs often produce locally plausible intermediate steps that contain subtle visual or logical errors, which then cascade into wrong final answers. Prior approaches either rely on trained critics/PRMs (expensive supervision, unstable transfer) or use simple score aggregation across frozen sources (mean/vote), which discards the information carried by disagreement patterns. The goal is a training-free verifier that explicitly uses disagreement as a first-class signal.
summary_en.importance: It is not a pretraining contribution; it sits in inference-time verification and post-training tooling. The pretraining-adjacent value is in signal construction: if one wants to synthesize process-supervision data or train PRMs, a disagreement-aware consensus score can serve as a cleaner pseudo-label/filter than naive averaging, potentially reducing cross-task regressions. It is also an engineering-friendly baseline: plug-in, no training, closed-form computation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VERDICT formulates verification as a coupled scoring problem among frozen, modality-specialized judges.
- Three frozen judges score each candidate step from different perspectives: Visual grounding, Logical validity, and Contextual relevance.
- Disagreement-aware consensus: instead of aggregating independently, they introduce coupling and interpret the interaction as a coordination game. The consensus-adjusted scores correspond to a unique Nash equilibrium with a claimed closed-form solution, so each judge’s adjusted belief accounts for others.
- Dual acceptance rule: a mean-confidence threshold ensures sufficient collective endorsement, while a dispersion (agreement) constraint rejects unstable steps with unresolved conflict. Among accepted candidates, they rank by consensus confidence to pick the most stable continuation.
- Key distinction vs mean/variance: averaging is symmetric and loses “who disagrees with whom”; variance ignores belief strength. Coupling introduces structured, asymmetric influence (e.g., a stubborn visual judge can dominate disagreement in a way fixed weights cannot capture).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on six benchmarks spanning spatial reasoning, visual grounding, and multimodal abstraction. They report improvements up to +5.95% over baselines and emphasize a robustness property: VERDICT never drops below the baseline on any tested benchmark, whereas trained domain-specific critics can improve some tasks but degrade others. The excerpt does not include the full experimental tables; to assess reproducibility and transfer, the key missing details to verify in the main text are: which base MLLMs are used, how many candidate steps/continuations are generated (K) and by what decoding strategy, how the three judges are instantiated (same model with different prompts vs different models), and how sensitive the mean/dispersion thresholds are.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with three checkpoints:
1) The closed-form consensus derivation and the coordination-game interpretation (this is the core novelty vs ad hoc aggregation).
2) The acceptance criteria (mean + dispersion) and the ranking rule (this largely explains the “no degradation” claim).
3) The cross-benchmark stability tables: focus on where trained critics regress and whether VERDICT avoids those regimes.
A solid skim takes ~40–60 minutes; if you plan to use it for data filtering or pseudo-labeling, also read the judge design and threshold sensitivity ablations carefully.

recommendation.zh: 将多个 verifier 之间的分歧（disagreement）形式化为博弈论问题，作为无需训练的验证信号，对构建高质量的 RL 奖励模型或合成数据有启发。
recommendation.en: Formalizes disagreement among multiple verifiers as a game-theoretic problem to serve as a training-free verification signal, offering insights for building high-quality RL reward models or synthetic data.

paper.title: Understanding Calibration and Truncation Error Propagation in Training-Free Low-Rank Compression for LLMs
paper.abstract: Training-free low-rank compression frameworks have been gaining prominence for LLM compression given their effectiveness in reducing model parameter count while maintaining task-level accuracy. However, existing SOTA frameworks share two key limitations: (1) residual errors in calibration data activations accumulate across layers during compression, causing misalignment between representations simulated at compression time and those experienced at inference; (2) the assumption that layer importa

summary.core_problem: Training-free 低秩压缩中，校准数据激活的残差误差逐层累积，且层重要性分布在压缩后发生变化，导致压缩时模拟的表示与推理时不一致。
summary.importance: 分析了现有低秩压缩框架的两个具体失效模式，并提出简单的 training-free 修复方法，对模型压缩实践有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 两个修复：(1) Layer-by-Layer Compression with Calibration Correction，逐层压缩时修正校准误差；(2) Iterative Compression with Rank Allocation Correction，迭代调整秩分配以适应压缩后的层重要性变化。在现有 SOTA 分解框架上实现。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集或数值结果，仅说明在现有 SOTA 框架上评估。

summary_en.core_problem: In training-free low-rank compression, residual errors in calibration activations accumulate across layers, and layer importance distributions shift post-compression, causing misalignment between compression-time and inference-time representations.
summary_en.importance: Identifies two concrete failure modes in existing low-rank compression frameworks and proposes simple training-free fixes; practically relevant for model compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two mitigations: (1) Layer-by-Layer Compression with Calibration Correction to fix calibration errors during per-layer compression; (2) Iterative Compression with Rank Allocation Correction to iteratively adjust rank allocation for post-compression importance shifts. Implemented atop an existing SOTA decomposition framework.
summary_en.experiments: No specific models, datasets, or numerical results in the abstract beyond stating evaluation atop an existing SOTA framework.

recommendation.zh: 误差累积和层重要性漂移的分析值得做压缩的人看，但方法是增量修补，无实验细节；只看问题分析部分即可。
recommendation.en: The error accumulation and layer-importance drift analysis is worth reading for compression practitioners, but the method is an incremental patch with no experimental details. Read the problem analysis only.

paper.title: Wiener Representation Filtering for VLM Hallucination Suppression
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended captioning and visual QA but often describe objects, attributes, or relations absent from the image, a phenomenon known as object hallucination. We propose a {training-free, post-hoc representation editing technique} that operates in the representation space of the language backbone. The method performs a lightweight, one-time offline calibration on a modest paired dataset to estimate the required covariance structures, using only forward passes

summary.core_problem: VLM在开放域描述和视觉问答中频繁产生图像中不存在的物体、属性或关系（物体幻觉）。
summary.importance: 提出一种训练自由、事后的表示编辑方法，无需梯度更新或微调即可抑制幻觉，属于方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 将语言骨干隐藏状态建模为真实成分和幻觉相关成分的叠加；在小规模配对数据集上仅通过前向传播估计协方差结构；推导出Wiener型估计器，最优增益由真实和幻觉表示的协方差闭式给出；特征分解得到逐模式衰减并满足稳定性准则；校正直接吸收到模型现有权重中。
summary.experiments: 在VLM物体幻觉基准上测试，训练自由、一次性校准，显著降低幻觉率同时保持描述质量。
summary.authors_note: Lior Wolf（Tel Aviv University），在多模态和生成模型领域有较多代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: VLMs frequently describe objects, attributes, or relations absent from the image (object hallucination) in open-ended captioning and VQA.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free, post-hoc representation editing method that suppresses hallucination without gradient updates or fine-tuning; method innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models hidden states of the language backbone as a superposition of truthful and hallucination-associated components; estimates covariance structures on a small paired dataset via forward passes only; derives a Wiener-type estimator whose optimal gains are given in closed form from covariances of truthful and hallucinated representations; eigendecomposition yields mode-wise attenuation satisfying a stability criterion; correction is absorbed directly into existing model weights.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on VLM object hallucination benchmarks; training-free with one-time calibration, significantly reduces hallucination rate while preserving caption quality.
summary_en.authors_note: Lior Wolf (Tel Aviv University), known for work in multimodal and generative models.

recommendation.zh: 看§3的Wiener滤波推导和协方差估计部分，判断幻觉是否真在表示空间线性可分；若成立，对幻觉干预手段的认知会改变。
recommendation.en: Read §3 for the Wiener filter derivation and covariance estimation; if hallucination is truly linearly separable in representation space, it changes how we think about hallucination interventions.

paper.title: VADER: Adaptive Debiasing for Hallucination Mitigation in Video Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in open-ended video understanding, yet they remain prone to fluent responses unsupported by video evidence. Existing training-free methods typically apply a globally fixed visual intervention or construct a contrastive branch through input perturbation. The former cannot accommodate video-dependent fusion paths, while the latter can be compensated by cross-frame redundancy. We therefore propose Video-Adaptive Debiasing via

summary.core_problem: 视频大语言模型易生成缺乏视频证据支撑的幻觉，现有免训练方法要么使用全局固定视觉干预无法适配不同视频，要么通过输入扰动构造对比分支但被跨帧冗余抵消。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出免训练的视频自适应去偏框架，通过逐层视觉-文本证据流诊断与选择性证据擦除缓解视频LLM幻觉。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VADER：1) 视觉焦点重分配(VFR)：逐层诊断视觉到文本的证据流，确定干预层并将系统token注意力重分配到视频token；2) 选择性证据擦除(SEE)：独立掩码每帧高重要性视觉token，构造对比信号抑制无证据生成。
summary.experiments: 在开放域视频理解任务上对比现有免训练幻觉缓解方法，验证VFR与SEE的互补效果，具体提升幅度未在摘要中披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Video LLMs tend to hallucinate fluent responses unsupported by video evidence; existing training-free methods either apply globally fixed visual interventions or build contrastive branches via input perturbation that are canceled by cross-frame redundancy.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a training-free video-adaptive debiasing framework that mitigates video LLM hallucination through layer-wise visual-text evidence flow diagnosis and selective evidence erasure.
summary_en.technical_approach: VADER framework: 1) Visual Focus Reallocation (VFR) diagnoses layer-wise visual-to-text evidence flow, decides where to intervene, and reallocates pre-softmax attention from system tokens to video tokens; 2) Selective Evidence Erasure (SEE) masks high-importance visual tokens per frame independently to build contrastive signals against evidence-free generation.
summary_en.experiments: Compared with existing training-free hallucination mitigation methods on open-domain video understanding; concrete gains are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 免训练的视频LLM幻觉缓解方法，注意力重分配思路可参考做多模态对齐诊断，但属于后处理技巧，对预训练流程无直接启示，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: A training-free hallucination mitigation method for video LLMs; attention reallocation is useful for multimodal alignment diagnosis, but it is a post-processing trick with no direct pretraining implication—abstract suffices.

paper.title: RoRA: Role-Oriented Regional Allocation for Visual Token Pruning in MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode images as long visual token sequences, making prefilling and KV-cache storage expensive. Existing training-free pruning methods select tokens by importance, diversity, or spatial coverage, but treat retained tokens as interchangeable and do not explicitly track which object-related regions are already covered. We present RoRA, a training-free framework that casts visual token pruning as role-oriented regional evidence allocation. Given a fixed budg

summary.core_problem: MLLM 中图像被编码为长视觉 token 序列，prefill 和 KV-cache 开销大；现有无训练剪枝方法把保留 token 视为可互换，未显式覆盖对象区域。
summary.importance: 推理效率类工作，对多模态 KV-cache 压缩和视觉 token 预算分配有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: RoRA 是无训练框架，把视觉 token 剪枝建模为面向角色的区域证据分配：受保护语义核心、互补上下文、细粒度细节；用位置先验和 prompt 校准的对象先验校正 attention，构造 Attention-Anchored Regions 作为已覆盖对象代理，上下文主要在 AAR 外探索，少量预算用于局部细节恢复。
summary.experiments: 在多个 MLLM 和 benchmark 上做训练无关剪枝对比（摘要未给具体数字）。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLMs encode images as long visual token sequences, making prefilling and KV-cache storage expensive; existing training-free pruning methods treat retained tokens as interchangeable without tracking object-region coverage.
summary_en.importance: Inference-efficiency work relevant to multimodal KV-cache compression and visual token budget allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: RoRA is a training-free framework casting visual token pruning as role-oriented regional evidence allocation: a protected semantic core, complementary context, and fine-grained detail. It calibrates text-conditioned attention with positional and prompt-calibrated object priors, builds Attention-Anchored Regions as proxies for covered object support, explores context mainly outside AARs, and uses a small AAR-guided budget to restore local detail.
summary_en.experiments: Training-free pruning comparisons across multiple MLLMs and benchmarks (specific numbers not in abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把对象覆盖显式纳入视觉 token 剪枝是合理方向，但无训练方法上限有限；看 AAR 构造和与 FastV/视觉 token 剪枝基线的对比即可。
recommendation.en: Explicit object-coverage accounting is a sensible angle for visual token pruning, but training-free methods have limited headroom; inspect the AAR construction and comparisons to FastV-style baselines.

paper.title: Diff-VF: Training-free High-quality Long Video Generation via Diffusion Model
paper.abstract: Recently, diffusion models have made great progress in video generation. However, most existing video diffusion models are trained with short videos, and degrade when extrapolated to long videos, struggling to maintain long-range temporal coherence while retaining diverse motions. To generate consistent, high-quality and dynamic long videos, we propose Diff-VF, a training-free, plug-and-play and model-agnostic framework that converts existing short-video diffusion backbones into long-video gener

summary.core_problem: 解决短视频 diffusion backbone 外推到长视频时出现的长程时序不一致、窗口断裂和运动多样性下降问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成侧的 sampling 框架，不是语言模型预训练；对预训练研究员的价值主要在于观察 training-free temporal stitching 如何利用现有生成模型的先验。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Diff-VF，一个无需训练、即插即用、模型无关的长视频生成框架。它结合 Hybrid Noise Initialization 约束全局语义，Weighted Window Sampling 平滑跨窗口边界，Temporal Extended Sampling 用随 timestep 变化的融合建立长程依赖；还用 Skip Residual Guidance 扩展到长视频增强。
summary.experiments: 基于现有短视频 diffusion 模型做长视频生成与增强评测，并提到使用 VBench 等视频生成评测。摘要未给出 backbone、参数量、视频长度和具体提升数值；核心报告是相对已有长视频扩展方案能改善一致性、质量和动态性。
summary.authors_note: 摘要标注存在 Cohere 相关 notable 信息，但无法仅从给定作者列表确认具体团队归属。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the failure of short-video diffusion backbones when extrapolated to long videos, especially long-range temporal inconsistency, window discontinuities, and reduced motion diversity.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a sampling framework for multimodal generation rather than language-model pretraining. Its relevance is mainly as a case study in exploiting pretrained generative priors without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Diff-VF is a training-free, plug-and-play, model-agnostic framework. It combines Hybrid Noise Initialization for global semantics, Weighted Window Sampling for cross-window continuity, and Temporal Extended Sampling with timestep-varying fusion for long-range dependencies. Skip Residual Guidance extends the method to long-video enhancement.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on long-video generation and enhancement using existing short-video diffusion backbones, with VBench mentioned in the abstract. The abstract does not provide backbone sizes, generated lengths, or exact gains; it claims improved consistency, quality, and motion dynamics over prior extensions.
summary_en.authors_note: The metadata marks Cohere as a notable institution, but the provided author information alone is insufficient to confirm exact affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫一眼采样设计：不是预训练突破，但 HNI/WWS/TES 是长程生成里低成本利用模型先验的实用套路。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick skim for the sampling design: not a pretraining advance, but HNI/WWS/TES are practical ways to reuse short-video priors for long generation.

paper.title: Training-Free Hashing-Based Attention via Binary Principal Components
paper.abstract: Long-context large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet self-attention remains a major efficiency bottleneck -- especially during decoding -- due to the necessity of repeatedly processing ever-growing key-value (KV) caches. Existing sparse attention reduce computation by attending to fewer KV pairs, but often suffer from substantial accuracy degradation, require additional training, or rely on expensive hashing. In this work, we present BinaryPC, a tra

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM解码阶段自注意力随KV缓存增长成为计算瓶颈，现有稀疏注意力方案要么精度损失大、要么需要额外训练、要么哈希计算开销高
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出训练-free、数据感知的哈希稀疏注意力方案BinaryPC，在不修改模型参数、不增加训练成本的前提下降低长上下文解码的注意力计算量
summary.technical_approach: 通过计算KV数据的二值主成分构造紧凑二进制哈希码与对应哈希函数，相比于数据无关的LSH和需要训练的非线性哈希，可显式保留数据结构信息，无需梯度训练，基于哈希桶做稀疏注意力计算
summary.experiments: 在多个长上下文任务上测试，BinaryPC在不同上下文长度下均优于LSH等无训练稀疏注意力基线，精度接近全注意力，同时显著降低解码阶段的KV计算量

summary_en.core_problem: Self-attention during long-context LLM decoding becomes a compute bottleneck as KV cache grows; existing sparse attention methods either suffer large accuracy drops, require additional training, or incur high hashing overhead.
summary_en.importance: A method contribution proposing BinaryPC, a training-free, data-aware hashing-based sparse attention that reduces long-context decoding compute without modifying model parameters or adding training costs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs compact binary hash codes and hash functions by computing binary principal components of KV data. Unlike data-independent LSH or trained non-linear hashing, it explicitly preserves data structure without gradient-based training, then performs sparse attention within hash buckets.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across multiple long-context tasks, BinaryPC outperforms training-free sparse attention baselines including LSH across context lengths, achieves accuracy close to full attention while significantly reducing KV compute during decoding.

recommendation.zh: 训练-free的长上下文稀疏注意力方案，无需改模型即可降低解码算力，知道结论即可，无需深读
recommendation.en: A training-free sparse attention approach for long-context decoding that cuts compute without model modifications; know the result, no need to read in depth.

paper.title: DIVE: Dynamic Iterative Visual Evidence Construction for Efficient Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Visual inputs in vision-language models (VLMs) are often encoded into substantially longer token sequences than text, making visual tokens a major bottleneck for efficient inference. Abundant recent methods address this bottleneck by scoring token importance and pruning low-scoring tokens in a single pass. However, one-shot scoring is insufficient because a token's prompt-relevant usefulness depends on the evidence already retained. Motivated by this insight, we introduce DIVE (Dynamic Iterative

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 中一次性视觉 token 评分无法考虑已保留证据、导致剪枝 token 与 prompt 需求不互补的问题。
summary.importance: 方法型工作，把视觉 token 剪枝重新表述为动态证据构建；对 VLM 推理加速有参考，但属于训练-free 的增量式剪枝改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DIVE，一个 training-free 框架：迭代选择当前 residual-conditioned score 最高的 token，更新视觉和 prompt residual 以折扣已解释证据，再重新评估剩余 token，形成互补的保留集合。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个图像理解 benchmark 上评估；摘要未给出具体模型、baseline 或数值结果，仅说明该 select-update-re-evaluate 流程用于构建 prompt-relevant visual evidence。

summary_en.core_problem: One-shot visual token scoring in VLMs ignores which evidence has already been retained, so pruned tokens may fail to complement the prompt-relevant evidence set.
summary_en.importance: A methods paper that recasts visual token pruning as dynamic evidence construction; relevant to VLM inference acceleration, but it is an incremental training-free pruning improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: DIVE repeatedly selects the token with the highest residual-conditioned score, updates visual and prompt residuals to discount explained evidence, and re-evaluates remaining tokens to build a complementary retained set.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on eight image-understanding benchmarks. The abstract does not report model names, baselines, or numeric results, only describing the select-update-re-evaluate procedure.

recommendation.zh: 训练-free 的迭代剪枝技巧，思路清楚但更像 VLM 推理工程改进；看 residual 更新公式和主表即可。
recommendation.en: A training-free iterative pruning trick with a clear idea, but mostly VLM inference engineering. Read the residual update and main table.

paper.title: Trace, Verify, and Correct: A Training-Free Framework for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress, their spatial reasoning may still produce intermediate judgments inconsistent with the input image, allowing errors to propagate through the reasoning chain and affect the final answer. Existing methods mainly improve spatial reasoning through training or additional spatial information, without considering whether the reasoning process itself is faithful to the model input. Our study shows that unfaithful reasoning

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型的空间推理链常包含与输入图像不一致的中间判断，错误沿推理链传播导致最终答案失准，现有方法多通过训练或额外信息改进而未校验推理忠实度。
summary.importance: 首次从推理链忠实度角度切入 MLLM 空间推理，提出免训练的验证-修正框架，属于方法改进与忠实推理分析。
summary.technical_approach: 构建空间证据图 SEG，将 CoT 中抽取的原子空间证据与视觉实体、空间关系、来源步骤及视觉证据关联；设计空间证据可靠性评估 SERA，基于对象检测等评估证据可信度，再对不可靠步骤做模块化修正。
summary.experiments: 在多个 MLLM 空间推理基准上验证，忠实度提升显著带动最终答案准确率提升；对比训练式方法在零样本场景下保持竞争力。

summary_en.core_problem: Spatial reasoning chains in MLLMs often contain intermediate judgments inconsistent with the input image; errors propagate and degrade final accuracy, while existing methods mostly rely on training or extra spatial signals instead of verifying reasoning faithfulness.
summary_en.importance: First approach to MLLM spatial reasoning from the reasoning-faithfulness perspective; proposes a training-free verification-correction framework, contributing method improvement and faithful-reasoning analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a Spatial Evidence Graph (SEG) linking atomic spatial evidence extracted from CoT to visual entities, spatial relations, source steps and visual evidence; designs Spatial Evidence Reliability Assessment (SERA) to score evidence credibility via object detection, then applies modular correction to unreliable steps.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple MLLM spatial reasoning benchmarks; improved faithfulness consistently lifts final answer accuracy, and remains competitive against training-based methods under zero-shot settings.

recommendation.zh: 免训练后处理类工作，对预训练研究员仅作“空间推理失败模式”的参考素材，读实验失败案例即可。
recommendation.en: Training-free post-hoc correction work; useful to pretraining researchers only as a reference for spatial-reasoning failure modes, read failure-case analysis only.

paper.title: Approximate Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying a draft block with a target model in parallel. Under standard greedy verification, decoding stops at the first draft token that differs from the target argmax, discarding the remaining target-scored suffix. Although accepting such a mismatch changes the decoding trajectory, it can make a contiguous suffix reusable when its tokens remain target-greedy under the realized prefix. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{Approximate

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是 speculative decoding 中 verifier 过于保守的问题：标准 greedy verification 一旦遇到 draft token 与 target argmax 不一致，就截断整个 block，即使这个 mismatch 的 target-logit regret 很小，且后续 token 在接受该 mismatch 后仍然会被 target 判为 greedy token。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，主要价值在推理效率和 serving。它有一个清晰的提醒：很多解码加速方法把“保持目标模型轨迹不变”作为硬约束，而 ASD 选择显式放松这个约束，用可计量的局部 regret 换取吞吐。这个思路对基座研究也有参考意义，尤其是研究训练目标、解码目标和任务正确性之间并不完全等价时。论文也比较克制地说明，ASD 只控制累计 local regret，不保证输出一致、语义一致或任务正确。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 training-free verifier 改造，不训练 draft model，也不增加额外 target forward。标准 speculative decoding 对 draft block 做 teacher-forced target pass，得到每个位置的 target logits。严格 verifier 只接受从开头开始完全等于 target argmax 的最长前缀。ASD 把它改成 budgeted longest-prefix selection：遇到 mismatch 时，计算 local target-logit regret，即 target argmax 相对 draft token 的 logit 差；只有 regret 小于阈值、当前 block 的 exception 数不超过上限、整个 request 的累计 regret budget 仍可用，才允许接受这个 mismatch。关键细节是 realized-prefix suffix reuse：如果接受了早期 mismatch，那么后续 teacher-forced target row 已经是在包含该 mismatch 的 draft prefix 上计算的；因此后面连续等于 target argmax 的 draft token 可以直接提交，不需要重新跑 target。这个设计区别于简单放宽 token match 的方法，因为它不是逐 token 独立放行，而是维护 request-level ledger，防止长输出中小偏差不断累积。
summary.experiments: 实验主要报告固定 workload 下的吞吐收益和接受率变化。Qwen3-14B 作为 target、DSpark-14B 作为 draft，在 7 个任务上，ASD 相比匹配设置下的严格 speculative decoding，最高提升 15.26% fixed-workload throughput，平均提升 7.78%。在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 285B 与 DSpark 的设置中，论文还报告了 FP4-to-FP8 compatibility 下的接受率改进：GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上约有 10% 到 16% 的提升。消融重点不是模型训练，而是 verifier 策略：local regret threshold、block-level exception cap、request-level budget，以及可复用 suffix 的出现频率。论文也指出 opportunity rate 和最终 TPS 不是严格因果对应关系，因为系统吞吐还受 batch、cache、内存带宽和实现细节影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 first-mismatch truncation 的问题定义，以及 Approximate Speculative Decoding 一节中 local target-logit regret、request-level budget 和 suffix reuse 的形式化。图 1 和图 3 值得看：前者解释为什么接受一个 mismatch 后后缀可以复用，后者给出这种机会在不同任务和阈值下的经验分布。实验部分主要看固定 workload TPS，而不是只看 acceptance rate。需要特别留意论文的边界条件：ASD 是近似解码，不是 lossless serving 优化；如果部署在高精度数学、代码生成或安全敏感场景，需要额外验证任务级错误率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an overly strict verification rule in speculative decoding. Standard greedy verification stops at the first draft token that differs from the target argmax, even when the mismatch has very small target-logit regret and the following draft tokens would still be target-greedy under the prefix that includes the accepted mismatch.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is inference efficiency rather than pretraining. Its useful lesson is that exact target-trajectory preservation is only one operating point. ASD makes a controlled tradeoff: it spends a measured local-regret budget to gain more reusable target-scored tokens. This is also a useful framing for pretraining researchers studying the gap between token-level objectives, decoding trajectories, and task-level correctness. The paper is careful about the limitation: ASD bounds accumulated local regret, but it does not guarantee identical outputs, semantic preservation, or task correctness.
summary_en.technical_approach: ASD is a training-free verifier-side modification. It uses the same teacher-forced target pass as standard speculative decoding. Instead of accepting only the longest prefix that exactly matches the target argmax, it selects the longest prefix subject to three constraints: a local target-logit regret threshold for mismatched tokens, a per-block cap on the number of accepted exceptions, and a persistent request-level regret budget. The central mechanism is realized-prefix suffix reuse. Once an early mismatch is accepted, later target rows in the teacher-forced pass are already conditioned on the draft prefix containing that mismatch. If subsequent draft tokens equal the corresponding target argmax under that realized prefix, they can be committed without another target forward pass. This differs from a naive relaxed matcher because deviations are explicitly accounted for over the whole request rather than reset at every block.
summary_en.experiments: The reported gains are throughput-oriented. With Qwen3-14B as the target and DSpark-14B as the draft model, ASD improves fixed-workload throughput over matched strict speculative decoding by up to 15.26%, with a 7.78% average gain across seven tasks. With DeepSeek-V4-Flash at 285B parameters and DSpark, the paper reports roughly 10% to 16% acceptance improvements on GSM8K and MATH-500 under FP4-to-FP8 compatibility. The ablations focus on verifier controls: regret threshold, block exception cap, request-level budget, and the empirical frequency of reusable suffixes. The paper also notes that opportunity rate does not directly determine TPS, since serving performance depends on batching, cache handling, memory bandwidth, and implementation details.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the Introduction for the precise failure mode of first-mismatch truncation. Then focus on the ASD formulation: local target-logit regret, budget accounting, and realized-prefix suffix reuse. Figure 1 is the key intuition for suffix reuse; Figure 3 is useful for understanding how often low-regret mismatches followed by greedy suffixes appear. In the experiments, prioritize fixed-workload TPS over raw acceptance rate. The main caveat is important: ASD is approximate decoding, not a lossless serving optimization, so task-level error should be checked before use in math, code, or safety-sensitive generation.

recommendation.zh: 训练免费的推测解码实用改进，无需改模型即可提升接受率，部署侧可直接接入验证，只看§3算法和核心ablation即可。
recommendation.en: A practical training-free tweak to speculative decoding that boosts acceptance rate without model changes; skip to §3 for the algorithm and core ablation results for deployment validation.

paper.title: REFLEX: Rethinking MoE Inference as Refinement-Aware Compute Allocation in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models increase parameter capacity by activating only a small subset of experts for each token. This conditional-computation paradigm has enabled autoregressive language models to scale model capacity without a proportional increase in per-token computation. In diffusion language models (DLMs), however, each denoising forward jointly revisits all token positions despite their sharply different refinement demands, while the default fixed token-choice routing assigns them

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（DLM）的 MoE 推理默认对所有 token 使用固定 top-k 专家选择，但在同一次 denoising forward 中，不同 token 所处的 refinement 状态差异很大——有的还在结构探索阶段，有的已接近确定。固定专家预算造成计算与 refinement 需求错配：低需求 token 浪费专家，高需求 token 预算不足。
summary.importance: 对 diffusion LM 这一非 AR 建模范式的推理效率有实际意义，也触及 MoE 与 DLM 结合时的一个新问题：AR MoE 的可变专家策略以 router score 或全局预算为依据，而 DLM 中 token 是联合迭代精炼的，分配单元应是 token 的 refinement state。论文把这一问题形式化为受约束的 state-wise 分配问题，对后续 DLM-MoE 架构和训练-推理协同设计有参考价值。属于推理优化方向，对 pretrain 本身启发间接。
summary.technical_approach: REFLEX 是 training-free 方法，保留默认 router 学到的专家排序，只改变每个 token 分配到的专家数量。它用两个维度刻画 refinement state：(1) Refinement-Role Budgeting，根据 token 在 block-wise 扩散中的结构角色给出先验分配；(2) Frontier-Guided Expert Reallocation，用 Frontier-Progress Score 衡量 token 向确定状态推进的动态进度，在保持每个 block 总专家预算不变的前提下做粗到细的再分配。与 dMoE（限制每 block 唯一专家数以降加载开销）和 EC-DLM（按 timestep 全局调度专家容量）不同，REFLEX 以 token refinement state 为分配单位，且不改动 router。
summary.experiments: 在 LLaDA-MoE 和 LLaDA2.0-mini 上，针对数学推理和代码 benchmark 评测。相比默认 Fixed TC top-8 routing，REFLEX 平均减少 15% 的 selected expert-token pairs，在多数 benchmark 上保持甚至提升生成质量；与 AR 风格的可变专家路由方法相比，quality-computation 权衡更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。建议重点看引言中对 DLM-MoE 与 AR-MoE 推理差异的问题刻画，以及方法部分两个维度（structural role + frontier progress）的定义。实验部分关注 15% 专家削减下的质量保持情况即可。预计 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE inference in diffusion language models defaults to fixed top-k expert selection for every token, yet within a single denoising forward different tokens occupy very different refinement states — some are still under structural exploration while others are near commitment. A uniform expert budget mismatches compute with refinement demand, wasting experts on low-demand tokens and under-provisioning tokens that still benefit from refinement.
summary_en.importance: Practical for inference efficiency of non-AR diffusion LMs, and it surfaces a genuine new problem at the MoE–DLM intersection: variable-expert strategies for AR MoEs rely on router scores or global budgets, but in DLMs tokens are refined jointly and iteratively, so the natural unit of allocation is the token refinement state. The paper formalizes this as a constrained state-wise allocation problem, which is useful for future DLM-MoE architecture and training–inference co-design. The relevance to pretraining itself is indirect, sitting mainly in inference optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: REFLEX is training-free and keeps the default router's learned expert ranking; it only changes how many experts each token receives. Refinement state is characterized along two axes: (1) Refinement-Role Budgeting produces a structural prior based on a token's role within block-wise diffusion; (2) Frontier-Guided Expert Reallocation uses a Frontier-Progress Score as dynamic evidence of progress toward commitment and reallocates experts coarse-to-fine while preserving each block's total expert budget. Unlike dMoE (which limits unique experts per block to reduce loading overhead) and EC-DLM (which adapts expert capacity across timesteps via a global schedule and expert-choice routing), REFLEX allocates at the token-refinement-state granularity without modifying the router.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LLaDA-MoE and LLaDA2.0-mini over mathematical reasoning and coding benchmarks. Relative to default Fixed TC top-8 routing, REFLEX reduces selected expert-token pairs by 15% on average while preserving or improving generation quality on most benchmarks, and yields a more consistent quality–compute trade-off than autoregressive-style variable-expert routing.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the introduction's framing of how DLM-MoE inference differs from AR-MoE, and on the two refinement-state dimensions (structural role and frontier progress) in the method. In experiments, the key takeaway is quality retention at a 15% expert reduction. Estimated 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: DLM+MoE 的推理预算不该照搬 AR；只看方法和预算曲线，值得在内部 DLM ablation 里复现。
recommendation.en: Do not inherit AR-style MoE budgeting for DLMs blindly; the compute-allocation curves are worth reproducing in an internal DLM ablation.

paper.title: Allocation Before Ranking: Decoupled Token Compression for OmniLLMs
paper.abstract: Token compression in OmniLLMs is typically posed as a single saliency-ranking problem: score each multimodal token, keep the top-K. We argue this abstraction is mis-specified. The same attention score simultaneously decides two things: how much retained capacity each modality receives, and which tokens within a modality are kept. A shared top-K rule therefore inherits this audio-favoring allocation prior, spending retained capacity on audio before video tokens have a chance to compete. We propos

summary.core_problem: 现有共享解码器OmniLLM的token压缩普遍采用全局top-K显著性排序，将跨模态容量分配、模态内token选择两个独立决策耦合在同一个注意力分数中。共享注意力本身存在稳定的音频偏好先验，会隐式挤占视频token的保留配额，导致压缩后的精度与效率平衡不佳。
summary.importance: 它揭示了共享解码器OmniLLM的注意力存在结构性跨模态分配偏差——这一偏差来自架构设计本身，而非训练数据或策略。对统一多模态预训练的架构设计、模态容量平衡机制，以及推理侧的token压缩优化都有参考价值。无需训练的特性也使其可直接用于现有OmniLLM的部署优化。
summary.technical_approach:
Macer是一种无需训练的推理侧token压缩方法，核心遵循「先分配，后排序」的原则：
1. 先显式为音频和视频分配各自的保留配额，不再由原始共享注意力的质量隐式决定容量分配；
2. 在每个模态内部，用模态归一化后的注意力分数排序选token，不做跨模态混排；
3. 由于音频显著性在解码器浅层更早稳定，视频显著性稍晚才稳定，因此在模态特定的浅层读取注意力分数，无需等到深层。
此外，在视频配额内加入了一个轻量的时间覆盖约束，避免保留的视频token在时间上过度集中。
整个方法不需要训练、不需要修改模型，也不需要额外前向传播。
summary.experiments: 在三个共享解码器OmniLLM骨干（Qwen2.5-Omni-7B、Qwen2.5-Omni-3B、OmniVinci-9B）上验证，覆盖音频grounding、音视频联合、视觉主导、视频中心四类任务。25% token保留率下，Qwen2.5-Omni-7B可保留全token性能的98.7%，对比基线OmniZip的91.6%；3B版本可保留97.3%，OmniZip为95.5%。在OmniVinci-9B上，相比共享top-K排序最高提升12.9个点。所有测试保留率下的综合性能，均优于对比的token剪枝基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看Introduction部分的三个核心观察，这是方法的核心动机，比方法本身更具启发性。然后看方法部分中注意力分解为跨模态分配项和模态内残差项的数学推导，理解全局top-K排序天然存在耦合问题的原因。实验部分只需看主结果表和跨模型迁移性结果即可。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing token compression methods for shared-decoder omnimodal LLMs (OmniLLMs) frame compression as a single global top-K saliency ranking problem, coupling two distinct decisions — cross-modal capacity allocation and within-modality token selection — into one attention score. Shared attention has a persistent audio-favoring prior that implicitly consumes most of the retention budget before video tokens can compete, leading to a poor accuracy-efficiency tradeoff under compression.
summary_en.importance: It identifies a structural cross-modal allocation bias in shared-decoder OmniLLM attention that arises from architecture design, not training data or strategies. This finding informs multimodal pretraining architecture design, cross-modal capacity balancing mechanisms, and inference-side token compression optimization. The training-free property makes it directly applicable to existing OmniLLM deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Macer is a training-free inference-time token compressor built on the allocation-before-selection principle:
1. It first explicitly assigns separate retention budgets for audio and video tokens, removing implicit budget allocation from raw shared attention mass.
2. It ranks tokens only within each modality using modality-normalized attention scores, instead of cross-modal mixed ranking.
3. It reads saliency scores at modality-specific shallow layers, since audio saliency stabilizes earlier than video saliency in the decoder.
A lightweight temporal coverage term is applied only within the video budget to avoid temporal over-concentration of retained video tokens.
The method requires no training, no model modification, and no extra forward pass.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three shared-decoder OmniLLM backbones (Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, Qwen2.5-Omni-3B, OmniVinci-9B) across four task categories: audio-grounded, audio-video joint, visual-dominant, and video-centric. At 25% token retention, Macer preserves 98.7% of full-token accuracy on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B (vs. 91.6% for OmniZip) and 97.3% on the 3B variant (vs. 95.5% for OmniZip). On OmniVinci-9B, it outperforms shared top-K ranking by up to 12.9 points. It achieves the best aggregate performance among compared token pruning baselines at every tested retention ratio.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the three motivating observations in the Introduction — they capture the core insight behind the method. Then review the mathematical decomposition of attention into cross-modal allocation and within-modality residual terms in the method section, which explains why global top-K ranking is fundamentally mis-specified for OmniLLMs. Skim the main result tables and cross-model transfer results in experiments. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多模态 token 压缩的一个干净 insight：统一 top-K 隐含模态间不公平分配。看 §3 方法和 Table 2 性能保留曲线即可。
recommendation.en: A clean insight on multimodal token compression: unified top-K implicitly biases cross-modality allocation. Read §3 method and Table 2 performance-retention curves.

paper.title: TRAM: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning with Trajectory-Derived Auxiliary Memory
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks requiring visual understanding and multi-step inference. However, as reasoning trajectories grow, models may become less effective at using information established earlier in the context, increasing the risk of reasoning errors. Existing approaches primarily address this problem by sustaining visual grounding throughout reasoning. However, reasoning also transforms visual observations into task-specific relations

summary.core_problem: 多模态大推理模型在长推理轨迹中，早期推导的任务特定关系、约束、中间结论的影响力会随轨迹长度增加而衰减；现有方法仅关注维持原始图像的视觉接地，未覆盖推理衍生信息的保留问题，且图像归因强度本身无法稳定区分正确与错误推理轨迹。
summary.importance: 明确了推理衍生信息整合不足（而非视觉接地减弱）是长程多模态推理错误的关键驱动因素，为多模态预训练的推理能力优化提供了新的靶点；提出的无训练记忆机制为推理时增强提供了轻量方案，也为预训练阶段引入推理记忆模块的架构设计提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: TRAM（Trajectory-derived Auxiliary Memory）是一种无需训练的解码增强方法。推理过程中，已完成的推理步骤被在线压缩为紧凑的潜在记忆状态；记忆通过双时间尺度循环流更新：快流响应近期推理内容，慢流保留长程信息，平衡近期敏感度与长程保留能力；记忆通过轻量残差路径注入选定的解码器层，无需修改注意力机制、额外训练或外部验证器。
summary.experiments: 在4个多模态大推理模型变体（含Qwen3-VL-4B、InternVL3.5-4B）、8个覆盖数学、科学、通用视觉推理的基准上测试，TRAM的平均准确率优于原生解码。归因分析验证：正确轨迹对多阶段推理信息的整合范围更广，错误轨迹对累积推理信息的利用更有限，两类轨迹的图像归因强度无稳定差异。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注推理轨迹分析章节的归因实验设计与核心结论，以及方法章节的双时间尺度记忆更新机制，还有实验章节的跨模型泛化结果。预计阅读时间25-30分钟，核心是理解推理衍生信息衰减这一独立于视觉接地损失的问题定位。

summary_en.core_problem: As reasoning trajectories grow longer, multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) lose access to task-specific relations, constraints, and intermediate conclusions derived early in the reasoning process. Existing methods focus exclusively on sustaining grounding to the original input image, but image attribution strength does not consistently distinguish correct from incorrect reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Insufficient integration of reasoning-derived information, not weakened visual grounding, is identified as a key driver of long-horizon multimodal reasoning errors. This reframes the target for optimizing reasoning capabilities in multimodal pretraining, and the training-free memory mechanism informs architecture design of reasoning memory modules in pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRAM (Trajectory-derived Auxiliary Memory) is a training-free decoding enhancement method. During reasoning, completed reasoning steps are consolidated online into a compact latent memory state. The memory is updated via two recurrent streams with different timescales: a fast stream responsive to recent reasoning, and a slow stream that retains information over longer horizons, balancing recent sensitivity and long-range retention. The memory is fed into selected decoder layers via a lightweight residual pathway, requiring no attention mechanism modifications, additional training, parameter updates, or external verifiers.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across four MLRM variants (including Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3.5-4B) and eight visual reasoning benchmarks covering mathematical, scientific, and general reasoning tasks, TRAM achieves higher average accuracy than vanilla decoding. Attribution analysis confirms that correct trajectories show broader integration of information across multiple reasoning stages, while incorrect trajectories have limited use of accumulated reasoning information, with no consistent difference in image attribution between the two groups.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the reasoning trajectory analysis section for attribution experiment design and core findings, the methods section for the dual-timescale memory update mechanism, and the experiments section for cross-model generalization results. Estimated reading time: 25-30 minutes. The core insight is the framing of reasoning-derived information decay as a distinct problem from visual grounding loss.

recommendation.zh: 多模态长推理的记忆设计有参考价值，重点看归因分析部分和辅助记忆通路的实现逻辑，无需复现
recommendation.en: The memory design for long multimodal reasoning is referenceable; focus on the attribution analysis and auxiliary memory pathway implementation, no reproduction required

paper.title: Token Radius Attention for Efficient Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video Diffusion Transformers (VDiTs) enable high-fidelity generation but incur quadratic cost from dense 3D self-attention. Existing head- and block-level sparse methods share computation budgets across queries, overlooking token-specific attention demand. We observe that retained density varies across queries yet correlates log-linearly with attention entropy, while dominant interactions form query-centered neighborhoods with token-dependent radii. Based on these findings, we propose Token Radi

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散Transformer的3D稠密自注意力随token数平方增长，现有稀疏方法在head/block层统一分配计算预算，忽略不同token的注意力需求差异。
summary.importance: 提出训练免费的token级动态稀疏注意力框架，在主流视频生成模型上实现1.5-2x加速且质量损失可控。
summary.technical_approach: 观察到query的注意力保留密度与注意力熵呈对数线性相关，核心交互集中在query中心邻域；将每个query的熵映射为独立token预算，转换为带时序衰减的注意力半径，无需显式key排序；通过融合熵提取、warm-up复用、块稀疏掩码构建降低额外开销。
summary.experiments: 在Wan2.1、Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo共7个文生视频/图生视频配置上测试，仅保留9-19%注意力交互，实现1.56x-2.05x加速，生成质量与原模型相当。

summary_en.core_problem: 3D dense self-attention in video Diffusion Transformers incurs quadratic cost, while existing sparse methods share computation budgets at head/block granularity, ignoring token-specific attention demand.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free token-level dynamic sparse attention framework that delivers 1.5-2x speedup on mainstream video generation models with negligible quality loss.
summary_en.technical_approach: Observes that retained attention density per query correlates log-linearly with attention entropy, and dominant interactions form query-centered neighborhoods; maps per-query entropy to independent token budgets converted to temporally decayed attention radii without explicit key ranking; reduces overhead via fused entropy extraction, warm-up reuse, and block-sparse mask construction.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 7 T2V/I2V configurations of Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo, retains only 9-19% of attention interactions, achieves 1.56x-2.05x speedup with competitive generation quality.

recommendation.zh: 视频生成专用的token级动态稀疏注意力，无排序动态半径的思路可作长上下文LLM稀疏注意力的旁证，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Video-generation-specific token-wise dynamic sparse attention; its ranking-free dynamic radius idea offers minor reference for long-context LLM attention, abstract suffices.

paper.title: Capturing Token Tendencies for Training-Free Token Pruning in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: While visual token pruning is essential for efficient Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), existing training-free methods suffer from a critical limitation: they rely on static, instantaneous heuristics to perform irreversible filtering. This approach ignores the hierarchical nature of MLLMs, where token importance often evolves dynamically rather than remaining fixed across layers. Consequently, tokens essential for deep-layer reasoning are often prematurely discarded by shallow-layer esti

summary.core_problem: 训练免费视觉 token pruning 往往根据浅层瞬时重要性一次性丢 token，导致深层推理才变重要的视觉线索被过早删除。
summary.importance: 贡献是 MLLM 推理效率方法。它提出 token 重要性随层变化的建模视角，对多模态上下文压缩、视觉 token budget 分配和 serving 侧延迟优化有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Trend-aware Pruning，把剪枝从单点打分改成跨层趋势建模。方法跟踪 attention flow 的 momentum，并加入动态校正机制：当某些早期分数低但后续语义重要性上升的 late-blooming tokens 出现时，选择性重新激活，降低不可逆剪枝造成的信息损失。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个实验中验证了该方法相对既有 training-free pruning 的优势，但未给出 MLLM 类型、token 保留率、任务集、baseline 或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Rongrong Ji，他长期从事视觉、多模态与高效模型研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Training-free visual token pruning in MLLMs often drops tokens using shallow, instantaneous importance scores, removing cues that only become important in deeper reasoning layers.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency method for MLLMs. Its useful idea is to treat token importance as a layer-wise trajectory, which matters for multimodal context compression, visual token budgeting, and serving latency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trend-aware Pruning reframes pruning from local score thresholding to temporal trajectory modeling across layers. It tracks the momentum of attention flow and uses dynamic rectification to reactivate late-blooming tokens whose early scores are low but whose semantic importance rises later.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims extensive experiments showing gains over existing training-free pruning methods, but does not provide the MLLM backbones, retention ratios, benchmarks, baselines, or numeric improvements.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Rongrong Ji, known for work on vision, multimodal learning, and efficient models.

recommendation.zh: 只看 late-blooming token 的统计和消融；若现象稳，视觉 token 剪枝不能再只看浅层 saliency。
recommendation.en: Read the late-blooming-token statistics and ablations; if stable, visual pruning should not rely only on shallow saliency.

paper.title: LAST: The Last Query Token Guides Visual Token Pruning for Edge-Cloud Collaborative MLLM Inference
paper.abstract: Multimodal foundation models are reshaping edge-cloud visual intelligence from task-specific feature pipelines into token-based interfaces, where edge devices encode visual inputs into tokens for a general-purpose cloud MLLM. However, dense visual-token sequences increase cloud-side inference costs. Existing pruning methods mainly target centralized inference: vision-driven methods can operate before cloud execution but are typically query-agnostic, whereas query-guided methods often rely on int

summary.core_problem: 降低 edge-cloud 协同 MLLM 推理中视觉 token 上传和云端处理成本，同时保留 query-dependent 的视觉 token 选择能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态推理效率方法。它针对视觉 token pruning 的部署约束：云端模型内部状态不可提前获得，边端又不能承担复杂生成或注意力聚合成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LAST，一个 training-free 的 query-dependent visual token pruning 框架。它在边端使用小型 VLM 作为 guidance proxy，通过最后一个 query token 对视觉 token 的 attention 得到轻量重要性分数，在传输到云端 MLLM 前完成视觉 token 剪枝。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MLLM、边端 VLM、数据集、token 保留率、延迟或准确率变化。实验重点应是与 query-agnostic pruning、依赖目标 MLLM 内部状态的 query-guided pruning、以及需要额外生成的 guidance 方法比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reduces visual-token transmission and cloud-side inference cost in edge-cloud collaborative MLLM serving while preserving query-dependent token selection.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for multimodal LLMs. It addresses a practical deployment constraint: target-cloud MLLM internals are unavailable before transmission, while edge devices cannot afford heavy attention aggregation or auxiliary generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: LAST is a training-free visual-token pruning framework. It uses a compact edge-side VLM as a proxy and derives token importance from the last query token's attention to visual tokens, enabling pruning before sending visual tokens to the cloud MLLM.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the MLLMs, proxy VLMs, datasets, token-retention rates, latency reductions, or accuracy tradeoffs. The relevant comparisons are against query-agnostic pruning, target-internal-state query-guided pruning, and guidance models requiring extra generation.

recommendation.zh: 可略读：最后 query token 做剪枝信号很便宜，关键看 token 保留率-精度曲线是否跨模型稳。
recommendation.en: Skim lightly: the last-query-token signal is cheap; the only real question is whether the retention-accuracy curve transfers across MLLMs.

paper.title: ObjectStream: Latent Objects as Memory Anchors for Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Streaming video understanding requires models to continuously retain useful visual evidence before future questions are known. Existing approaches primarily manage the growing visual context according to token importance, temporal redundancy, or segment-level relevance, but rarely organize evidence around objects that persist and evolve over time. Thus, in this paper, we introduce ObjectStream, a training-free framework that treats latent objects as memory anchors for streaming video understandi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是流式视频理解里的记忆组织问题：视频不断到来、问题何时提出未知、上下文预算有限，模型需要提前决定“保留什么”和“怎么组织这些保留下来的证据”。作者认为，现有 training-free 方法大多围绕 token 重要性、时间冗余或片段级相关性做压缩，但缺少跨时间稳定的对象级组织，因此在需要追踪对象身份、状态变化和交互关系的问题上不够稳。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接相关性不高，它更接近 Video-LLM 推理时的记忆管理方法，而不是预训练目标、数据或训练 recipe 的创新。不过它有一个可借鉴的点：作者把“对象”当作长期记忆锚点，而不是把历史视觉 token 平铺存储。这种 object-centric memory 视角，对原生视频模型、长上下文多模态模型、甚至视觉 tokenizer 设计都有启发。若关心统一多模态模型在长时序输入上的表示压缩，这篇可以作为思路参考，但不属于必须精读的预训练论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是一个 training-free、plug-and-play 的流式记忆框架，直接建立在冻结的 Video-LLM 表示上，不改底层模型。核心由三部分组成。

第一部分是 Latent Object-Anchored Memory。作者不依赖外部 detector 或 segmentation model，而是从冻结模型的 patch-level visual tokens 中诱导出空间上连贯的“latent objects”，再把跨帧相似的对象关联起来，形成持久的 memory anchors。这样做的目的，是把长视频中的历史信息从“按时间堆叠的 token”改成“按对象维护的状态轨迹”。

第二部分是 Object-Conditioned Temporal Residuals。仅保留对象主轨迹还不够，因为很多关键证据是短暂变化，比如物体突然出现、姿态切换、交互发生。作者因此额外保存围绕对象级突变的残差信息，用来补足长期对象记忆对瞬时事件的压缩损失。

第三部分是 Recent Visual Grounding Window。对象历史适合长期追踪，但回答当前问题时还需要最近的原始视觉上下文做 grounding，因此系统保留一个近期窗口，避免过度抽象后丢失即时细节。

整体上，这是一个三层记忆结构：持久对象历史、短时变化残差、最近视觉窗口。和常见的 token pruning、frame selection、segment memory 相比，它的区别不在压得更狠，而在组织方式从 token-centric 变成 object-centric。作者强调 latent objects 完全来自模型内部表征，这一点让方法具备较好的可插拔性。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖在线流式和离线长视频两类场景，底座模型主要展示在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上。在线流式评测中，ObjectStream 相比基线在 OVO-Bench 的 Real-Time Visual Perception 上提升 10.0 分，在 Backward Tracing 上提升 4.9 分，在 StreamingBench 上提升 2.9 分。这个结果说明对象锚点式记忆对“实时感知”和“回溯追踪”都有效，尤其对需要沿时间找对象证据的问题更明显。

离线长视频评测里，作者声称在丢弃 82.5% 视觉 token 的情况下，仍能超过 full-token baseline。这个结果的意义在于：它不是单纯用更多计算换更好效果，而是在强压缩下仍保持甚至提升性能，说明记忆组织方式确实比原始 token 堆叠更有效。

从消融角度看，三部分组件各自对应不同能力：对象锚点负责长期一致性，temporal residuals 负责突发变化，recent window 负责即时 grounding。若只保留其中一部分，性能会掉，说明这不是单一压缩技巧，而是针对不同时间尺度的信息做分工。全文没有把重点放在训练细节，因为方法本身不需要训练；实验价值主要在于展示“冻结模型 + 更好的记忆结构”可以带来稳定收益。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读。先看引言和 Figure 2，把三层记忆结构理解清楚：object anchors、temporal residuals、recent window 分别解决什么问题。然后看方法部分里 latent object 的构造和跨帧关联方式，这是全文最关键的设计。实验部分重点看两类 benchmark：OVO-Bench 的实时感知/回溯追踪，以及离线长视频上的 token efficiency。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要内容。

如果你主要做预训练，不必深挖全部实现细节；更值得留意的是它背后的表示假设：冻结 Video-LLM 的 patch token 已经隐含了可聚合的对象结构。这一点和 object-centric tokenizer、视频离散化、长时记忆压缩都有潜在联系。若你做 streaming inference 或长视频 VLM，这篇的图表和消融值得仔细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a memory-organization problem in streaming video understanding. In a streaming setting, frames arrive continuously, future questions are unknown, and memory is bounded. Existing training-free methods mostly decide which tokens, frames, or segments to keep, but they do not organize retained evidence around persistent objects. That becomes a weakness when the question requires tracking object identity, state changes, or interactions over time.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to core pretraining research is limited. This is primarily an inference-time memory framework for Video-LLMs, not a new pretraining objective, data recipe, or scaling result. Still, there is one useful idea for foundation-model researchers: long-horizon visual memory may be better organized around object-like latent units than around raw token history. That object-centric view could matter for future work on native video models, multimodal long-context systems, and visual tokenization. It is a useful skim for representation and memory design, but not a must-read pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ObjectStream is a training-free, plug-and-play memory framework built on frozen Video-LLM representations. It does not modify the backbone model. The method has three components.

The first is Latent Object-Anchored Memory. Instead of storing historical visual tokens as a flat sequence, the method induces spatially coherent latent object candidates directly from patch-level features of the frozen model, links corresponding objects across frames, and maintains their histories under a memory budget. The goal is to convert long video memory from token-centric storage into object-centric trajectories.

The second is Object-Conditioned Temporal Residuals. Persistent object histories alone can miss short-lived but important events, such as abrupt appearance changes or interactions. To address that, the method stores residual evidence around object-level changes, preserving transient information that would otherwise be compressed away.

The third is a Recent Visual Grounding Window. Object histories are useful for long-term tracking, but answering current questions still requires access to recent raw visual context. The grounding window keeps the latest observations so the model can remain visually grounded without relying only on abstracted memory.

So the design is a three-part memory system: persistent object histories, transient change residuals, and recent visual context. Compared with token pruning, frame selection, or segment-level memory, the main difference is not just stronger compression but a different organizing principle. The method is also notable for avoiding external detectors or segmentation models; the object-like units are induced from the model’s own latent space.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover both online streaming and offline long-video understanding, with Qwen2.5-VL-7B as the main backbone. On streaming benchmarks, ObjectStream improves Real-Time Visual Perception on OVO-Bench by 10.0 points, Backward Tracing by 4.9 points, and StreamingBench by 2.9 points. The gains are especially consistent with the paper’s claim that object-anchored memory helps when evidence must be traced over time.

On offline long-video benchmarks, the method reportedly surpasses the full-token baseline while discarding 82.5% of visual tokens. That is the most important efficiency result: performance is maintained or improved under aggressive token reduction, suggesting that better memory organization can outperform brute-force retention of raw visual tokens.

The ablations support the division of labor among the three components. Object anchors handle long-term consistency, temporal residuals preserve abrupt changes, and the recent window supports immediate grounding. Removing any one of them hurts performance, which indicates that the method is not a single compression trick but a multi-timescale memory design. Since the framework is training-free, the experimental contribution is mainly about showing that frozen models can benefit substantially from better memory structure.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and the main framework figure to understand the three memory components and why each exists. Then read the method section on latent object induction and cross-frame association, since that is the core design choice. In the experiments, focus on the OVO-Bench results for real-time perception and backward tracing, and on the token-efficiency results in offline long-video evaluation. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea.

If your main focus is pretraining, you do not need every implementation detail. The more interesting takeaway is the representation assumption behind the method: frozen Video-LLM patch tokens already contain enough structure to recover object-like units. That connects naturally to object-centric tokenization, video discretization, and long-horizon memory compression.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法图和记忆更新规则；对象锚点比 token saliency 更像可扩展视频记忆，但证据强度要看完整实验。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and memory update rule; object anchors look more scalable than token saliency, but the claim depends on full experiments.

paper.title: Thinking Once Is Enough: Intermediate-Layer Evidence Routing for High-Resolution VQA
paper.abstract: High-resolution visual question answering (HR-VQA) is often treated as a problem of insufficient evidence acquisition, where failing multimodal large language models must inspect images again through cropping, re-encoding, or multi-round search. We show that this view is incomplete: in many cases, fine-grained evidence has already survived visual encoding and become identifiable and influential within an intermediate-layer routing window, but is later diluted before answer generation. We propose

summary.core_problem: 高分辨率 VQA 中，细粒度视觉证据在中间层已可识别但在答案生成前被稀释，现有方法依赖裁剪、重编码或多轮搜索来重新获取证据。
summary.importance: 提出证据稀释而非证据获取不足才是 HR-VQA 瓶颈的观点，并给出无需训练、单次视觉编码的路由方案；属于方法创新和对 MLLM 层间信息流的机制观察。
summary.technical_approach: Thinking-Once 在中间层路由窗口重建问题条件注意力，保留核心实体 token 和紧凑背景上下文，将证据直接路由到后续层，避免额外视觉编码；training-free，单次 forward。
summary.experiments: 在 5 个基模型上验证，V*Bench 平均 +3.1，HRBench-4K +3.0，HRBench-8K 有提升（摘要截断）；均匹配或超过对应 base 设置。

summary_en.core_problem: In high-resolution VQA, fine-grained visual evidence is already identifiable in intermediate layers but gets diluted before answer generation; existing methods rely on cropping, re-encoding, or multi-round search to reacquire it.
summary_en.importance: Frames evidence dilution rather than insufficient acquisition as the key bottleneck and offers a training-free, single-visual-pass routing solution; a methodological innovation with a mechanistic observation about inter-layer information flow in MLLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Thinking-Once reconstructs question-conditioned attention at an intermediate-layer routing window, preserves core entity tokens and compact background context, and routes this evidence to later layers without extra visual encoding; training-free, single forward pass.
summary_en.experiments: Across five base models, improves or matches base settings: +3.1 on V*Bench, +3.0 on HRBench-4K, and gains on HRBench-8K (abstract truncated).

recommendation.zh: 中间层证据稀释的观察对 MLLM 表征分析有参考价值，但方法是推理时 VQA trick，与预训练无直接关系；知道结论即可，不必读方法细节。
recommendation.en: The intermediate-layer dilution observation is mildly useful for MLLM representation analysis, but the method is an inference-time VQA trick with no pretraining relevance; know the finding, skip the method details.

paper.title: SepPrune:A Separator-based Pruning Framework for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
