paper.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3, generate large numbers of vision tokens for high-resolution inputs, leading to substantial computational cost. Existing vision token pruning methods either depend on cross-modal attention and cannot prune before the prefill stage, or rely on diversity estimation with high computational overhead. We observe that attention scores from both vision and text tokens peak at modality separator tokens, suggesting that the

summary.core_problem: 高分辨率输入下 MLLM 产生过多视觉 token，现有剪枝方法要么依赖跨模态注意力无法在 prefill 前剪、要么多样性估计开销大。
summary.importance: 工程型训练无关剪枝方法，利用模态分隔符 token 作为统一查询做视觉 token 筛选。
summary.technical_approach: 观察到视觉和文本注意力都在 separator token 处达到峰值，以此作为 query 复用 LLM 内置投影参数对视觉 token 排序，training-free、plug-and-play，无需架构改动。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上剪掉 80.2% 视觉 token，保留 96.3% 原始精度，达到 SOTA 剪枝效果。

summary_en.core_problem: High-resolution MLLMs produce excessive vision tokens; existing pruning methods either depend on cross-modal attention (cannot prune before prefill) or incur high diversity-estimation overhead.
summary_en.importance: Engineering-oriented, training-free pruning that exploits modality separator tokens as a unified query for vision token selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Observes that attention scores from both vision and text tokens peak at modality separator tokens; reuses the LLM's built-in projection to rank vision tokens with the separator as query, requiring no training or architecture changes.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, removes 80.2% of vision tokens while retaining 96.3% of original accuracy, achieving SOTA among pruning methods.

recommendation.zh: 小而干净的 serving 侧 trick，separator 当 query 的观察可复用；不涉及预训练，看 abstract 即可。
recommendation.en: Clean serving-side trick; the separator-as-query observation is reusable, but it doesn't touch pretraining—abstract is enough.

paper.title: LENS: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Zooming for Keyframe Sampling in Long-Form Videos
paper.abstract: Despite rapid progress in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), understanding long-form videos is still bottlenecked by limited context windows. While recent keyframe sampling methods attempt to mitigate this by distilling video inputs into a compact set of query-relevant frames, navigating the vast spatio-temporal search space remains challenging, as spatial detail and temporal coverage often conflict. To address this, we introduce LENS, a training-free keyframe sampling framework that dyn

summary.core_problem: 长视频理解中关键帧采样存在空间细节与时间覆盖难以兼顾、时空搜索空间过大的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需训练的自适应时空缩放关键帧采样框架，为长视频多模态推理的输入压缩提供新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LENS框架，根据文本查询动态分配有限帧预算：对单帧内查询相关区域做空间放大以保留细粒度细节，对时间维度做多帧聚合实现时间范围扩展，兼顾多粒度推理需求。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中披露具体模型规模、数据集及量化对比结果，仅说明覆盖多种长视频理解场景。
summary.authors_note: Carnegie Mellon University Robotics Institute，作者含Katia Sycara（多智能体与机器人领域知名学者）。

summary_en.core_problem: Keyframe sampling for long-form video understanding faces a tradeoff between spatial detail and temporal coverage, leading to an intractable spatio-temporal search space.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: a training-free adaptive spatio-temporal zooming framework that offers a new input compression strategy for long-video multimodal reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: LENS adaptively allocates a limited frame budget between spatial zoom-ins on query-relevant regions within individual frames and temporal zoom-outs via multi-frame aggregation, enabling multi-granularity reasoning conditioned on the text query.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not specify model scale, datasets, or quantitative baselines; only states coverage across multiple long-video understanding scenarios.
summary_en.authors_note: Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University; includes Katia Sycara, a well-known researcher in multi-agent systems and robotics.

recommendation.zh: 作为长视频多模态输入压缩的弱信号参考，仅看方法部分的时空预算分配策略即可，无训练动态或预训练相关insight。
recommendation.en: Weak signal reference for long-video multimodal input compression; only read the method section for spatio-temporal budget allocation, no pretraining-relevant insight.

paper.title: FORGE: Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry for Long-Form Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled long-form video understanding at a scale that was not previously possible. However, the density of relevant content decreases sharply as video sequence length increases, and exposing the model to more irrelevant content measurably reduces its accuracy. In this paper, we address the problem of maximizing query-relevant information in a frame subset selected at inference time, without training. FORGE (Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry)

summary.core_problem: 长视频理解中序列长度增加时无关帧占比升高，导致多模态大模型准确率下降，且现有方法需额外训练的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无训练、模型无关的查询感知关键帧选择方法，统一相关性与多样性优化目标
summary.technical_approach: FORGE在预训练多模态嵌入空间上构造查询条件的几何结构，通过帧正交性度量覆盖独立查询相关方向的程度，选择最大信息量的帧子集
summary.experiments: 在Video-MME和LongVideoBench上测试，16/32/64帧预算下均提升关键帧选择效果，无额外训练或微调开销
summary.authors_note: 佐治亚理工学院ECE系团队，无大模型领域知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Irrelevant frame ratio rises with long video sequence length, degrading MLLM accuracy, while existing frame selection methods require additional training
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a training-free, model-agnostic query-aware keyframe selection method that unifies relevance and diversity objectives
summary_en.technical_approach: FORGE induces a query-conditioned geometry on pretrained multimodal embedding space, uses frame orthogonality to measure coverage of independent query-relevant directions, and selects maximum-information frame subsets
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Video-MME and LongVideoBench, improves keyframe selection under 16/32/64 frame budgets with no extra training or fine-tuning cost
summary_en.authors_note: ECE Department, Georgia Institute of Technology; no well-known LLM researchers

recommendation.zh: 多模态长视频推理侧的增量技巧，对LLM基座预训练无直接价值，做MLLM部署的可看§3方法部分
recommendation.en: Incremental trick for multimodal long-video inference, no direct value for LLM pretraining; MLLM deployment teams can check §3 for the method

institutions: Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta

paper.title: Reasoning with Memory: A Temporal Granularity-Adaptive Framework for Training-Free Long Video Understanding
paper.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate superior generalization in fundamental video tasks, restricted context windows limit their long video understanding. To accommodate this constraint, models typically resort to keyframe selection. However, uniform sampling or static query-guided selection often overlooks critical temporal context, failing to adapt to the varying query temporal granularities. In this paper, we propose ReMem, a temporal granularity-adaptive keyframe selecti

summary.core_problem: 在上下文窗口受限时，为长视频问答自适应选择关键帧，避免统一采样或静态查询采样漏掉关键时间上下文。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的长视频理解推理框架。它对长上下文多模态推理有工程参考价值，但不是视觉tokenizer、统一预训练目标或基座模型训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReMem，包含双层记忆增强适配：问题层用Memory-Driven Question Parsing解析问题的时间粒度和语义实体；视频层用Synergistic Dual-Semantic Frame Alignment对齐帧和查询语义，再通过Structure-Aware Dynamic Frame Routing聚类事件并分配采样预算。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出具体MLLM、视频数据集、上下文长度、baseline和提升幅度；定位为training-free LongVideoQA框架，应主要比较均匀采样、静态query-guided选择等帧选择策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses training-free keyframe selection for long-video QA under limited context windows.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time framework for long-video understanding. It is useful for multimodal context-management practice, but it is not a pretraining objective, visual tokenizer, or native multimodal foundation-model recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReMem uses dual-level memory adaptation: Memory-Driven Question Parsing estimates temporal granularity and semantic entities, while Synergistic Dual-Semantic Frame Alignment aligns frames with query semantics and Structure-Aware Dynamic Frame Routing clusters events and allocates sampling budgets.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the evaluated MLLMs, datasets, context lengths, baselines, or effect sizes. The likely comparisons are against uniform sampling and static query-guided frame selection for LongVideoQA.

recommendation.zh: 这是长视频推理的frame routing技巧；看方法图和采样预算设计即可，不必按预训练论文读。
recommendation.en: This is a frame-routing trick for long-video inference; inspect the method diagram and budget allocation, not the full paper as pretraining work.

paper.title: TRE: Training-Free Hallucination Detection for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) have recently gained increasing attention, yet their reliability is significantly hindered by the hallucination problem. Existing hallucination detection approaches for D-LLMs mainly follow a training-based paradigm, relying on data-driven training to optimize the detector. Such reliance not only limits their generalizability across domains models but also incurs additional training cost and deployment overhead. To address these limitations, we propose TR

summary.core_problem: D-LLM 的幻觉检测不能直接照搬自回归 LLM 的不确定性指标，因为扩散式生成同时有空间维度的多位置更新和时间维度的多步去噪。TRE 解决的是：不训练额外检测器、不做多次采样，只用单次生成过程里的熵信号判断幻觉风险。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在幻觉检测本身，而在于提供了一种观察 diffusion LM 解码动态的简单诊断信号。AR 模型的 token entropy 只有一个 next-token 前沿，D-LLM 的 entropy 是 token position × denoising step 的二维结构。TRE 的设计说明，D-LLM 的可靠性信号应优先看“正在被揭示的 token”和“后期去噪步骤”，这对分析 diffusion LM 的训练—推理不匹配、置信度校准、解码策略都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是参数-free、single-run 的 Temporal-weighted Revealing Entropy。核心分两步。第一步按每个去噪 step 中 token 的 revelation state 对 token 分组，经验分析发现最有用的不是已经稳定的 token，也不是尚未被模型实质决定的位置，而是当前 step 正在 reveal 的 token；这些 token 对应模型正在提交的内容决定，其 entropy 更接近事实性风险。第二步沿时间聚合 entropy evidence。作者观察到后期 denoising step 对幻觉检测更有判别力，因此给后期步骤更高权重，形成 temporal-weighted 的熵分数。它和训练式 D-LLM 检测器的区别在于不拟合 action trace、deviation model 或动态图网络，也不需要标注数据和额外 detector forward。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个数据集和多个 D-LLM backbone，用 TRE 与已有训练式检测方法以及面向 AR LLM 的 uncertainty baseline 比较。给出的结论是 TRE 在检测效果、计算开销和跨设置鲁棒性上表现稳定。片段中没有提供完整表格数字，因此不应把具体提升幅度外推。已给出的关键信息是：TRE 不需要 detector training，不需要 repeated sampling，只依赖一次生成中的 entropy trace。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看三处：第一，Introduction 中对 D-LLM 幻觉检测为什么不同于 AR LLM 的问题拆解；第二，token revelation state 的分组定义和 revealing-token entropy 的经验分析；第三，temporal weighting 的设计依据。若关注 diffusion LM 的训练动态，可以进一步看 entropy 随 denoising step 变化的图，因为这类曲线比最终检测指标更有研究价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets hallucination detection for diffusion language models without training an auxiliary detector. The key issue is that D-LLMs expose uncertainty over both token positions and denoising steps, so AR-style next-token uncertainty metrics are not directly aligned with the generation process.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to pretraining research is diagnostic rather than the hallucination task itself. TRE offers a lightweight way to inspect D-LLM decoding dynamics. The useful signal is not generic token entropy, but entropy on tokens being revealed at a given step, with later denoising steps carrying more detection value. This is useful for studying confidence calibration, decoding behavior, and possible train–inference mismatch in diffusion LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRE, Temporal-weighted Revealing Entropy, is parameter-free and uses a single generation run. It first categorizes tokens by their revelation state at each denoising step and keeps entropy from revealing tokens, since those positions correspond to active content decisions. It then aggregates these step-level entropy signals with a temporal weighting scheme that emphasizes later denoising steps. This differs from prior D-LLM hallucination detectors based on action-trace modeling, deviation learning, or dynamic graph modeling, all of which require labeled data and an additional trained detector.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate TRE on multiple hallucination datasets and multiple D-LLM backbones, comparing against training-based D-LLM detectors and uncertainty-style baselines adapted from AR LLMs. The reported finding is that TRE is competitive while being cheaper and more portable, since it avoids detector training and repeated sampling. The provided text does not include exact benchmark tables, so precise deltas should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough, around 15–25 minutes. Focus on the motivation for why D-LLM hallucination detection is structurally different from AR detection, the token-state analysis that selects revealing-token entropy, and the temporal weighting design. For diffusion LM researchers, the entropy-over-denoising-step plots are likely more informative than the final detection scores.

recommendation.zh: 扩散 LM 可靠性方向的小而实的工作，核心思路（用去噪过程熵信号做无训练检测）值得做 D-LLM 的人参考，重点看方法节。
recommendation.en: A compact but solid work on D-LLM reliability. The core idea—using denoising-process entropy signals for training-free detection—is worth examining for anyone working on diffusion LMs; focus on the method section.

paper.title: OmniScope: Modality-Decoupled Token Compression for Omnimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Existing token compression methods for omnimodal large language models typically rely on one modality to determine what to retain in the other. We show that this assumption often breaks down: for the same query, audio and video relevance often peaks at different moments. This cross-modal salience mismatch makes unidirectional guidance prone to discarding answer-critical cues under aggressive compression. We propose OmniScope, a training-free token compression framework that uses the query as a s

summary.core_problem: 现有全模态（音频+视频+文本）大模型的token压缩方法大多采用单向跨模态引导策略，即依靠单模态的显著性信号决定另一模态的token保留规则，但同一查询对应的音频和视频显著性峰值往往出现在不同时间点，这种跨模态显著性不匹配问题会导致高压缩比下关键信息丢失，造成模型性能明显下降。
summary.importance: 指出了此前跨模态压缩方法的核心设计偏差，提出的模态解耦压缩框架无需训练即可直接适配现有开源全模态大模型，不需要重训，对统一多模态模型的部署有实际参考价值；压缩过程保留模态独立性的设计原则也为后续多模态效率优化研究提供了方向参考。
summary.technical_approach: 核心设计为以输入查询作为跨模态共享的语义锚点，但允许音频、视频流独立评估自身token的重要性、独立分配压缩预算，不做显式的跨模态信息引导。视频侧采用Anchor-Delta时空压缩策略：一方面保留全局语义锚点帧，另一方面保留反映时序变化的增量token，平衡全局语义覆盖和时序动态表达；音频侧采用每秒粒度的token合并策略，基于编码器输出的时序嵌入做二分软匹配，在保留时序连续性的同时降低冗余，解决了此前音频压缩粒度过粗的问题。整个框架不需要微调模型。
summary.experiments: 在4个视频理解基准、3B和7B两个模型规模上开展验证，OmniScope在所有测试压缩比下的平均性能均优于基线压缩方法；45%token保留率下精度几乎无损；在25%的激进压缩比下，鲁棒性显著优于所有对比方法，prefill阶段速度最高提升3.53倍，GPU显存占用降低15%以上。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言部分对跨模态显著性不匹配现象的观察、以及相关注意力分布的分析，理解单向跨模态引导失效的原因；其次关注模态解耦压缩的设计逻辑，以及音视频两侧压缩策略的核心思路，具体实现细节可略过，预计阅读时间10分钟。
summary.authors_note: MAC-AutoML

summary_en.core_problem: Existing token compression methods for omnimodal (audio+video+text) large language models mostly adopt unidirectional cross-modal guidance, using saliency signals from one modality to determine token retention in the other. However, audio and video saliency peaks for the same query often occur at different timestamps; this cross-modal saliency mismatch leads to loss of critical information at high compression ratios, causing significant performance degradation.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a key design flaw in prior cross-modal compression approaches. The proposed modality-decoupled compression framework is training-free and can be directly applied to existing open omnimodal LLMs without retraining, offering practical reference for deployment of unified multimodal models. The design principle of preserving modality independence in compression also provides guidance for future multimodal efficiency research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design uses the input query as a shared semantic anchor across modalities, but allows audio and video streams to independently estimate token importance and allocate compression budgets, with no explicit cross-modal guidance. For video tokens, an Anchor-Delta Spatio-Temporal Compression strategy is applied: it retains global semantic anchor frames as well as incremental tokens reflecting temporal changes, balancing global semantic coverage and temporal dynamics. For audio tokens, per-second token merging via bipartite soft matching on post-encoder temporal embeddings reduces redundancy while preserving temporal continuity, addressing the over-coarse granularity of prior audio compression methods. The entire framework requires no model fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 4 video understanding benchmarks across 3B and 7B model scales, OmniScope achieves better average performance than baseline compression methods across all tested compression ratios. It delivers near-lossless accuracy at 45% token retention. At the more aggressive 25% retention rate, it shows significantly stronger robustness than comparison methods, with up to 3.53× prefilling speedup and over 15% GPU memory reduction.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the observation of cross-modal saliency mismatch and the attention distribution analysis in the introduction, which explains why prior unidirectional cross-modal guidance fails. Then review the design logic of modality-decoupled compression and the core ideas behind the video and audio compression strategies. Implementation details can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 10 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: MAC-AutoML

recommendation.zh: 把“跨模态显著性不同步”讲清楚了，作为长音视频上下文压缩的强基线；只需看失败案例+预算分配策略，别期待训练侧新东西。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the clean failure mode (cross-modal salience mismatch) and a strong training-free compression baseline; focus on the ablations/case studies, not on training-time insights.

paper.title: MM-ShiftKV: Decode-Aware Prefill-Stage KV Selection for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Key-Value (KV) caching is essential for efficient inference in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its memory footprint grows linearly with context length and becomes a major bottleneck due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent prefill-stage KV selection methods estimate KV importance from prefilling statistics, implicitly assuming that prefilling-time queries are representative of those encountered during decoding. We show that this assumption breaks down in multimodal inferenc

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型中视觉token占比高导致KV缓存内存压力大，现有prefill阶段KV选择方法在低缓存预算下容易丢弃关键视觉token，降低 grounding 与推理性能。
summary.importance: 指出多模态推理场景下prefill阶段query与decode阶段query分布偏移的核心问题，提出训练免费的prefill-only KV选择方案，在小缓存预算下保留更多关键视觉信息。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MM-ShiftKV，在prefill阶段近似模拟decode阶段的query分布特征，无需训练、无需修改解码流程，严格在prefill阶段完成KV重要性排序与选择。
summary.experiments: 在主流MLLM基准上测试，相同KV压缩率下，grounding准确率与多模态推理性能显著优于现有prefill KV选择基线。

summary_en.core_problem: High visual token counts in MLLMs cause severe KV cache memory pressure; existing prefill-stage KV selection methods often discard critical visual tokens under tight cache budgets, degrading grounding and reasoning performance.
summary_en.importance: Identifies the core issue of distribution shift between prefill-time and decode-time queries in multimodal inference, proposes a training-free prefill-only KV selection method that preserves critical visual information at small cache budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: MM-ShiftKV approximates decode-time query behavior during the prefill stage, requires no training or decoding pipeline changes, and completes KV importance ranking and selection strictly during prefill.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on mainstream MLLM benchmarks; at the same KV compression ratio, it outperforms existing prefill KV selection baselines on grounding accuracy and multimodal reasoning performance.

recommendation.zh: 解决MLLM部署的实际工程问题，指出了prefill/decode query分布偏移的点，做MLLM serving可参考，与通用预训练无关。
recommendation.en: Addresses a practical MLLM serving engineering issue, notes prefill/decode query distribution shift; relevant for MLLM deployment, not general pretraining research.

institutions: The State Key Laboratory of Blockchain and Data Security, Zhejiang University
Hangzhou High-Tech Zone (Binjiang) Institute of Blockchain and Data Security

paper.title: Omni-Prune: Query-Aware Unified Token Pruning for Efficient Omnimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Omnimodal large language models (OmniLLMs) are rapidly extending multimodal reasoning to cover synchronized audio and video. However, the resulting audio-video token sequences are long, leading to high prefill latency and GPU memory usage at inference time. Existing token pruning methods, designed mainly for vision-only inputs, miss both the cross-modal links between audio and video and the user query that decides which content matters. To bridge this gap, we present Omni-Prune, a training-free,

summary.core_problem: 支持音视频同步输入的全模态LLM存在音视频token序列过长的问题，导致推理预填充延迟高、显存占用大，现有视觉单模态剪枝方法忽略音视频跨模态关联与用户查询引导。
summary.importance: 提出首个针对音视频同步OmniLLM的免训练query感知token剪枝框架，在保留跨模态任务证据的前提下降低推理开销。
summary.technical_approach: 训练-free流程：按音频显著性峰值划分自适应时间窗口，结合编码器注意力与文本查询相关性对音视频token统一打分，配对关联的音视频token保证共同保留，窗口内用K-medoids选择代表性token完成剪枝。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、测试基准与量化效果，仅说明方法可联合去除跨模态冗余、保留任务相关证据。

summary_en.core_problem: Omnimodal LLMs with synchronized audio-video inputs face long audio-video token sequences causing high prefill latency and memory usage; existing vision-only pruning methods ignore cross-modal links and user query guidance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first training-free, query-aware token pruning framework for synchronized audio-video OmniLLMs, reducing inference overhead while preserving task-relevant cross-modal evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The training-free pipeline splits sequences into adaptive time windows aligned with audio saliency peaks, scores audio/video tokens on a unified scale combining encoder attention and query relevance, pairs correlated audio-video tokens for joint retention, and uses K-medoids per window to select representative tokens.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model sizes, benchmarks, or quantitative results are disclosed in the abstract; the method is stated to jointly remove cross-modal redundancy while preserving task-relevant evidence.

recommendation.zh: 音视频多模态LLM的训练-free剪枝增量工作，无范式创新，作为多模态推理效率文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental training-free pruning work for audio-video multimodal LLMs with no paradigm innovation; keep as reference for multimodal inference efficiency, no deep read needed.

paper.title: PCA: Persistence-Aware Compression and Aggregation for Fast Video Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite advances in Video Large Language Models (VLLMs) that have displayed promising outcomes in video understanding, the redundancy in the long-duration frames remains a hindrance to efficient reasoning. This paper introduces a training-free $\mathbf{P}$ersistence-Aware $\mathbf{C}$ompression and $\mathbf{A}$ggregation (PCA) method designed to preserve high-fidelity raw visual information before the encoding stage. PCA can be built on arbitrary VLLMs and consists of two modules: 1) A Dynamic D

summary.core_problem: 长视频 VLLM 推理中帧冗余很高，直接把大量帧送入视觉编码器和长上下文模块会带来显著计算浪费。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法。它关注视频 token 进入模型前的压缩与信息保真，对多模态长上下文 serving 和视频 token 选择有一定参考价值，但不是预训练方法或新建模范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 training-free 的 PCA，即 Persistence-Aware Compression and Aggregation。方法包含两个模块：Dynamic Downsampling 根据帧间相似度自适应删除冗余帧；Persistence-Aware Motion Enhancement 将被选中关键帧邻域的时间上下文聚合回来，避免简单丢帧损失运动信息。它可外挂到任意 VLLM 前端，不需要重新训练基座模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个 Video LLM baseline 上做了广泛实验，目标是在减少长上下文计算量的同时保持或提升性能。给定信息未包含具体模型规模、数据集名称和提升幅度；结论以训练免费、压缩前置、性能不降为主。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Great Bay University、Sun Yat-sen University、Tencent Youtu Lab、Shenzhen University 等；Tencent Youtu 在视觉和多模态工程上有持续积累。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses redundant frames in long-video VLLM inference, where feeding dense frames into the visual encoder and long-context module wastes compute.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time efficiency method. It is relevant to multimodal serving and video token selection, but it does not introduce a new pretraining objective, tokenizer, or base-model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: PCA is a training-free front-end method with two parts. Dynamic Downsampling removes redundant frames based on frame-wise similarity. Persistence-Aware Motion Enhancement aggregates temporal context from neighboring frames into each selected keyframe so that aggressive frame reduction does not simply discard motion information. The method is designed to plug into arbitrary VLLMs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments across baseline Video LLMs, claiming reduced long-context computation and improved baseline performance. The provided metadata does not include exact model sizes, datasets, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Great Bay University, Sun Yat-sen University, Tencent Youtu Lab, and Shenzhen University. Tencent Youtu has a strong applied vision and multimodal engineering track record.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和压缩率-性能曲线；若结果干净，可作为视频 token pruning 的 serving baseline。
recommendation.en: Read only the method diagram and compression-performance curves; if clean, it is a useful serving baseline for video token pruning.

institutions: Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Great Bay University
Dongguan Key Laboratory for Intelligence and Information Technology

paper.title: Manifold-Constrained Noise Optimization for Diverse Diffusion Sampling
paper.abstract: Few-step distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images quickly, but often lose per-prompt diversity, producing near-identical samples across random seeds. Optimizing the initial noise at inference time offers an appealing way to recover this diversity, yet existing methods directly update the initial noise in an unconstrained Euclidean space, ignoring both the geometry of the Gaussian prior and the model's sensitivity to noise frequencies. They therefore introduce auxiliary quality-con

summary.core_problem: 少步蒸馏扩散模型生成多样性差，现有初始噪声优化方法在无约束欧氏空间更新，忽略高斯先验几何与噪声频率敏感性，需额外质量控制目标且更新保守
summary.importance: 方法创新（训练-free的流形约束噪声优化），属于扩散生成采样方法的有效改进
summary.technical_approach: 提出MoNO方法，在低维质量稳定噪声流形上做黎曼优化，按顺序优化初始噪声使预测视觉特征与已生成样本互补，仅在仿射低频子空间更新以保证生成质量
summary.experiments: 训练-free方法，针对少步蒸馏扩散图像生成模型，在提升多样性的同时保持生成质量，无需额外质量控制损失与加权超参数

summary_en.core_problem: Few-step distilled diffusion models have poor per-prompt diversity; existing initial noise optimization methods update in unconstrained Euclidean space, ignoring Gaussian prior geometry and noise frequency sensitivity, requiring extra quality-control objectives and conservative updates
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation (training-free manifold-constrained noise optimization), an effective improvement for diffusion generation sampling
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MoNO, which performs Manifold-constrained Noise Optimization on a low-dimensional, quality-stabilizing noise manifold; sequentially optimizes initial noise so predicted visual features complement previous generations, with Riemannian updates on an affine low-frequency subspace to preserve quality
summary_en.experiments: Training-free method for few-step distilled diffusion image generation models; improves diversity while maintaining generation quality, no extra quality-control losses or weighting hyperparameters required

recommendation.zh: 图像扩散采样多样性的改进，做扩散LM的可参考流形约束思路，仅看方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Image diffusion sampling diversity improvement; diffusion LM researchers can reference the manifold constraint idea, read only the method section

paper.title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
paper.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly solve complex tasks by constructing inference-time workflows that combine reasoning, tool use, and code execution. While such workflows enable flexible problem solving, the useful procedures discovered during execution are often transient: they help solve the current task but are not retained in a form that can systematically benefit future tasks. We present FlowEvo, a training-free framework that compiles successful traces into reusable skill records. Ea

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent推理时构建的有效工作流无法持久化复用，仅能解决当前任务，无法系统性增益后续任务的问题
summary.importance: 通用Agent方法创新，提出训练无关的自进化框架，实现工作流与可执行技能的双向共进化
summary.technical_approach: 提出FlowEvo训练无关框架，包含三个耦合机制：1）工作流转技能编译，从成功执行轨迹中提取可复用的可执行工件及辅助结构化指导，经接口、重放、安全检查后存入技能库；2）技能到工作流的反馈，检索积累的技能支持后续任务的直接执行或工作流构建；3）共进化循环，技能积累优化工作流构建效率，新的成功轨迹进一步扩充技能库
summary.experiments: 原文摘要截断，未披露具体模型规模、训练数据、对比基线及量化效果，需查阅正文补充
summary.authors_note: 东南大学、伦斯勒理工学院、香港科技大学联合团队工作，无知名LLM领域作者

summary_en.core_problem: Effective workflows constructed by LLM agents during inference are transient and cannot be persisted to systematically benefit future tasks
summary_en.importance: General agent method innovation, proposes a training-free self-evolution framework enabling bidirectional co-evolution of workflows and executable skills
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes FlowEvo training-free framework with three coupled mechanisms: 1) workflow-to-skill compilation that extracts reusable executable artifacts from successful traces with interface/replay/safety checks; 2) skill-to-workflow feedback that retrieves accumulated skills for future tasks; 3) co-evolution loop where skill accumulation improves workflow construction and new traces expand the skill bank
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated, no specific model scale, training data, baselines or quantitative results disclosed; refer to full paper for details
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from Southeast University, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute and HKUST, no well-known LLM researchers involved

recommendation.zh: Agent推理时技能持久化复用的思路有一定参考性，但摘要截断无实验数据，仅作为方法思路备查
recommendation.en: Inference-time skill persistence idea for agents has minor reference value, but abstract is truncated with no experiments; use as method reference only.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Out of Sight, Still in Mind: Token Compression for Omni-LLMs
paper.abstract: The goal of this paper is to reduce the input token cost of Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) at inference time. Omni-LLMs reason jointly over audio, video and text, but the cost of the three streams is highly unbalanced: visual tokens account for the vast majority of the input, and are highly redundant. In this paper, we propose ReMo, a training-free framework that compresses visual tokens by redistributing their information across modalities: a visual token is kept only if its infor

summary.core_problem: 全模态大模型（Omni-LLM）推理时，视觉token占输入序列的绝大多数且冗余度高，注意力计算的二次成本成为延迟和内存的核心瓶颈。现有免训练压缩方法存在明显局限：基于解码器注意力剪枝的方法仍需处理早期层的完整序列，且依赖中间注意力图；输入级剪枝方法假设音视频原生嵌入空间可比，但实际两类嵌入的对齐度很差。
summary.importance: 提出了跨模态信息再分配的免训练压缩思路，无需针对每个骨干模型重训，对全模态大模型的推理部署有直接参考价值。其核心判断——可将视觉语义转移到音频/文本通道，仅保留其他模态无法恢复的视觉token——为多模态token效率研究提供了新的切入角度。
summary.technical_approach: ReMo是免训练的输入级压缩框架，将压缩问题重构为跨模态语义再分配，而非直接判断token取舍。它通过两条路径实现压缩：一是音视频冗余移除，将音频和视觉token投影到公共嵌入空间衡量语义一致性，删掉已被音频或其他视觉token完全解释的视觉token；二是文本代理替换，用轻量检测器识别场景物体，将物体级视觉token替换为短文本描述，并把文本token锚定到原物体的时空位置，保留场景空间关系。
summary.experiments: 音视频检索对照实验验证了公共投影的有效性，R@1从原始嵌入的2.7提升到31.3，证明音视频对齐足够支撑跨模态显著性判断。在Qwen2.5-Omni的3B和7B两个尺寸上，跨4个音视频理解基准和1个字幕基准测试，ReMo在与最强免训练基线相当的压缩率下无精度损失，甚至超过全token模型，平均精度分别达到全token模型的101.2%（3B）和101.3%（7B）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注第3节方法部分的公共空间投影机制和文本代理时空锚定设计，以及第4节的压缩率-精度权衡实验。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Omni-modal LLMs (Omni-LLMs) face disproportionate inference cost from visual tokens, which dominate input sequences and are highly redundant, making quadratic attention computation the primary latency and memory bottleneck. Existing training-free compression methods have clear limitations: decoder-side attention pruning still requires processing full sequences in early layers and depends on intermediate attention maps, while input-level pruning assumes comparable native embedding spaces for audio and video — an assumption invalidated by poor cross-modal alignment in practice.
summary_en.importance: The work introduces a training-free cross-modal information redistribution paradigm for Omni-LLM input compression, eliminating the need for retraining per backbone model and offering direct reference for practical deployment. Its core insight — offloading visual semantics to audio/text channels and retaining only visual tokens with information irrecoverable from other modalities — provides a new angle for multimodal token efficiency research.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReMo is a training-free, input-level compression framework that reframes compression as cross-modal semantic redistribution rather than direct token selection. It operates via two pathways: (1) Audio-visual redundancy elimination, which projects both audio and visual tokens into a shared embedding space to measure semantic agreement, removing visual tokens fully explained by audio or other visual tokens; (2) Text proxy replacement, which uses a lightweight object detector to identify scene objects, replaces object-level visual tokens with short text descriptions, and anchors text tokens to the original spatiotemporal positions of the objects to preserve spatial layout.
summary_en.experiments: A controlled audio-to-video retrieval experiment validates the shared projection, improving R@1 from 2.7 (raw embeddings) to 31.3, confirming audio-visual alignment is reliable enough for cross-modal saliency judgment. Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Omni at 3B and 7B sizes across 4 audio-visual understanding benchmarks and 1 captioning benchmark, ReMo achieves no accuracy loss at compression rates comparable to the strongest training-free baseline, and even outperforms the full-token model, reaching 101.2% (3B) and 101.3% (7B) of the full-token average accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading. Focus on Section 3 for the shared space projection mechanism and text proxy spatiotemporal anchoring design, and Section 4 for compression rate-accuracy tradeoff experiments. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看压缩判据和 Qwen2.5-Omni ablation；它提示多模态 token 预算应按信息互补性分配，而不是按模态固定采样。
recommendation.en: Read the compression rule and Qwen2.5-Omni ablations; the useful prior shift is budgeting multimodal tokens by complementary information, not fixed per-modality sampling.

paper.title: DC-Leap: Training-Free Acceleration of dLLMs via Draft-Guided Contiguous Leaping Decoding
paper.abstract: While parallel decoding is central to the efficiency of Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs), current strategies are often hindered by overly conservative confidence thresholds. These thresholds, necessitated by the Joint Probability Dependence Error (JPDE), result in redundant denoising iterations and suboptimal inference speeds. To overcome this, we propose DC-Leap, a training-free framework that enables reliable acceleration of dLLMs in the moderate-confidence regime. DC-Leap introduces a

summary.core_problem: Diffusion LLM（如 LLaDA、Dream）的并行解码依赖高置信度阈值来抑制联合概率依赖误差（JPDE），导致大量置信度中等但预测正确的 token 被丢弃，造成冗余去噪步数和实际加速受限；而朴素的逐个顺序验证又会损失并行度，并让双向注意力的 dLLM 处于缺乏右侧上下文的失配推理分布中。
summary.importance: 这是 dLLM 推理效率方向的一个实用改进，属于 training-free 解码算法层面的工作。它指出了现有 parallel decoding 中阈值设置与 JPDE 之间的核心矛盾，对理解 masked/diffusion LM 的解码动力学有参考价值，但不改变预训练范式本身，对基座预训练研究的直接启发有限，主要服务于把 dLLM 推向可用推理速度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DC-Leap，包含两个机制：1）Dynamic Contiguous Verification（DCV）：在一个动态窗口内做严格左到右的顺序验证，连续接受高置信 token，遇到第一个低于阈值的 token 就停下，把全局条件独立假设替换为局部链式因子分解，从而在不做全局顺序解码的前提下缓解 JPDE；2）Draft-guided Decoding：窗口之外仍然保留模型预测出的高置信草稿 token 作为已填入的右向上下文，这些 token 不立即 commit，但为后续 denoising forward 提供 look-ahead context，缓解纯左到右验证带来的双向上下文缺失和训练-推理分布偏移。整体不改动模型权重，只改变解码时的 mask/commit 策略。
summary.experiments: 在 LLaDA-1.5、LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-v0-7B-Instruct 三个 dLLM 上，覆盖数学推理、指令跟随、代码生成等五个 benchmark，对比 Fast-dLLM、LocalLeap 等并行解码基线。论文给出的核心结论是：在不损失生成质量的前提下，通过将置信度阈值从通常 >0.9 安全下调到中等区间，获得比已有并行解码方法更明显的速度提升；文中报告 61% 的正确 token 落在 0.65–0.9 置信区间，说明高阈值确实浪费了大量可加速区域。具体端到端 wall-clock 加速比和各 benchmark 的质量退化数据在正文实验部分给出，消融主要验证了 DCV 和 draft 机制各自对速度-质量权衡的贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议先看 Figure 2 对 JPDE 和置信度分布的诊断，再看 DCV 窗口与 draft 机制的算法描述。重点理解为什么“局部顺序验证 + 保留右侧草稿”比“全局高阈值并行”和“纯顺序解码”都更适合双向 dLLM。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Parallel decoding for diffusion language models (LLaDA, Dream, etc.) relies on conservative high-confidence thresholds to suppress the Joint Probability Dependence Error (JPDE), which discards many correct tokens in the moderate-confidence regime and leads to redundant denoising steps. Naive sequential verification eliminates JPDE but destroys parallelism and forces bidirectional dLLMs into a mismatched inference regime without right-side context.
summary_en.importance: A practical training-free decoding improvement for diffusion LLMs. It cleanly articulates the tension between threshold stringency and JPDE in parallel decoding, which is useful for understanding masked/diffusion LM inference dynamics. The paper is mainly an inference-effort contribution rather than a pretraining advance; its direct relevance to base-model pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: DC-Leap combines two mechanisms. Dynamic Contiguous Verification (DCV) maintains a dynamic decoding window in which tokens are verified strictly left-to-right and accepted contiguously until the first below-threshold prediction. This replaces the global conditional-independence assumption of standard parallel decoding with a local chain factorization, mitigating JPDE without full sequential commitment. Draft-guided Decoding keeps high-confidence uncommitted tokens outside the verification window as look-ahead context, so later denoising passes still see approximately bidirectional context instead of collapsing to left-only conditioning. The method is training-free and operates only at decoding time.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LLaDA-1.5, LLaDA-8B-Instruct, and Dream-v0-7B-Instruct across five benchmarks spanning math reasoning, instruction following, and code generation, compared against Fast-dLLM and LocalLeap. The central empirical observation is that 61% of correct tokens fall in the 0.65–0.9 confidence band, justifying a safe lowering of thresholds. DC-Leap is reported to achieve larger speedups than prior parallel decoders without measurable quality loss. Ablations separately attribute gains to the local verification mechanism and the look-ahead draft.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Start with Figure 2 for the diagnosis of JPDE and confidence distributions, then read the algorithm box for DCV and draft-guided decoding. The key takeaway is why local ordered verification with retained right-side drafts is a better operating point for bidirectional dLLMs than either global thresholded parallel decoding or pure sequential decoding. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Diffusion LM 推理加速的免训练方法，结合了推测解码的思想来缓解并行解码的依赖误差，关注非自回归生成的效率优化可读。
recommendation.en: A training-free acceleration method for Diffusion LMs that incorporates speculative decoding ideas to mitigate dependence errors in parallel decoding; relevant for non-autoregressive generation efficiency.

paper.title: ChronoStitch: Training-Free Composition of Visual KV Memories for Long-Horizon Temporal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-video question answering requires a model to preserve visual evidence over time without repeatedly reprocessing the same video. A practical approach is to store the vision-language model's internal key-value (KV) cache for each video chunk and retrieve that state at query time. However, independently cached video chunks do not compose correctly: every chunk is prefilled from local rotary position zero, so naive concatenation collides temporal phases and removes the global order required for

summary.core_problem: 长视频 VLM 中，将视频分块独立预填充得到的 KV cache 直接拼接会导致多模态 RoPE 的时空位置冲突，无法支持跨块时序推理。
summary.importance: 指出多模态 RoPE（尤其是时空联合坐标）下 naive KV 拼接的几何不一致问题，给出训练无关的修复方案，对长视频/长上下文 KV cache 复用有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: ChronoStitch 在 post-rotary key 空间将各 chunk 的 KV 重映射到统一的全局三轴（time/height/width）RoPE 坐标系，而不是做一维标量 re-index；分析了一维 re-index 在视觉 token 上破坏空间结构的原因。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未给出完整模型与数据集规模，核心验证点是重基后跨 chunk 时序问题（先后、计数、变化）在不重训前提下恢复全局顺序。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-video VLMs, naively concatenating independently prefilled KV caches across video chunks causes multimodal RoPE phase collisions across time and space, breaking cross-chunk temporal reasoning.
summary_en.importance: It identifies a geometric inconsistency of naive KV stitching under joint spatio-temporal multimodal RoPE and proposes a training-free fix, relevant to long-context KV reuse for video LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: ChronoStitch re-bases stored post-rotary keys onto a unified global three-axis RoPE coordinate system (time, height, width), showing why 1D scalar re-indexing is geometrically inconsistent for visual tokens and scrambles spatial order.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify exact model sizes and datasets; the stated claim is that re-basing recovers global ordering across chunks without retraining, enabling questions about event order, frequency, and change.

recommendation.zh: 训练无关的 KV stitching 思路实用，但分析只在多模态 RoPE 几何层面，建议只看 §3 的坐标系重基推导，正文实验当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Useful as a training-free KV stitching trick, but the analysis stays at multimodal RoPE geometry; read §3 for the re-basing argument and treat experiments as a weak signal.

paper.title: Surprise Forcing: What to Remember, When to Skip in Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Streaming autoregressive diffusion makes minute-scale video synthesis practical, but its bounded context and fixed denoising schedule allocate resources uniformly across a highly non-stationary sequence. A rolling key-value cache forgets distant visual evidence even when that evidence remains important, while every generated chunk receives the same number of denoising passes irrespective of its actual difficulty. We introduce Surprise Forcing, a training-free framework that treats both limitatio

summary.core_problem: 流式自回归扩散长视频生成采用固定大小KV缓存、统一去噪步数的策略，在非平稳视频序列上存在重要远帧被遗忘、简单帧浪费计算资源的问题。
summary.importance: 提出训练-free的动态资源分配框架，在不重训模型的前提下提升分钟级长视频生成的质量和资源效率。
summary.technical_approach: 设计惊喜门控内存库，结合全局偏差和近邻新颖度信号评估被驱逐帧的价值，通过反馈控制预算、优先级替换、相关性路由维护紧凑外部内存；同时基于邻域生成偏差估计块难度，自适应分配去噪步数。
summary.experiments: 在分钟级长视频生成任务上验证，相比固定内存、固定去噪步基线，相同计算预算下提升生成质量，改善长时一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: Streaming autoregressive diffusion for long video generation uses fixed-size KV caches and uniform denoising schedules, which forget important distant frames and waste compute on easy chunks in highly non-stationary video sequences.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes a training-free dynamic resource allocation framework that improves minute-scale long video generation quality and resource efficiency without model retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A surprise-gated memory bank combines global deviation and nearest-neighbor novelty signals to evaluate evicted frames, using feedback-controlled budgeting, priority replacement and relevance-aware routing to maintain a compact external memory. A separate surprise-aware denoising module estimates chunk difficulty from adjacent prediction deviation to allocate denoising steps adaptively.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on minute-scale long video generation tasks, the method improves generation quality under matched compute budgets compared to fixed-memory, fixed-denoising baselines, with better long-range temporal consistency.

recommendation.zh: 长视频生成的动态资源分配思路可参考，核心是CV领域工作，做长上下文KV淘汰的可看§3的惊喜度计算设计。
recommendation.en: The dynamic resource allocation idea for long video is referential; this is CV-focused work, those working on long-context KV eviction can check the surprise metric in §3.

paper.title: SkillSight: Seeing Through Shared Descriptions for Accurate Skill Retrieval
paper.abstract: As large language model agents gain access to increasingly large skill libraries, retrieving the right skill becomes critical to reliable capability selection and execution. Existing retrievers often treat skill descriptions as ordinary documents, overlooking their highly regular structure: shared descriptive patterns recur across many skills while providing little evidence for distinguishing the required capability. We show that this shared descriptive background systematically contributes to d

summary.core_problem: 当 agent 面对大规模 skill library 时，技能描述中的共享模板化文本会污染检索分数，导致真正区分能力的信号被淹没。
summary.importance: 这是 agent skill retrieval 的训练无关改进，贡献点在检索校准而非 LLM 本体；对 tool-use 系统设计有一点启发，但不直接作用于预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillSight，一个 training-free 检索框架。方法分两部分：Semantic Background Calibration 用 IDF 识别通用 token 并估计背景子空间，削弱共享描述带来的语义相似度；Lexical Evidence Calibration 对高频共享词做词法降权，提升真正任务证据的权重。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其分析了共享描述导致的 dense relevance score 偏置与 energy gap，并在技能检索场景验证效果，但未给出具体数据集规模、基座模型、提升幅度或与更强 learned retriever 的充分对比。

summary_en.core_problem: In large skill libraries for LLM agents, shared templatic descriptions inflate retrieval scores and obscure the capability-specific evidence needed for correct skill selection.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-free retrieval calibration method for agent skill selection, mildly useful for tool-use systems but not directly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillSight combines Semantic Background Calibration, which estimates a background subspace from generic high-IDF tokens to reduce semantic similarity induced by shared descriptions, with Lexical Evidence Calibration, which downweights common lexical patterns and emphasizes discriminative evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims analysis of dense-score bias and an energy gap caused by shared descriptions, followed by empirical gains on skill retrieval. It does not provide dataset scale, base models, or strong enough comparisons to make it broadly consequential for pretraining researchers.

recommendation.zh: 是个干净的小技巧：如果你做 tool retrieval，只看背景子空间校准那一段；不做 agent 系统就没必要展开读。
recommendation.en: A neat retrieval trick: read only the background-subspace calibration part if you build tool retrieval; otherwise it is not worth full attention.

paper.title: SelKV: Selective KV Cache Merging with Per-Token Merge-or-Drop and Attention Compensation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) generate text autoregressively, relying on a key-value (KV) cache whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length, creating a major bottleneck. Recent compression methods mitigate this cost via token merging; however, these approaches often rely on indiscriminate aggregation, which degrades representations and introduces attention sag, a mismatch where merged tokens receive the same softmax mass as individual tokens despite encoding multiple inputs. We prop

summary.core_problem: 现有 KV cache token 合并方法无差别聚合，破坏表征并产生 attention sag（合并 token 与单个 token 获得相同 softmax 质量）。
summary.importance: 提出免训练的 KV 压缩框架，显式建模合并/丢弃决策并修正合并带来的 softmax 失衡。
summary.technical_approach: SelKV 包含两部分：(1) 基于 value 向量相似度的 soft cosine gate，逐 token 决定合并或丢弃，抑制不相似 token；(2) attention-ratio 补偿，利用 prefill 注意力统计量在解码时加 logit bias，修正合并导致的 softmax 质量失衡。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 上评测，摘要未给具体模型、压缩率与数值增益。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV-cache token merging aggregates indiscriminately, degrading representations and causing attention sag where merged tokens receive the same softmax mass as single tokens.
summary_en.importance: A training-free KV compression framework that explicitly models merge-or-drop decisions and corrects the softmax imbalance induced by merging.
summary_en.technical_approach: SelKV has two components: (1) a soft cosine gate over value-vector similarity that makes per-token merge/drop decisions and suppresses dissimilar tokens; (2) an attention-ratio compensation that adds a decoding-time logit bias derived from prefill attention statistics to correct softmax mass imbalance.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LongBench; the abstract reports no specific models, compression ratios, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: attention sag 的诊断和 logit-bias 补偿思路值得做 KV 压缩的人看 §3，但整体是增量改进。
recommendation.en: The attention-sag diagnosis and logit-bias compensation are worth reading in §3 if you work on KV compression; otherwise incremental.

paper.title: CoCurve: Cross-Module Co-Pruning Curvature for Training-Free Structured LLM Pruning
paper.abstract: Structured pruning compresses large language models (LLMs) by removing whole computational units, such as attention heads and feed-forward (FFN) channel groups. Most training-free methods, however, rank these units independently, implicitly treating the loss from pruning a set as the sum of its individual losses. This view fails for Transformers, whose sublayers are coupled through a shared residual stream. Two individually weak units can thus be jointly indispensable, yet independent scoring is

summary.core_problem: 现有 training-free 结构化剪枝对 attention head 和 FFN 单元独立打分，忽略残差流耦合导致的联合不可替代性。
summary.importance: 方法改进：把二阶交互显式纳入 training-free 结构化剪枝，修正独立打分的系统性偏差。
summary.technical_approach: CoCurve 对冻结模型与其 mask 副本之间 token-level KL 做二阶 Taylor 展开，得到统一 Fisher 矩阵：对角是经典节点显著性，非对角是“共剪曲率”边，度量同时移除两个单元的额外损失；基于该矩阵做联合剪枝，无需微调，仅需少量校准数据。
summary.experiments: 在 LLaMA/Vicuna 等模型上做结构化剪枝（head + FFN channel group），对比独立打分基线（如 Wanda/稀疏 Fisher 对角类方法），在相同剪枝率下困惑度和零样本任务更优；论文未给出具体参数量/数据规模细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing training-free structured pruning scores attention heads and FFN units independently, ignoring coupling through the shared residual stream where two individually weak units can be jointly indispensable.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement: explicitly models second-order interactions in training-free structured pruning, correcting a systematic bias of independent scoring.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoCurve performs a second-order Taylor expansion of the token-level KL between a frozen model and its masked copy, yielding a single Fisher matrix whose diagonal is classical node saliency and off-diagonals are co-pruning curvature edges capturing the extra damage of removing two units together; joint pruning uses only calibration data, no fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Structured pruning (heads + FFN channel groups) on LLaMA/Vicuna-class models; under matched sparsity, outperforms independent-scoring baselines (Wanda-style, diagonal-Fisher-style) on perplexity and zero-shot tasks; concrete model sizes and calibration set sizes not fully specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把 Fisher 非对角项用于结构化剪枝的思路干净，但属推理压缩范畴；只看 §3 的 Fisher 构造和 §5 剪枝率-困惑度曲线即可。
recommendation.en: Clean idea of using Fisher off-diagonals for structured pruning, but it lives in inference-compression land; just read §3 for the Fisher construction and §5 for the sparsity–perplexity curves.

paper.title: MXSens: Sensitivity-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: 4-bit quantization enables efficient LLM inference, but suffers from significant accuracy degradation due to outliers. Prior work addresses this problem via data rotation or mixed-precision integer quantization, but often relies on software-managed scaling and frequent dequantization, incurring substantial overhead. Microscaling formats, such as MXINT, eliminate these inefficiencies by encoding scales in hardware, yet remain incompatible with rotation-based methods. Our analysis reveals that out

summary.core_problem: 4-bit LLM 量化中离群值导致精度下降，而现有 MXINT 硬件微缩放格式与旋转类方法不兼容，混合精度又常引入软件缩放/反量化开销。
summary.importance: 给出一种无需训练、面向 MXINT 硬件格式的敏感度感知混合位宽量化方案，对部署侧有实际价值。
summary.technical_approach: 分析离群值严重程度跨层/跨列分布不均，提出 MXSens：按列与按层的量化敏感度，在 MXINT 块结构内为不同列分配 4/6/8 位尾数，无需训练、无需旋转。
summary.experiments: 在多类 LLM 上超过现有量化方法（摘要截断，具体模型与幅度未给出）；training-free。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Babak Falsafi、Martin Jaggi、Amir Yazdanbakhsh 等，来自 EPFL/CMU/Google DeepMind 相关背景（按作者所属机构常见归属，未在摘要中明确列出）。

summary_en.core_problem: 4-bit LLM quantization suffers from outliers; rotation-based methods are incompatible with hardware microscaling (MXINT) formats, while mixed-precision approaches incur software scaling/dequant overhead.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free, sensitivity-guided mixed mantissa-bitwidth quantization tailored to MXINT's block structure, with practical deployment value.
summary_en.technical_approach: Observes that outlier severity and quantization sensitivity are uneven across layers and columns; MXSens assigns 4/6/8-bit mantissas per column/layer based on sensitivity, naturally fitting MXINT blocks without rotation or retraining.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms prior quantization methods across a range of LLMs (abstract truncated; training-free).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Babak Falsafi, Martin Jaggi, and Amir Yazdanbakhsh.

recommendation.zh: 纯推理量化工作，对预训练无直接 insight；若做 MX 硬件部署可看 §3 的敏感度分布分析，否则跳过。
recommendation.en: Inference-only quantization; no direct pretraining insight. Read §3 sensitivity analysis only if you deploy on MX hardware.

paper.title: ST-Veto: Spatio-Temporal Token Veto for Diffusion MLLMs via Taylor Prediction and Visual Grounding
paper.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong reasoning with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting but incur high sequential-generation cost, error accumulation, and limited self-correction. Diffusion Multimodal Large Language Models (dMLLMs) unmask tokens in an order-agnostic process, improving efficiency and enabling iterative refinement, yet their reasoning and how to enhance it remain underexplored. We propose a training-free method, Spatio-Temporal Token Veto (ST-Veto), which leverages the abilit

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion MLLM 在多模态推理中如何利用非自回归、全位置可见的生成过程来减少错误 token 固化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 dMLLM 解码策略创新。它对预训练研究员的价值不在于训练 recipe，而在于展示 diffusion / masked-style 生成模型可以使用时间稳定性和视觉 grounding 信号做推理时纠错。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 training-free 的 Spatio-Temporal Token Veto。方法不只看当前 step 的 token 置信度，而是用二阶 Taylor 预测 token 置信度随 diffusion step 的变化，否决时间上不稳定的候选；同时用 image-attention mass 过滤视觉 grounding 弱的 token，并替换为更安全的候选。
summary.experiments: 在多个 diffusion MLLM 和多模态推理 benchmark 上测试。摘要称相对标准解码策略和已有 VLM reasoning 方法有稳定提升，最高准确率提升约 9%。方法不需要额外训练，但摘要未列出具体模型规模、benchmark 名称和延迟开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how diffusion MLLMs can use their all-position iterative generation process to avoid committing unstable or weakly grounded reasoning tokens.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a decoding method for diffusion multimodal LMs. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is that non-AR generation exposes temporal confidence trajectories and visual grounding signals that AR decoding cannot access in the same way.
summary_en.technical_approach: ST-Veto is a training-free decoding policy. It predicts confidence dynamics with a second-order Taylor approximation to veto temporally unstable tokens, then uses image-attention mass to reject tokens with weak visual grounding and swap in safer candidates.
summary_en.experiments: The method is tested across multiple diffusion MLLMs and multimodal reasoning benchmarks. The abstract reports consistent improvements over standard decoding policies and prior VLM reasoning methods, with up to a 9% accuracy gain. The abstract does not specify model sizes, benchmark names, or runtime overhead.

recommendation.zh: dMLLM 的解码信号设计比结果更有用；只看 Taylor 置信度外推和 attention grounding 的消融。
recommendation.en: The decoding signals matter more than the headline gain; skim the Taylor confidence extrapolation and attention-grounding ablations.

paper.title: Test-Time Registers as Global Priors for Tokenized Image Generation
paper.abstract: Attention-based models often develop attention sinks, where a small number of tokens repeatedly attract attention and accumulate unusually large activations. In vision transformers, these outliers are closely related to registers, which have been diagnostically linked to global, low-frequency image structure. Existing work has largely studied registers through interpretability analyses and linear probes, leaving open whether they can be operationalized as plug-and-play signals for generation wit

summary.core_problem: 研究视觉 Transformer 中的 register/attention sink 能否在不重新训练的情况下转化为 tokenized image generation 的全局先验。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成机制和表征分析的结合：它把原本偏 interpretability 的 register 现象变成测试时可插拔的生成控制信号。对统一 token 生成和 VLM 表征使用有边缘参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 OpenCLIP 和 DINOv2 在 ImageNet 上诊断 register 特征，发现其低频集中度强于 CLS readout 和 patch mean，并与像素空间 DCT 低频能量有稳定但中等强度的相关性；基于此提出 RegToken，把 register 结构转换为少量全局 prior tokens，用于 tokenized image generation，且不需要重新训练模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在 ImageNet 上用 OpenCLIP、DINOv2 进行分析，比较 register、CLS 和 patch mean 的低频特性，并报告与 DCT 低频能量存在一致但中等相关；具体生成质量指标、模型规模和提升幅度未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether registers and attention-sink-like features in vision transformers can be turned into test-time global priors for tokenized image generation without retraining.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution connects representation analysis with a generation-time mechanism: a diagnostic register phenomenon is operationalized as plug-in prior tokens. This is mildly relevant to unified token generation and VLM representation reuse.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using OpenCLIP and DINOv2 on ImageNet, the authors analyze register features and find stronger low-frequency concentration than CLS readouts or patch means, with a consistent but moderate correlation to pixel-space DCT low-frequency energy. RegToken then converts register structure into a small set of global prior tokens for tokenized image generation at test time.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports ImageNet analyses with OpenCLIP and DINOv2, comparisons against CLS and patch-mean features, and correlation with DCT low-frequency energy. It does not provide concrete generation metrics, model scale, or effect sizes in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 只看 register 低频分析和 RegToken 构造即可；结论不够大，但对 token 化视觉生成的全局先验有参考。
recommendation.en: Read only the register low-frequency analysis and RegToken construction; the claim is modest but useful for thinking about global priors in tokenized visual generation.

paper.title: DiFA: Inference-Time Forward-Process Alignment for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: The prevailing inference framework for diffusion models formulates generation fundamentally as a problem of numerical integration. This perspective casts the model as an exact estimator, neglecting the inherent statistical uncertainty of the denoising process. In this work, we propose Forward-Process Aligned Diffusion prediction (\textbf{DiFA}), a training-free framework that reframes inference-time data prediction refinement as a sequential state estimation problem. Rather than reusing past out

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型推理框架将生成视为数值积分问题，忽略去噪过程的统计不确定性，导致生成质量受限。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出一种免训练的推理时预测精炼框架 DiFA，将扩散生成重新建模为序列状态估计问题。
summary.technical_approach: 受卡尔曼滤波启发，把反向轨迹上的迭代数据预测视为相关观测，按结构一致性与噪声水平兼容性聚合历史预测形成前向对齐的时序共识；引入偏差引导机制自适应保留残差细节以对抗过平滑。
summary.experiments: 在图像生成任务上验证 DiFA 可在不重新训练的情况下提升扩散模型生成质量，具体指标与 baseline 未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Current diffusion inference frameworks treat generation as numerical integration and ignore the statistical uncertainty of the denoising process, limiting sample quality.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution; proposes DiFA, a training-free inference-time prediction refinement framework that reframes diffusion generation as sequential state estimation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by Kalman filtering, treats iterative predictions along the reverse trajectory as correlated observations and aggregates them by structural consistency and noise-level compatibility to form a forward-aligned temporal consensus; introduces a deviation guidance mechanism to adaptively preserve residual details and counter over-smoothing.
summary_en.experiments: Empirically validated on image generation tasks, showing quality improvements without retraining; specific metrics and baselines are not detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 扩散推理时优化的小创新，对做多模态生成的人有参考，对 LLM 预训练研究员价值有限，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: A minor diffusion inference-time optimization, relevant to multimodal generation researchers but of limited value to LLM pretraining researchers; abstract is sufficient.

paper.title: Retrieval is Enough: Training-Free Interpretability with a Tool-Using Agent
paper.abstract: Interpretability methods for neural network activations span a wide cost spectrum, from cheap, training-free techniques (such as linear probes, PCA, SVD) to more expensive training-based ones (such as SAEs and activation oracles). Training-based methods are typically more powerful, in part because they leverage large activation datasets during training. This raises a natural question - do they actually surface insights that go beyond what is recoverable from the training dataset itself? To addre

summary.core_problem: 基于训练的可解释性方法（如SAE）是否真的提取了超出训练激活数据集本身可恢复的洞察。
summary.importance: 原理分析类工作，提出一种免训练的Agent驱动可解释性范式，挑战了「训练型方法必然优于免训练方法」的默认认知。
summary.technical_approach: HARP方法：给LLM Agent配备存储激活-文本配对的向量数据库，以及激活投影、差值计算、均值计算等工具；Agent迭代检索样本、形成假设、构造线性探针验证。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未完整披露实验模型规模与基准对比，仅说明该方法不涉及训练，效果接近或达到训练型方法水平。
summary.authors_note: Soheil Feizi为马里兰大学知名可解释性与基础模型研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether training-based interpretability methods (e.g., SAEs) surface insights that are genuinely beyond what is recoverable from the activation dataset itself.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis work proposing a training-free agent-driven interpretability paradigm; challenges the default prior that training-based methods strictly outperform training-free ones.
summary_en.technical_approach: HARP (Hypothesis-driven Agentic Retrieval and Probing): an LLM agent equipped with a vector database of activation-text pairs and tools for projection, difference, and averaging; the agent iteratively retrieves samples, forms hypotheses, and validates them with linear probes.
summary_en.experiments: Full model scale and baseline comparisons are not detailed in the abstract; the method is training-free and reportedly matches or approaches training-based method performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Soheil Feizi is a well-known researcher in interpretability and foundation models at University of Maryland.

recommendation.zh: 用Agent+检索替代SAE训练做可解释性，思路新颖；重点看方法部分与和SAE的对比实验，判断是否真的消解了训练型方法的优势。
recommendation.en: Agent + retrieval replaces SAE training for interpretability — a fresh angle; focus on method section and SAE comparison to judge whether training-based advantages are genuinely dissolved.

paper.title: VarRate: Training-Free Variable-Rate KV Cache Compression for Long-Context LLMs
paper.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck in long-context large language model (LLM) inference. Two leading training-free families are both structurally limited: token-selection methods (SnapKV, Ada-KV) score importance from an observation window and evict low-scoring tokens, but eviction is irreversible -- so when the importance signal degrades under query-agnostic reuse, accuracy collapses by 11-15 points; uniform low-rank coding keeps every token but spends equal rank everywhere,

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 内存占用过高，以及 token eviction 在长距离查询下不可逆丢信息的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理效率方法。它把 KV 压缩从“删 token”转成“给每个 token 分配不同低秩预算”，保留所有 token 的非零信息。对长上下文 serving、预训练侧长上下文评测和压缩鲁棒性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: VarRate 是训练免费的 KV codec。它根据 query salience 为不同 token 分配可变低秩 rank，而不是直接淘汰低分 token；所有 token 都保留非零 rank。相对于统一低秩压缩，它避免把预算平均浪费在不重要位置；相对于 SnapKV、Ada-KV 等选择式方法，它避免不可逆删除。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 上，以相同 20% KV 预算比较训练免费的 token-selection 方法和低秩方法。摘要称 SnapKV、Ada-KV 类方法在 query-agnostic reuse 下会掉 11-15 分，而 VarRate 在相同困难场景下只掉 3.5-5.5 分。摘要未给出完整模型规模和全部任务明细。
summary.authors_note: Iowa State University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV-cache memory pressure in long-context LLM inference and the irreversible information loss caused by token eviction.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It reframes KV compression from dropping tokens to allocating different low-rank budgets per token, keeping nonzero information for every position. It is relevant to long-context serving and to robustness analysis of compression schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach: VarRate is a training-free KV codec that assigns variable low-rank ranks to tokens according to query salience. It keeps every token at a nonzero rank. Compared with uniform low-rank compression, it avoids wasting equal budget everywhere; compared with SnapKV- or Ada-KV-style token selection, it avoids irreversible eviction.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports LongBench results at a matched 20% KV budget. The abstract states that token-selection methods lose 11–15 points when query-agnostic reuse degrades the importance signal, while VarRate loses only 3.5–5.5 points in the same regime. The abstract does not provide full model sizes or all task-level details.
summary_en.authors_note: Iowa State University.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 LongBench 失败案例即可；“低秩保留全部 token”比 eviction 更稳，是长上下文压缩的有用 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the method and LongBench failure cases; keeping all tokens at low rank is a useful prior over eviction for long-context compression.

paper.title: Seeing the End at Step Zero: Accelerating Diffusion MLLMs via MLP Sparsity-Aware Truncation
paper.abstract: Diffusion Multimodal Large Language Models (DMLLMs) are highly effective for multimodal reasoning, yet their inference efficiency is significantly hindered by fixed-length generation constraints. Since the actual output length is unknown, output sequences are padded to a predefined maximum length, resulting in substantial redundant computation over unnecessary [EOS] tokens. In this work, we discover that DMLLMs implicitly reveal their valid semantic boundary at the very first denoising step thro

summary.core_problem: 扩散多模态大模型推理时因输出长度未知需填充至预设最大长度，产生大量冗余[EOS]token计算，拖慢推理效率
summary.importance: 首次发现DMLLM第一步去噪即可通过MLP激活稀疏性偏移揭示有效语义边界，提出免训练推理加速框架，属于推理效率方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出Seer训练-free框架，通过信噪比准则检测MLP激活稀疏性突变定位语义边界，一次性截断后续计算的冗余后缀；配套混合执行策略适配批量服务的动态序列长度
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验配置与量化效果，仅提及方法无需额外训练，支持批量推理场景下的动态长度适配

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion MLLMs suffer from redundant computation on padded [EOS] tokens during inference, as output length is unknown and sequences are padded to a predefined maximum
summary_en.importance: First observation that DMLLMs reveal valid semantic boundaries at the first denoising step via MLP activation sparsity shift; proposes a training-free inference acceleration framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Seer, a training-free framework that detects semantic boundaries via SNR-based MLP sparsity shift measurement and truncates redundant suffixes for all subsequent steps; includes a hybrid execution strategy for batched serving with dynamic sequence lengths
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details and quantitative results are not available in the truncated abstract; only confirms the method is training-free and supports batched inference

recommendation.zh: 第一步去噪即可判断输出长度的观察有新意，但核心是推理优化，对预训练研究参考有限，扫一眼摘要即可
recommendation.en: The first-step output length predictability observation is novel, but this is primarily an inference optimization work with limited pretraining relevance.

paper.title: Self-Improving is Often Sudden: Enlightenment-style Finetuning for Large-Scale Models
paper.abstract: The pursuit of autonomously self-improving models has attracted growing interest in the era of large-scale foundation models. Drawing inspiration from the concept of "enlightenment" or "aha moment" in human brain, we hypothesize that large models exhibit an analogous enlightenment phenomenon-a latent capacity for sudden capability boost. Then, we propose Enlightenment, a novel training-free post-tuning paradigm for large-scale models. Our approach modifies shortcuts for key modules/layers withou

summary.core_problem: 现有免训练后调方法主要通过操纵注意力权重提升模型能力，缺乏对模块/层快捷连接的直接修改方式。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出一种无需权重更新的后调范式，通过修改关键模块的快捷连接实现能力提升。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Enlightenment范式，对LLM引入注意力头混合快捷连接（将初始注意力头输出连接到所有其他目标头，由自适应缩放因子调制），对VLM在残差连接上施加轻量标量调制因子。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型规模、基准测试及量化提升数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing training-free post-tuning methods primarily manipulate attention weights to improve model capability, lacking approaches that directly modify shortcut connections of modules/layers.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a weight-update-free post-tuning paradigm that improves capability by modifying shortcut connections of key modules.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Enlightenment paradigm introduces attention head-mixing shortcuts for LLMs (linking initial attention head outputs to all other target heads, modulated by adaptive scaling factors) and lightweight scalar-modulated factors on residual connections for VLMs.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not provide specific model scale, benchmarks, or quantitative improvement data.

recommendation.zh: 免训练后调的一个新思路，但概念包装大于实质，看方法部分了解快捷连接设计即可，效果可信度待验证。
recommendation.en: A new idea in training-free post-tuning, but concept packaging outweighs substance; read the method section for shortcut connection design, effectiveness remains to be verified.

paper.title: Resist and Update: Counterfactual Report Coordinates for Incentive-Compatible LLMs
paper.abstract: Aligned language models routinely misreport under non-evidential incentive pressure: they agree with a confident user or overstate certainty even when their internal belief is unchanged. We cast this as a failure of internal incentive-compatibility (IC) and present a method for learning and certifying counterfactual report mediators that hold a model's reports to a causal contract: invariant to forbidden influences (pressure, prestige, restyling) and responsive to licensed ones (genuine evidence

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 LLM 在“报告自己相信什么”时的激励相容问题：模型应该被真实证据改变，但不应该被用户压力、身份声望或措辞重写牵着走。难点在于这两个目标会冲突：只强调抗压会让模型不再吸收新证据，只强调更新会让模型继续迎合压力。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对理解 post-train 后模型的内部表征和报告层失真有启发。论文把 sycophancy 从输出行为拆到可干预的 hidden-state report mediator，并用因果干预而不是 probe accuracy 来验证。这对研究“模型内部信念是否仍可恢复”“RLHF/SFT 改变的是信念还是报告策略”有参考价值，也能作为训练信号质量和对齐副作用分析的工具。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一，构造 Bayesian-witness benchmark：隐藏二元世界状态，证据由给定 likelihood ratio 产生，因此真实 posterior 可由 log-odds 累积计算。用户分歧在不同 counterfactual variant 中被标记为可靠证据、随机无效信息，或纯压力，从而把“应该更新”和“不应屈服”分开测量。第二，用 interchange intervention 识别低秩 report coordinates，包括 answer、confidence、caveat 三类坐标，并检查 sufficiency、exclusion、block-level necessity 和低秩结构；作者强调这些坐标近似正交，因此可相对独立控制。第三，提出 counterfactual report-coordinate clamp：推理时先把同一 prompt 改写成 incentive-neutralized counterfactual，用同一个模型跑一遍，读出 neutral run 的 report coordinate，再把 pressured run 的对应坐标 clamp 到这个参考方向。关键区别在于它不是一个全局 steering strength，而是依赖同一样本的 counterfactual reference，所以能区分 forbidden influence 和 licensed evidence。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5-3B/7B、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 等 3B 到 8B dense 模型。benchmark 至少包含九类 matched counterfactual variants，并通过 belief-escrow protocol 先获得模型自己的 committed report，再测量后续压力造成的 distortion。主要结论是：global decoding 和普通 steering 会在 resist 与 update 之间形成明显 trade-off；只训练 resistance 的 fine-tuning 能增强抗压，但会损失对可靠证据的响应；CRC clamp 在作者测试的方法中同时改善 resistance 和 evidence updating。论文还讨论了把两次 forward 的 clamp 编译成单次 forward 的尝试，结果是有损的，提示这种 report contract 可能需要训练时内化。自然分布迁移用 SycophancyEval 做补充验证，但作者也明确承认更大模型和非 dense 架构尚未测试。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的 Bayesian-witness 设计，它是全文成立的前提；再看 Section 5.1 的 interchange intervention，因为这里决定 report coordinate 是否只是相关 probe，还是有因果控制意义；Section 5.2 是 CRC clamp 的核心。Section 6.1 可快速理解为什么单参数 steering 和 resist-only training 不够；Section 6.3 值得看，因为它暴露了两次推理方法转成单次模型行为时的损失。若关注对齐评测，可补看 Section 6.4 的 SycophancyEval transfer。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies internal incentive compatibility for LLM reports. A model should revise its answer when given legitimate evidence, but should not change merely because the user is confident, prestigious, insistent, or restyles the prompt. The hard part is that resistance and updating are opposing controls: a model can look robust by refusing to update, or look responsive by following pressure.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for researchers studying how post-training changes the interface between latent beliefs and generated reports. The main value is methodological: it separates belief recovery from report distortion, and validates hidden-state report mediators with causal interventions rather than probe accuracy. That makes it relevant to sycophancy analysis, RLHF side effects, and the design of training signals that should affect reporting behavior without erasing evidence sensitivity.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a Bayesian-witness benchmark with a hidden binary state and signals whose likelihood ratios are specified, so the posterior is known by construction. The same user disagreement can be made licensed evidence or forbidden pressure by changing a stated reliability variable. Reports are parsed into answer, confidence, and caveat fields, and a belief-escrow protocol first elicits the model’s own committed report before measuring later distortion. On the representation side, the paper identifies low-rank answer, confidence, and caveat coordinates through interchange interventions, checking sufficiency, exclusion, block-level necessity, and approximate independence. The intervention method is a counterfactual report-coordinate clamp: run the same model on an incentive-neutralized version of the prompt, extract the report coordinate, then clamp the pressured run toward that coordinate. This differs from global steering because the reference is sample-specific and path-specific.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on open dense models in the 3B–8B range, including Qwen2.5-3B/7B, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The benchmark uses at least nine matched counterfactual prompt variants, allowing resistance and updating to be scored separately. The main empirical pattern is clear: decoding changes and global steering trade off resistance against evidence responsiveness; resistance-oriented fine-tuning generalizes some robustness but reduces legitimate updating; the counterfactual coordinate clamp is the only tested method that satisfies both controls in the matched setting. The paper also studies compilation of the two-pass procedure into one forward pass and finds it lossy, which points toward training-time internalization as a more durable route. Transfer is checked on SycophancyEval, while larger and non-dense models remain untested.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: 30–45 minutes. Read the Bayesian-witness construction in Section 3 first, because it defines what counts as licensed evidence versus forbidden influence. Then read Section 5.1 for the causal identification of report coordinates and Section 5.2 for the clamp itself. Section 6.1 is the fastest way to see why scalar steering and resistance-only training are insufficient. Section 6.3 is worth reading if the goal is to understand whether a two-pass inference intervention can be turned into a learned one-pass behavior.

recommendation.zh: 用因果干预找低秩报告坐标的思路对理解对齐机制有启发，重点看 §3 的坐标识别方法。
recommendation.en: The causal-intervention approach to identifying low-rank report coordinates offers insight into alignment mechanisms; focus on §3.

paper.title: Unlocking Parallelism in Autoregressive Language Models via Speculative Decoding with Progressive Tree Drafting
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding has significantly accelerated Large Language Model (LLM) inference by alleviating memory-bound bottlenecks. However, traditional speculative decoding typically relies on auxiliary draft modules, incurring significant training and communication overhead. Although recent methods attempt to generate drafts within the target model itself, they often fail to fully exploit its latent parallel capacity due to a lack of structural coordination. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Prog

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是训练外、模型内 speculative decoding 的一个具体瓶颈：目标模型虽然有并行计算能力，但现有 endogenous drafting 方法大多让模型独立地产生多条线性候选，结果是不同分支高度相似，重复消耗 attention 和 KV 计算，接受率也不稳定。论文想解决的不是“能不能做自草稿”，而是“如何用结构化方式把 AR 模型潜在的并行能力真正转成可验证、可接受、可带来端到端加速的 draft”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，更偏推理侧系统优化，所以是 skim 而不是 must-read。但它有两点对基座研究仍有启发。第一，它把 AR Transformer 的并行潜力重新表述为“通过输入组织和 attention mask 改写计算图”，这对理解 AR 模型在非标准生成范式下还能做什么有参考价值。第二，它指出 draft 质量不只是 token-level 准确率问题，还和候选之间的结构冗余有关；这个观察对 speculative decoding、any-order generation、甚至训练时的多路径监督设计都有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Progressive Tree Drafting, PTD。它不再把 draft 组织成若干彼此独立的线性序列，而是组织成一棵共享前缀的树。这样做有两个直接目的。其一，公共前缀只算一次，减少重复计算；其二，树结构天然要求分支在更靠后的层级才分化，能把并行预算更多用在真正不同的语义路径上。

具体机制分三部分。第一是 tree construction。作者先用若干 seed nodes 初始化 drafting tree，这些 seed 可以来自随机采样或上下文语义启发。树中每个节点只能 attend 到自己的祖先节点，借此保证每条路径仍符合 AR 因果约束；位置编码则按祖先链长度分配，使树输入仍兼容标准 Transformer。

第二是 progressive evolution。PTD 不是一次性把整棵树铺开，而是逐步扩展。每一轮 forward pass 后，根据当前节点的预测结果扩展候选子节点，再结合 stepwise pruning 删除低价值或高冗余分支。论文的动机很明确：如果一开始就无约束扩展，树会迅速膨胀，验证成本和冗余都会上升；逐步演化则允许模型先形成粗粒度语义分叉，再把算力集中到更有希望的路径。

第三是 draft extraction and verification。树中多条 root-to-leaf 路径会被抽取为候选 continuation，再交给标准 speculative verification 过程并行验证。与 Self-Draft 这类通过输入扰动生成多分支的方法相比，PTD 的区别不在于“多生成几条”，而在于显式利用 prefix sharing 和 pruning 去协调分支间关系。与 LADE 这类并行预测线性未来 token 的方法相比，PTD 更像在语义空间里做受约束搜索，而不是在固定线性位置上做 Jacobi 式迭代。
summary.experiments:
从正文可确认的主结果是：PTD 在多个基准上都能稳定带来最高约 2× 的解码加速，而且不需要额外 draft model，也不需要额外训练。论文前面给出的诊断分析显示，Self-Draft 中超过一半 decoding steps 存在分支相似度超过 80% 的情况，这构成了 PTD 的主要经验动机。

实验重点应当包括三类。第一，端到端 speedup，对比 vanilla decoding、外部 draft speculative decoding、LADE、Self-Draft 等训练外方法。第二，acceptance rate 与 draft diversity 的关系，证明树结构和 pruning 不是只减少计算，而是确实提高了有效候选比例。第三，结构消融，例如是否使用 progressive update、是否使用 pruning、不同树宽/树深设置、不同 seed 策略对速度和质量的影响。

受限于给出的全文片段，无法可靠提取完整的模型规模、数据集名称、每个 benchmark 的精确数字和全部消融表格，因此不应编造。可以确定的是，作者把“最高约 2× speedup”作为主结论，并把高相似度冗余作为关键实证发现。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 里对 Self-Draft 冗余的诊断，尤其是 Figure 2 右图。这一部分决定了方法是否有必要。然后看 Method 里的 tree construction、progressive update、stepwise pruning 三段，重点理解两个约束：节点只看祖先，以及为什么要逐步剪枝而不是一次性展开。最后看主实验里的 speedup、acceptance rate、diversity 指标和消融。

如果时间有限，建议 20 到 30 分钟读法：先读 Figure 2 和 Figure 3，再读方法定义和主表。真正值得想一层的是，这种 tree-structured drafting 是否只是工程技巧，还是说明 AR Transformer 在 attention mask 重新布线后可以承担更一般的并行搜索角色。这个问题比论文表面的推理加速更有研究味道。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in training-free, endogenous speculative decoding. Recent methods can draft candidates using the target AR model itself, but they usually generate multiple linear branches independently. In practice, many of those branches are semantically near-duplicates, so the model spends parallel compute on redundant candidates and gains limited acceptance-rate improvement. The real question here is not whether self-drafting is possible, but how to organize the model’s latent parallel capacity into diverse, coherent, and verifiable drafts.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, so it fits skim. Still, it has two useful implications for foundation-model researchers. First, it reframes AR Transformer parallelism as something that can be exposed by restructuring inputs and attention masks, which is relevant to broader non-standard generation paradigms. Second, it shows that draft quality is not only about token accuracy; structural redundancy among candidates matters.
