That observation may carry over to speculative decoding, any-order generation, and even multi-path supervision during training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is Progressive Tree Drafting (PTD). Instead of representing drafts as several independent linear continuations, PTD organizes them as a prefix-sharing tree. This serves two purposes: shared prefixes are computed once rather than repeatedly, and branching is coordinated so parallel budget is spent on genuinely different semantic paths rather than near-identical continuations.

The method has three main components. First, tree construction. PTD initializes a drafting tree with seed nodes, obtained either stochastically or from context-aware semantic cues. Each node is only allowed to attend to its ancestors, preserving autoregressive causality along every root-to-node path. Positional encoding is assigned according to ancestor-chain length so the tree input remains compatible with a standard Transformer.

Second, progressive evolution. PTD does not expand the full tree in one shot. It grows the tree step by step: after each forward pass, candidate children are proposed, and a stepwise pruning rule removes low-value or highly redundant branches. This design is important. Unconstrained expansion would quickly inflate the tree and verification cost; progressive growth lets the model first establish coarse semantic alternatives and then allocate compute to the most promising paths.

Third, draft extraction and verification. Multiple root-to-leaf paths are extracted as candidate continuations and then verified with a standard speculative-decoding acceptance procedure. Compared with Self-Draft, which obtains multiple branches through input perturbations, PTD explicitly coordinates branch relationships through prefix sharing and pruning. Compared with LADE-style parallel future-token prediction, PTD is closer to constrained semantic search than to Jacobi-style linear refinement.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text content, the main confirmed result is that PTD consistently achieves up to about 2× decoding speedup across several benchmarks, without auxiliary draft models and without extra training. The motivating analysis in the paper shows that in Self-Draft, more than half of decoding steps contain branches with over 80% similarity, which is the empirical basis for the proposed tree formulation.

The experimental story appears to center on three aspects. First, end-to-end speedup against vanilla decoding and prior speculative baselines such as external-draft methods, LADE, and Self-Draft. Second, the relationship between acceptance rate and draft diversity, showing that the tree structure and pruning improve not only compute reuse but also the usefulness of candidates. Third, structural ablations: progressive update vs. one-shot expansion, pruning vs. no pruning, different tree widths/depths, and different seed strategies.

Because the supplied text is truncated, I cannot reliably extract all benchmark names, model sizes, or exact table values, and those should not be fabricated. The robust takeaway is the reported up-to-2× speedup and the redundancy diagnosis that motivates the method.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the Introduction and the redundancy analysis, especially Figure 2 on branch similarity in Self-Draft. That section tells you whether the method is solving a real bottleneck. Then read the Method section around tree construction, progressive update, and stepwise pruning. The two key ideas to track are: each node only attends to ancestors, and the tree is expanded progressively rather than fully materialized. Finally, inspect the main speedup table, acceptance-rate results, diversity analysis, and ablations.

A practical skim path is 20–30 minutes: Figure 2, Figure 3, the algorithm description, then the main results. The deeper question worth thinking about is whether tree-structured drafting is merely an engineering trick for decoding, or evidence that AR Transformers can act as more general parallel search engines once their attention graph is rewired.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和端到端延迟表；若加速不依赖小 batch 或短输出，值得放进内部 speculative decoding ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and end-to-end latency table; if the gain survives non-toy batch and length settings, it is worth an internal speculative-decoding ablation.

paper.title: Spectral Heat Flow for Conservative Token Condensation in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are costly at inference time because they must process long sequences of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods often degrade under high compression by blindly discarding information, breaking spatial structure or collapsing diversity. We propose SpecFlow, a training-free framework that shifts the paradigm from destructive pruning to conservative condensation, strictly enforcing spatial coverage and statistical conservation to ensure stability. Treating visua

summary.core_problem: VLM推理时视觉token序列过长导致计算开销大，现有token剪枝在高压缩率下信息损失严重。
summary.importance: 推理效率方向的方法改进，提出训练无关的保守token凝聚范式，属于增量型创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SpecFlow，将视觉token视为kNN图节点，通过谱热流计算重要性场、自适应空间划分保证覆盖、信息聚合到coreset sink保持统计守恒，无需微调。
summary.experiments: 在多个VLM架构和任务上与现有SOTA token剪枝方法对比，高压缩率下性能更优，兼容FlashAttention，即插即用。

summary_en.core_problem: Long visual token sequences make VLM inference expensive; existing token pruning methods degrade severely under high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: Incremental improvement in inference efficiency; proposes a training-free conservative token condensation paradigm as an alternative to destructive pruning.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecFlow treats visual tokens as nodes in a kNN graph, computes importance via spectral heat flow, allocates budgets through adaptive spatial partitioning, and aggregates discarded information into coreset sinks to preserve statistical conservation, requiring no fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across multiple VLM architectures and tasks, outperforming state-of-the-art token pruning methods especially at high compression rates; plug-and-play and FlashAttention-compatible.

recommendation.zh: VLM视觉token压缩的工程改进，训练无关思路有参考价值但非范式突破，看方法节即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering improvement for VLM visual token compression; training-free design is worth noting but not paradigm-shifting—skim the method section only.

paper.title: Encoder-Side Neuron Identification and Amplification for Acoustic Perception in Large Audio-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) often underperform on fine-grained, non-semantic attributes of speech, such as a speaker's emotion, despite strong performance on speech content. Improving this without the cost of retraining calls for an effective inference-time intervention, yet most existing methods intervene only after the audio encoder and operate at a relatively coarse granularity. The encoder itself, where acoustic information is first extracted from the waveform, remains largely unexpl

summary.core_problem: 大音频语言模型在语音非语义属性（如说话人情绪）识别上表现差，现有推理干预方法粒度粗、作用位置靠后，未挖掘音频编码器的神经元级信息。
summary.importance: 提出无训练、无标签的编码器神经元识别与放大方法，无需重训即可显著提升音频模型的非语义声学属性识别能力。
summary.technical_approach: 对比真实波形与缺乏声学信息的噪声参考输入下音频编码器每个FFN神经元的激活值，定位负责声学感知的神经元，推理时放大小部分高得分神经元的激活。
summary.experiments: 在10项非语义语音属性任务上，该方法平均提升准确率25.7%，无需任何标注或微调。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自台湾大学，知名作者为Hung-yi Lee（李宏毅，语音与语言模型领域知名研究者）。

summary_en.core_problem: Large audio-language models underperform on fine-grained non-semantic speech attributes (e.g., speaker emotion), while existing inference interventions operate at coarse granularity after the encoder, leaving encoder neuron-level information unexplored.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free, label-free encoder neuron identification and amplification method that significantly improves non-semantic acoustic attribute recognition without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Scores each feed-forward neuron in the audio encoder by comparing its activation on real waveforms against a noise reference lacking acoustic information, then amplifies a small set of highest-scoring neurons at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: Across ten non-semantic speech attribute tasks, the method improves average accuracy by 25.7% without any annotation or fine-tuning.
summary_en.authors_note: The team is from National Taiwan University, with notable author Hung-yi Lee, a well-known researcher in speech and language modeling.

recommendation.zh: 音频模型推理时的神经元激活调整技巧，噪声对比定位神经元的思路有极弱可迁移性，不用读正文。
recommendation.en: A neuron activation tuning trick for audio model inference; the noise-based neuron localization idea has marginal transfer value, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: MemDefrag: Latent Memory Defragmentation for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Latent memory, which stores past knowledge fragments as per-layer hidden states, has emerged as a promising paradigm (e.g., MemoryLLM and M+) for long-term memory in large language models (LLMs). However, the paradigm suffers from significant performance degradation during memory updates, due to positional encoding misalignment and the absence of any tracing mechanism to distinguish target memory fragments from irrelevant ones. To discover such a tracing mechanism, we probe the layer-wise attent

summary.core_problem: 基于“latent memory（以各层 hidden states 存储记忆片段）”的长时记忆 LLM 在更新/写入记忆后容易性能退化，如何在不训练的情况下缓解由位置编码错位与无追踪机制导致的记忆污染。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制探测 + 训练外（training-free）记忆管理：指出中间层对目标记忆片段存在稳定的注意力密度“追踪信号”，并用它做记忆碎片整理与遗忘；对做 MemoryLLM/M+ 这类架构的人有直接工程启发，但对通用预训练主线影响有限。
summary.technical_approach: 先做 probing：统计 layer-wise attention density 在存储的 memory fragments 上的分布，发现少数中间层对目标片段注意力最集中；据此提出 MemDefrag：用中间层信号对记忆做 rank/reorder/filter 的“defragmentation”，并在容量不足时用 informativeness-guided 的 proportional forgetting 做删减；强调 model-agnostic、training-free。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体基座、任务、记忆容量、退化幅度与修复幅度；从表述看会在 MemoryLLM/M+ 风格设置下对比更新前后性能，以及 MemDefrag 对更新退化的缓解效果与容量扩展曲线。
summary.authors_note: Kyoto University；其余作者含 Independent Researcher。

summary_en.core_problem: Latent-memory LLMs (storing memory as per-layer hidden states) often degrade after memory updates due to positional-encoding misalignment and lack of a tracing mechanism; the goal is to mitigate this without additional training.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism probing plus a training-free memory-management method: it claims a stable mid-layer attention-density “tracing signal” for target fragments and uses it for defragmentation/forgetting. Useful if you build MemoryLLM/M+-style systems, less central to mainstream pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Probe layer-wise attention density over stored memory fragments and identify a small set of middle layers that consistently concentrate attention on the target fragment. Propose MemDefrag: use this mid-layer signal to rank/reorder/filter memories (defragmentation) and apply an informativeness-guided proportional forgetting when capacity is exceeded; model-agnostic and training-free.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides no model/task/capacity numbers. Likely evaluates update-induced degradation in MemoryLLM/M+-like setups and measures how MemDefrag restores performance and scales with memory capacity.
summary_en.authors_note: Kyoto University; one author listed as Independent Researcher.

recommendation.zh: 中间层注意力密度当“记忆追踪信号”这个观察值得记一笔；但缺少规模化实验细节时先别信泛化，只需扫它的 probing 图和整理策略。
recommendation.en: The mid-layer attention-density “memory tracing” observation is worth noting; without large, clean experiments don’t over-believe generality—skim the probing plots and the defrag heuristic.

paper.title: Propose and Attend: Training-free MLLM Grounding Confidence via Multi-Token Localized Attention
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models can emit localized predictions, bounding boxes for objects and temporal windows for video and audio events, but they hallucinate these regions prolifically. The model's own token log-probabilities are nearly uninformative: they conflate grounding quality with input ambiguity, and coordinate tokens become near-deterministic once the model commits. We propose Multi-Token Localized Attention (MTLA): a training-free, post-hoc score that measures how strongly a predic

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 MLLM 生成定位结果时缺少可靠置信度的问题。模型可以直接输出 bbox 或时间窗口，但大量区域并不对应真实对象或事件；生成 token 的 log-prob 又不能有效区分正确定位和幻觉定位，因为坐标 token 在模型决定输出后往往变得近似确定。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练的贡献偏间接，但对多模态模型训练和评测很有用。核心启发是：定位是否可靠，可以从生成 token 对其声称区域内模态 token 的注意力支持程度中读出，而不是只看文本概率。这个信号可用于 MLLM grounding 评测、推理时重排序、训练数据过滤，也可能为后续构造视觉 grounding reward 提供一个无需额外标注的 proxy。论文还提醒，通用 MLLM 如果要作为定位系统使用，需要用检测领域的 AP、Recall@1、PSDS1 等指标来评估，而不能只看 VQA 或 caption 类 benchmark。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Multi-Token Localized Attention，简称 MTLA。给定模型生成的一个定位预测，例如类别标签加 bbox，或音视频中的时间窗口，MTLA 收集所有相关输出 token 的 decoder attention，并只统计这些 token 对预测区域内部模态 token 的注意力质量。它同时改进了两个常见弱点：第一，不再像 SVAR 类方法那样把注意力在整个视觉输入上求和，而是限制在模型自己声称的区域内；第二，不只读取第一个对象词 token，而是聚合整个预测的多个 token，包括语义标签和坐标/时间 token。这样得到的分数衡量的是“这个预测是否真的由其所指区域支撑”。方法不需要训练额外分类器，也不需要改模型结构，可用于图像、视频和音频定位。
summary.experiments: 论文在多个模型族和多个模态上验证 MTLA，包括图像目标定位、视频事件定位和音频事件定位。作者首先指出，当前强 MLLM 输出的定位区域中有 58% 到 68% 不能匹配有效对象或事件，说明定位幻觉比例很高。token probability 对正确与错误定位的区分度很弱。MTLA 在幻觉检测、训练自由的输出抑制和检测指标重排序中都优于已有 attention baseline。一个明确数字是：在 COCO zero-shot detection 上，对一个 8B generalist MLLM，把 MTLA 作为置信度后，AP 从 20.4 提升到 37.0。论文还使用 AP、Recall@1 和 PSDS1 等标准定位指标，而不是只用生成式任务指标。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。先看 Introduction 中关于 log-prob 失效和 58%–68% 无效定位的分析，这是问题成立的关键。然后看 MTLA 定义，重点是“localized”和“multi-token”两个设计；它们分别对应区域内注意力和跨预测 token 聚合。实验部分优先看 Figure 4，理解 token probability 与 MTLA 的分离度差异；再看 COCO AP 20.4 到 37.0 的重排序结果，以及跨图像、视频、音频的泛化表。若只关心预训练，可把它当作一个 grounding 信号候选，而不是一篇训练 recipe 论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies confidence estimation for localization outputs generated by MLLMs. These models can emit boxes for images and temporal windows for video or audio, but many predicted regions are hallucinated. Token log-probabilities are a poor confidence signal because they mix grounding quality with input ambiguity, and coordinate tokens often become nearly deterministic once the model commits to a region.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining recipe, but it is useful for multimodal foundation-model research. It shows that grounding quality can be probed from how strongly the generated prediction tokens attend to the region they claim. This gives a training-free signal for localization reliability, output reranking, data filtering, and possibly reward construction for future grounding-oriented post-training. It also argues that MLLMs used as localization systems should be evaluated with detection-style metrics such as AP, Recall@1, and PSDS1, not only with VQA or captioning benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed score, Multi-Token Localized Attention (MTLA), is a post-hoc confidence measure. For a predicted region, MTLA aggregates decoder attention from all tokens belonging to the prediction and restricts the modality-side aggregation to tokens inside the predicted box or temporal window. This differs from earlier attention-based hallucination detectors in two ways. It is localized: attention outside the claimed region is not treated as direct evidence. It is multi-token: the score uses the full prediction, including label and coordinate or time tokens, rather than a single object sub-token. The resulting score measures whether the prediction is supported by evidence in the region it points to. It requires no additional training and is intended to work across image, video, and audio localization.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover several model families and localization settings across modalities. A key empirical finding is that 58% to 68% of regions emitted by strong MLLMs do not correspond to valid objects or events on the evaluated benchmarks. Token probability provides weak separation between grounded and hallucinated predictions. MTLA improves hallucination detection, enables training-free suppression of unreliable outputs, and improves ranking under standard localization metrics. The clearest reported number is on zero-shot COCO detection: using MTLA as the confidence score raises AP for an 8B generalist MLLM from 20.4 to 37.0. The paper also evaluates with AP, Recall@1, and PSDS1, which makes the localization behavior easier to compare with detector-style systems.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 20 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure analysis of token log-probabilities and the reported 58%–68% invalid localization rate. Then read the MTLA formulation, paying attention to the two design choices: region-restricted attention and aggregation over all prediction tokens. In the experiments, Figure 4 is important because it compares the separation quality of token probability and MTLA. Also inspect the COCO AP reranking result and the tables covering image, video, and audio. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main takeaway is MTLA as a candidate grounding signal, not as a model-training method.

recommendation.zh: 多模态定位幻觉的无训练校准信号，方法简单且跨模态通用，做VLM对齐/评测的可直接复用，只看方法定义与Fig2即可。
recommendation.en: A simple, training-free, modality-agnostic calibration signal for MLLM grounding hallucination; reusable for VLM alignment/evaluation, read method definition and Fig 2 only.

paper.title: x-Prediction Is All You Need:Training-Free Accelerated Generation via Endpoint Decodability
paper.abstract: Diffusion and flow matching models generate high-quality samples, but their ODE samplers often need tens to hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs). This remains a practical challenge for released checkpoints, since many accelerators require additional design choices and training cost through retraining, distillation, or trajectory redesign. We investigate a different route based on $x$-prediction. During sampling, standard affine probability paths already expose $x_0$ information: an int

summary.core_problem: 扩散与流匹配模型的ODE采样需要数十到数百次神经函数评估(NFE)，现有加速方法多需重训练、蒸馏或轨迹重设计，无法直接用于已发布checkpoint。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次形式化端点可解码性(endpoint decodability)性质，提出完全免训练的采样加速范式，无需修改模型或训练流程即可落地。
summary.technical_approach: 证明标准仿射概率路径下，中间状态x_t与路径速度可得到最小MSE的干净样本x0估计（端点可解码性）；提出截断跳跃采样(TJS)：在ODE早停时刻t*直接解码得到x0，跳过后续迭代步骤。
summary.experiments: 在SDXL、SD3.5M、Z-Image-Turbo等图像扩散模型，以及音频、3D生成模型上验证；仅需4-8次NFE即可达到原采样器20-50次NFE的生成质量，无重训练、蒸馏或架构修改成本。

summary_en.core_problem: ODE samplers for diffusion and flow matching models require tens to hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs); existing acceleration methods mostly need retraining, distillation, or trajectory redesign, and cannot be directly applied to released checkpoints.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; first formalizes the endpoint decodability property, proposes a completely training-free sampling acceleration paradigm that can be deployed without model modification or training overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proves that under standard affine probability paths, the intermediate state x_t and path velocity yield the minimum-MSE estimate of clean sample x_0 (endpoint decodability); proposes Truncated Jump Sampling (TJS): stop ODE at early-exit time t* and directly decode x_0, skipping subsequent iteration steps.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on image diffusion models including SDXL, SD3.5M, Z-Image-Turbo, as well as audio and 3D generation models; achieves comparable generation quality to original samplers with 20-50 NFEs using only 4-8 NFEs, with no retraining, distillation, or architecture modification cost.

recommendation.zh: 端点可解码性的形式化结论可直接迁移到扩散语言模型的采样加速，仅看§3的证明和Fig 2的轨迹对比即可。
recommendation.en: The formal endpoint decodability conclusion is directly transferable to diffusion LM sampling acceleration; only read §3 proof and Fig 2 trajectory comparison.

paper.title: ProxyUp: Training-Free Proxy-Conditioned Video Generation for Controllable Dynamics
paper.abstract: Precise control over complex dynamics remains challenging for modern video generative models, as text prompts alone often cannot specify physically plausible, fine-grained motion and interactions. We introduce $\textit{proxy-conditioned video generation}$, where a coarse proxy video from physics-based simulation or real-world recording serves as a dynamics carrier to control foreground object motion. Given a proxy video and a text prompt, the goal is to synthesize a new video that preserves the

summary.core_problem: 文本提示难以精确控制视频生成中的复杂运动，论文希望用粗糙代理视频提供可控的动态轨迹。
summary.importance: 这是视频生成控制方法，贡献在于训练自由的 proxy-conditioned 生成流程；对统一多模态预训练的直接贡献不大，但对“外部动态载体如何进入生成模型”有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: ProxyUp 不重新训练视频生成模型，而是先将代理视频反演到中间 latent 表示，再做 region-wise latent noising：保留与运动相关的区域 latent，同时对需要按文本重生成的区域注入噪声，从而在保留 proxy 动态的同时生成新内容。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明代理视频可来自物理仿真或真实录制，并用于控制前景物体运动；未给出具体基座视频模型、数据规模、baseline、指标或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the difficulty of controlling complex motion in video generation using text alone, by introducing coarse proxy videos as carriers of dynamics.
summary_en.importance: This is a controllable video generation method. Its main contribution is a training-free proxy-conditioned generation pipeline; it is only indirectly relevant to unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProxyUp avoids paired proxy-target training. It inverts a proxy video into an intermediate latent representation and applies region-wise latent noising, preserving motion-critical proxy latents while adding noise to regions that should be regenerated according to the text prompt.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that proxy videos can come from physics simulation or real recordings and are used to control foreground object motion. It does not provide the underlying video model, data scale, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 latent noising 设计即可；它是生成控制技巧，不是统一建模或预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the latent-noising design only; this is a generation-control trick, not a unified modeling or pretraining recipe.

paper.title: kNNGuard: Turning LLM Hidden Activations into a Training-Free Configurable Guardrail
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in domains requiring guardrails to detect unsafe, off-topic, or adversarial prompts. Existing guardrails predominately rely on fine-tuning to build classifiers, which often suffer from low generalization and high inference latency. We present kNNGuard, a training-free guardrail that utilizes the activation space of an off-the-shelf LLM. Given a small bank of 50 safe and unsafe prompts, kNNGuard extracts hidden activations and performs multi-

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM 护栏方法主要依赖微调构建分类器，存在泛化性差和推理延迟高的问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需训练的护栏方案，属于安全对齐领域的方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: kNNGuard 利用现成 LLM 的激活空间，仅需少量（50个）标注提示词提取隐藏激活，通过多层 kNN 融合激活空间和嵌入空间分数进行分类，无需梯度更新或微调。
summary.experiments: 在六个主题和安全提示领域上，F1 值达到或优于微调 SOTA 护栏，推理速度比最佳可比护栏快 2.7 倍，比微调安全分类器快 10 倍；域适应仅需更新标注库，可在 10 秒内构建。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自兰卡斯特大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM guardrails rely heavily on fine-tuned classifiers, which suffer from low generalization and high inference latency.
summary_en.importance: Presents a training-free guardrail approach, a methodological improvement in safety alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: kNNGuard leverages the activation space of an off-the-shelf LLM, extracts hidden activations from a small bank of 50 labeled prompts, and performs multi-layer kNN classification fusing activation-space and embedding-space scores, requiring no fine-tuning or gradient updates.
summary_en.experiments: Across six topical and security domains, achieves competitive or superior F1 compared to fine-tuned state-of-the-art guardrails while running 2.7x faster than the best comparable guardrail and 10x faster than a fine-tuned safety classifier.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Lancaster University and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 免训练护栏的工程思路对快速部署有参考价值，但技术深度有限，对预训练研究无直接启发。
recommendation.en: Training-free guardrail engineering is useful for deployment but offers limited insight for pretraining research.

paper.title: QWERTY: Training-Free Motion Control via Query-Warped Video Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate high-fidelity and temporally coherent videos, yet motion control remains implicit, primarily relying on text prompts. As a result, achieving desired motion often requires extensive prompt engineering and repeated resampling. While fine-tuning models with additional spatial prompts (e.g., bounding boxes or point trajectories) enables explicit control, it demands substantial data curation and computation, and may compromise the generative capabilities o

summary.core_problem: 在不微调视频扩散 Transformer 的情况下，用用户给定的物体形变或光流实现可控视频运动生成。
summary.importance: 这是视频生成控制方法，不是 LLM 预训练论文；价值在于它直接操作 DiT 的 attention/query 表示，提供了一个观察视频 DiT 内部语义与运动解耦的案例。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 QWERTY，一个 training-free 控制框架。方法不改模型权重，而是在预训练 image-to-video DiT 的 3D full attention 中，对 query 的帧不变语义子空间做 warping，使用户定义的 object warping 或 optical flow 能影响后续噪声预测与运动轨迹。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline 或量化提升；对比对象主要是需要额外空间提示微调的方法，以及已有 U-Net 视频扩散中的 training-free 控制方法。
summary.authors_note: 标注信息显示该工作与 Cohere 有关；摘要未提供更具体的作者机构分工。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper enables user-specified motion control in video diffusion transformers without fine-tuning the pretrained model.
summary_en.importance: This is a video generation control method rather than an LLM pretraining paper. Its useful signal is the direct manipulation of DiT attention/query representations, which gives a concrete probe into semantic-motion factorization in video DiTs.
summary_en.technical_approach: QWERTY is a training-free framework for pretrained image-to-video DiTs. Instead of updating weights, it warps the frame-invariant semantic subspace of queries inside 3D full attention, using object warping or optical flow to steer the model's noise prediction and motion generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model names, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The relevant comparison is against fine-tuning-based spatial-control methods and training-free control methods previously explored mainly for U-Net video diffusion models.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided metadata marks Cohere as a strong affiliated institution; the abstract itself does not specify detailed affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 不影响 LLM 训练路线；若关心 DiT 表示，只看 query warping 机制和 attention ablation。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining-route paper; read only the query-warping mechanism and attention ablations if you study DiT representations.

paper.title: NeoMap: Training-free Novel-View Synthesis from Single Images and Videos
paper.abstract: We study the challenging problem of novel view video synthesis from single images or monocular videos. Existing methods, which operate under the assumption that pre-trained video models lack native novel view synthesis capability and enforce view alignment via camera conditioning, task-specific fine-tuning, or stepwise hard denoising guidance, often suffer from artifacts and compromised global scene consistency. In this paper, we introduce NeoMap, a novel training-free framework designed to loca

summary.core_problem: 在不训练或微调的情况下，从单张图像或单目视频生成视角一致的新视角视频。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成中的 training-free 推理方法，核心价值在于检验通用预训练视频模型是否已经隐含三维视角变化能力；对统一多模态预训练有弱相关参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: NeoMap 不增加相机条件、不做任务微调，而是在预训练视频模型的自然视频流形中搜索满足新视角约束的解；核心机制是对初始噪声进行收敛的流形交替投影迭代，以定位更符合视角一致性的生成轨迹。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在单图像和单目视频 novel-view video synthesis 上做了广泛实验，并显示比依赖相机条件、微调或硬去噪引导的方法有更好的保真度和全局场景一致性；摘要未给出模型名称、数据规模或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles training-free novel-view video synthesis from a single image or monocular video.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an inference-time method for multimodal generation, mainly testing whether general pretrained video models already contain usable 3D view-change capability. This is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: NeoMap avoids camera conditioning and task-specific fine-tuning. It searches the natural-video manifold of a pretrained video model by optimizing the initial noise through convergent alternating projection iterations, aiming to locate a view-consistent generation trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports broad experiments on single-image and monocular-video novel-view synthesis, with better fidelity and global consistency than camera-conditioned, fine-tuned, or hard-denoising-guided baselines. It does not specify model scale, datasets, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；有用的是“调噪声找流形解”这个 prior，别把它当视频预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and ablations; the useful prior is noise-space manifold search, not a clean conclusion about video pretraining.

paper.title: PhotoQuilt: Training-Free Arbitrary-Resolution Photomosaics via Bootstrapped Tiled Denoising
paper.abstract: Photomosaics are large images whose local regions are seen as independent tiles while their overall arrangement forms a coherent scene. Generating them at high resolution, with every tile convincing in its own right, is computationally expensive, since the canvas must hold many detailed tiles at once. We present PhotoQuilt, a training-free framework that generates photomosaics at arbitrary resolution. Diffusion models struggle to satisfy both scales at once, as direct high-resolution generation

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型难以同时满足高分辨率照片马赛克的局部tile细节真实性与全局布局一致性，直接生成计算成本高且易输出平滑图像，分块生成则丢失全局结构。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出训练自由的任意分辨率照片马赛克生成框架，无需修改扩散模型权重即可兼顾全局布局约束与局部tile生成质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出自举式分块去噪流程：先生成低分辨率全局图像确定整体布局，再在潜空间上采样并重新注入噪声恢复生成能力，随后在固定尺寸的tile内分块去噪，通过共享全局潜变量保证各tile的结构一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验配置、模型参数量、对比基线及量化效果，仅说明方法无需额外训练即可支持任意分辨率照片马赛克生成，同时兼顾局部细节与全局结构。
summary.authors_note: 合作机构包括University of Toronto、Vector Institute、Samsung Research、KITE Research Institute、Queen’s University。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing diffusion models struggle to balance local tile detail fidelity and global layout consistency for high-resolution photomosaics; direct generation is computationally expensive and tends to produce smooth images, while patch-based tiling loses global structure.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a training-free framework for arbitrary-resolution photomosaic generation, which balances global layout constraints and local tile quality without modifying diffusion model weights.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a bootstrapped tiled denoising pipeline: first generates a low-resolution global image to fix the layout, then upsamples in latent space and re-injects noise to restore generative capacity, followed by tiled denoising within fixed-size tiles to preserve consistency via shared global latents.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental setup, model parameters, baselines, and quantitative results are not disclosed in the provided abstract; only stated that the method supports arbitrary-resolution photomosaic generation without extra training, balancing local detail and global structure.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaborative team including University of Toronto, Vector Institute, Samsung Research, KITE Research Institute, and Queen’s University.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型分块生成的全局布局锚定思路可参考，用于长序列扩散LM或高分辨率多模态生成，仅看方法流程即可。
recommendation.en: Global layout anchoring for tiled diffusion generation is worth referencing for long-sequence diffusion LM or high-res multimodal generation; only the pipeline section is needed.

paper.title: Accelerated Likelihood Maximization for Diffusion-based Versatile Content Generation
paper.abstract: Generating diverse, coherent, and plausible content from partially given inputs remains a fundamental challenge for diffusion models. Existing approaches face clear limitations: training-based approaches offer strong task-specific results but require costly computation, and they generalize poorly across tasks. Training-free approaches offer better efficiency, but they do not explicitly optimize over unobserved variables, leading to globally inconsistent results. To address these limitations, we

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散模型在部分输入条件下生成完整内容时，全局一致性差和任务适配成本高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是扩散生成采样方法改进。它不改变语言模型预训练范式，但对理解训练-free 条件生成、逆问题采样和扩散模型后验优化有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Accelerated Likelihood Maximization，把似然最大化直接嵌入反向扩散过程；不同于只通过已生成区域或条件约束间接影响缺失区域的方法，ALM 在采样时显式优化未观测变量，并加入加速机制以降低迭代开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集和具体提升幅度；实验应覆盖多种 partially given input 的内容生成任务，并与训练式任务专用方法和训练-free 条件采样方法比较。
summary.authors_note: 论文标注包含 Cohere 背景；作者是否来自 Cohere 及具体团队信息需要以论文正文为准。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets coherent content generation from partially specified inputs with diffusion models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a sampling-side improvement for diffusion generation. It does not change LLM pretraining, but it is useful background for training-free conditional generation and posterior optimization in diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Accelerated Likelihood Maximization inserts likelihood maximization into the reverse diffusion trajectory. Instead of only steering missing regions through pre-generated constraints, it explicitly optimizes unobserved variables during sampling and adds an acceleration scheme to reduce compute.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model scale, datasets, or numerical gains. The evaluation likely compares against task-specific trained methods and training-free conditional diffusion baselines across several partially specified generation tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The listing marks Cohere as a strong institution associated with the paper; exact author affiliations should be checked in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 diffusion posterior sampling 备查；只看方法图和消融，别把它外推到语言建模。
recommendation.en: Useful as a diffusion posterior-sampling reference; read the method diagram and ablations, but do not over-extrapolate it to language modeling.

paper.title: Harnessing Textual Refusal Directions for Multimodal Safety
paper.abstract: To improve safety in Large Language Models (LLMs) we can either perform post-training alignment or exploit refusal directions in the activation space. Both strategies are less feasible in Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) as they require unsafe multimodal data, harder to collect than their unimodal counterpart. In this work, we relax this constraint and investigate whether textual refusal directions, extracted directly from the LLM backbone, generalize across modalities (i.e., image, video). Preliminary f

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型安全对齐依赖难以采集的多模态不安全标注数据，现有文本对齐策略跨模态泛化性差且易触发正常输入的误拒问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次验证LLM激活空间中的文本拒绝方向可跨图像/视频模态泛化，提出无需训练、无需多模态安全数据的轻量对齐方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出模态无关拒绝引导（MARS）方法：先提取LLM骨干的文本拒绝方向，通过激活重居中修正跨模态错位导致的正常输入误拒，再自适应调整引导强度，实现无训练的多模态安全能力注入。
summary.experiments: 覆盖图像、视频模态的安全测试场景，验证层选择、引导强度、跨模态对齐程度对拒绝效果的影响，可在保留正常输入可用性的前提下提升不安全输入的拒绝率。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLM safety alignment relies on hard-to-collect unsafe multimodal annotated data, while existing text alignment strategies generalize poorly across modalities and often trigger false refusals on benign inputs.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first verifies that textual refusal directions in LLM activation space generalize across image/video modalities, and proposes a lightweight training-free alignment scheme requiring no multimodal safety data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Modality-Agnostic Refusal Steering (MARS): extract textual refusal directions from LLM backbone, correct false refusals on benign inputs caused by cross-modal misalignment via activation re-centering, then adaptively scale steering strength to inject multimodal safety without training.
summary_en.experiments: Tests on image and video safety benchmarks, verifies the impact of layer selection, steering strength, and cross-modal alignment quality on refusal performance, improving unsafe input rejection rate while preserving benign input usability.

recommendation.zh: 多模态安全对齐的轻量无训练思路，对基座对齐的低成本 ablation 有参考价值，仅看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: A lightweight training-free MLLM safety alignment approach, useful reference for low-cost foundation model alignment ablations, read method section only.

paper.title: See Only When Needed: Context-Aware Attention Intervention for Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) excel at multimodal tasks but remain prone to object hallucinations. Prior training-free remedies often uniformly strengthen visual signals, which may also amplify irrelevant regions and introduce spurious evidence, harming fluency. We propose Context-aware Attention Intervention (CAI), a training-free inference-time mechanism that enforces a see only when needed principle via two-axis selectivity: where to look and when to intervene. At each decoding step, C

summary.core_problem: 大视觉语言模型（LVLM）易产生对象幻觉，现有训练-free的缓解方法统一增强所有视觉信号，会放大无关区域干扰、引入虚假证据，损害文本生成流畅性。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出训练无关的推理时注意力干预机制，遵循「按需观察」原则，在不微调模型的前提下精准缓解幻觉并保留生成流畅性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出上下文感知注意力干预（CAI），实现双轴选择性干预：1）定位维度：每个解码步从模型浅层特征提取token级视觉相关性，定位与语义对齐的视觉区域；2）时机维度：仅对模型深层中不确定性突增的token，施加熵与深度门控的注意力倾斜，不干预高置信token与无关视觉区域。
summary.experiments: 现有摘要未披露具体实验设置（模型参数量/评测基准/提升幅度），仅声明方法可在多个LVLM基准上取得一致的幻觉缓解效果，且无需依赖对比解码即可生效。

summary_en.core_problem: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are prone to object hallucinations; existing training-free mitigation methods uniformly strengthen all visual signals, amplifying irrelevant region interference, introducing spurious evidence, and harming generation fluency.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a training-agnostic inference-time attention intervention mechanism following the "see only when needed" principle, precisely mitigating hallucinations without fine-tuning while preserving fluency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Context-Aware Attention Intervention (CAI) with two-axis selectivity: 1) Localization: extract token-level visual relevance from early-layer features at each decoding step to locate semantically aligned visual regions; 2) Timing: apply entropy- and depth-gated attention tilting only to tokens with spiking uncertainty in deep layers, leaving high-confidence tokens and irrelevant regions untouched.
summary_en.experiments: The available abstract provides no specific experimental setup (model parameters, benchmarks, gain margins) and only claims consistent hallucination mitigation across multiple LVLM benchmarks, working without contrastive decoding.

recommendation.zh: LVLM幻觉缓解的推理时小技巧，选择性注意力干预的思路可参考，无预训练层面改动，扫读摘要与方法核心设计即可。
recommendation.en: Minor inference-time trick for LVLM hallucination mitigation; selective attention intervention design is referenceable, no pretraining-level changes, skim abstract and core method only.

paper.title: Neural Procedural Memory: Empowering LLM Agents with Implicit Activation Steering
paper.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel as static solvers, transforming them into autonomous agents remains challenging. This transition requires continuous environmental interaction, yet current agents lack the necessary persistent procedural memory. Existing approaches predominantly employ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to inject explicit textual guidelines into model contexts. However, relying solely on symbolic instructions can introduce a text-action disconnect, frequently failing to

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 LLM agent 的程序性记忆表示问题：过去经验中的操作流程和行为习惯，仅用文本说明检索出来时，模型不一定会在推理和动作选择中真正执行。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接关系不强，更接近 agent memory 与 inference-time model editing。但它有一个值得关注的接口问题：程序性知识不一定适合全部压成自然语言上下文，可能更适合通过激活空间中的方向来调制模型行为。这对 post-train 与 pretrain 的边界有启发，尤其是如何把经验、技能、轨迹压缩成可复用的非参数记忆，而不是每次都写成长 prompt 或重新微调。
summary.technical_approach: Neural Procedural Memory 是一个 training-free 框架。它不更新模型参数，也不把记忆全部转成文本放进上下文，而是从历史轨迹中提取 activation steering vectors，并在推理时注入 residual stream。方法分三步。第一步构造对比经验：inter-trajectory contrast 比较成功轨迹和失败轨迹，提取导致成功的行为差异；intra-trajectory contrast 在单个失败轨迹内部比较不同步骤，缓解复杂任务中缺少成功示范的问题。第二步把这些离散轨迹差异映射成连续 steering vector，作为程序性记忆的载体。第三步在新任务推理时检索相关历史任务，动态合成 steering vector，并注入模型中间层，从激活层面影响 reasoning 和 action selection。它与 RAG 的区别是，RAG 给模型读规则，NPM 直接改变模型内部表示；它与微调或 RL 的区别是，不改参数，适合在线积累和快速切换。
summary.experiments: 论文在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld、BabyAI 四个 agent benchmark 上评估。结果显示，隐式 activation steering 可以达到与显式文本记忆基线相近的表现，并且与文本 workflow 组合时有互补收益：文本记忆提供可读的高层步骤，steering vector 更偏向约束执行过程。论文还分析了提取出的向量，声称部分向量对应可解释的行为 primitive，例如更稳定地遵守某类动作顺序或补足中间步骤。提供内容中没有可核验的具体分数和消融数字，因此结论应主要看作方法信号，而不是性能结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。重点看第 3 节 Neural Procedural Memory：contrastive experience 如何构造、steering vector 如何从激活中提取、注入 residual stream 的层位和强度如何选。实验部分重点看三类消融：只用 inter-trajectory、只用 intra-trajectory、两者结合；只用文本记忆、只用 NPM、二者结合；不同注入层和 steering strength 的稳定性。若关注 pretrain/posttrain 接口，可重点看它如何把轨迹经验压缩成非文本控制信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses procedural memory for LLM agents: past experience often contains action routines and execution patterns that are hard to transfer through retrieved textual instructions alone.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core pre-training paper. Its value lies in the interface between model internals, agent memory, and inference-time adaptation. It suggests that some reusable skills may be better represented as activation-space directions than as natural-language prompts. This is relevant to researchers thinking about how post-training experience, trajectories, and skills can be stored and reused without repeatedly expanding context or updating parameters.
summary_en.technical_approach: Neural Procedural Memory is a training-free activation steering framework. Instead of retrieving text for the model to read, it extracts steering vectors from historical agent trajectories and injects them into the residual stream at inference time. The method has three stages. First, it builds contrastive experiences: inter-trajectory contrast compares successful and failed trajectories, while intra-trajectory contrast extracts useful step-level differences from failed attempts when successful demonstrations are scarce. Second, these contrasts are distilled into continuous activation-space vectors that serve as procedural memory. Third, for a new task, relevant memories are retrieved, dynamically composed, and injected into the model to bias reasoning and action selection. Compared with RAG, the intervention acts on internal representations rather than symbolic instructions. Compared with fine-tuning or RL, it avoids parameter updates and is easier to apply online.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on four agent benchmarks: ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and BabyAI. The reported findings are that implicit activation steering performs comparably to explicit textual memory baselines and improves further when combined with textual workflows. The interpretation is that textual memory supplies high-level symbolic guidance, while activation steering improves adherence to procedural patterns during execution. The paper also analyzes the learned vectors and reports behaviorally meaningful primitives. The provided content does not include verifiable numerical scores or detailed ablation values, so the result should be read mainly as evidence for a mechanism rather than as a settled performance claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Read the method section carefully, especially contrastive experience construction, vector extraction, and residual-stream intervention. In the experiments, look for ablations separating inter-trajectory and intra-trajectory signals, comparisons against textual memory, and the combination of both. The layer-wise and steering-strength analyses are important for assessing whether the method is stable or sensitive to intervention details. For pre-training-oriented readers, the most useful part is the compression of trajectories into non-textual control signals.

recommendation.zh: 用激活steering实现Agent程序性记忆的思路新颖，预训练研究员可参考§3.2的对比经验蒸馏与激活向量构造方法。
recommendation.en: The idea of using activation steering for agent procedural memory is novel; pretraining researchers can reference Section 3.2 for contrastive experience distillation and activation vector construction.

paper.title: TOPS: First-Principles Visual Token Pruning via Constructing Token Optimal Preservation Sets for Efficient MLLM Inference
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, but their efficiency is limited by the large number of visual tokens, which introduces substantial computational overhead. Visual token pruning offers a natural solution, yet existing methods are imperfect: attention-based criteria tend to retain redundant tokens, while diversity-based criteria are often agnostic to user instructions. Even methods that combine multiple criteria still lack a principle

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 MLLM 推理中的视觉 token 裁剪问题：如何在大幅减少视觉 token 的同时，尽量保持模型基于完整图像输入时的输出行为。作者认为现有方法多把裁剪做成打分排序问题，常见的 attention-based 方法容易保留相似 token，diversity-based 方法又容易忽略用户问题，缺少一个能解释“为什么这些 token 应该被保留”的目标函数。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，更接近高效推理与多模态 serving。但它对 MLLM 的视觉 token 表示有一定启发：视觉 token 裁剪不能只看局部显著性，也不能只看特征多样性，而要同时考虑 query 条件下的任务相关性、对原始视觉集合的信息覆盖，以及被选 token 之间的冗余控制。这个视角对多模态预训练中的 token budget、视觉 tokenizer 压缩、native multimodal 模型的上下文分配都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: TOPS 把视觉 token 裁剪形式化为构造 Token Optimal Preservation Sets。给定完整视觉 token 集合 V 和文本查询 Q，目标是在固定预算 K 下选择子集 S，使基于 S 和 Q 的输出尽量接近基于 V 和 Q 的输出。作者用互信息目标来展开这个问题：一个好的子集应同时保留关于视觉集合 V 和查询 Q 的信息。由此得到三个准则：Task Relevance，衡量所选 token 与用户问题的相关性；Information Coverage，要求所选 token 能覆盖原始视觉 token 集合中的关键信息；Semantic Diversity，用来避免选择一批语义重复的 token。实现上，TOPS 是训练无关、模型无关的模块，可以插入 MLLM 推理过程中的裁剪点。方法采用两阶段流程：第一阶段先做较粗粒度的视觉冗余去除，第二阶段再进行文本感知的精细筛选，以减少纯视觉多样性方法丢掉任务证据的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 MLLM 和多种视觉问答、图文理解基准。文中明确给出的结果是，在 LLaVA-v1.5-7B 和 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上，TOPS 可以移除接近 90% 的视觉 token，同时分别保留原模型 97.1% 和 99.1% 的性能。作者还比较了不同 reduction ratio 下的方法表现，结论是 TOPS 在激进裁剪时比单纯 attention 或 diversity 策略更稳。关键实验价值在于说明：当 token budget 很低时，只依赖 attention 会保留冗余区域，只依赖 diversity 又可能丢掉 query 所需区域；三类准则结合后，对高压缩率更友好。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Motivation 中从输出散度到互信息目标的推导，以及三条准则如何对应已有方法的缺陷。实验部分重点看不同裁剪率下的性能曲线、LLaVA-v1.5-7B 和 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 的 token 保留比例结果，以及与 attention-based、diversity-based 方法的消融对比。若关注多模态预训练，可重点思考这些准则能否前移到训练阶段，例如用于动态视觉 token 采样、tokenizer 训练或多模态 curriculum。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies visual token pruning for MLLM inference: how to remove a large fraction of image tokens while preserving the model behavior obtained with the full visual input. The authors argue that many existing methods reduce the problem to heuristic scoring. Attention-based criteria often keep redundant tokens, while diversity-based criteria may ignore the user instruction and discard task-critical evidence.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to efficient MLLM inference than to foundation-model pretraining. Its useful signal for pretraining research is the framing of visual tokens as a conditional information budget. A pruning policy should not optimize saliency or diversity alone. It should jointly preserve query-relevant evidence, cover the original visual representation, and avoid semantic redundancy. This is relevant for visual tokenizer design, native multimodal context allocation, and training-time token budgeting.
summary_en.technical_approach: TOPS formulates pruning as the construction of Token Optimal Preservation Sets. Given visual tokens V and a text query Q, the goal is to select a subset S of size K such that the MLLM output with S remains close to the output with the full V. The paper analyzes this objective with mutual information and derives three principles: task relevance, information coverage, and semantic diversity. Task relevance keeps tokens informative for the query. Information coverage keeps the selected subset representative of the original visual token set under the query. Semantic diversity reduces redundancy among selected tokens. The implementation is training-free and model-agnostic. It uses a two-stage pipeline: a first stage removes coarse visual redundancy, and a second stage performs text-aware refinement.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover several MLLMs and multimodal benchmarks. The reported headline numbers are that TOPS removes nearly 90% of visual tokens while retaining 97.1% of the original performance on LLaVA-v1.5-7B and 99.1% on LLaVA-NeXT-7B. The comparisons across reduction ratios suggest that the method is more robust under aggressive pruning than attention-only or diversity-only baselines. The main empirical lesson is that low-budget pruning needs both instruction awareness and coverage control; either criterion alone fails in predictable ways.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the Motivation section, especially the transition from output divergence to the mutual-information view and the derivation of the three pruning principles. In the experiments, look for the performance-versus-token-ratio curves, the LLaVA-v1.5-7B and LLaVA-NeXT-7B results, and the ablations separating relevance, coverage, and diversity. For multimodal pretraining work, the useful question is whether these criteria can be moved from inference-time pruning into training-time visual token sampling or tokenizer learning.

recommendation.zh: 多模态 token 预算会长期卡住 native MLLM；只看方法形式化和精度-剪枝曲线，别被“first-principles”措辞带跑。
recommendation.en: Visual-token budgets will keep limiting native MLLMs; skim the formulation and accuracy-pruning curves, and discount the “first-principles” framing.

paper.title: Towards a Dynamic and Fixed-budget Memory Bank for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Currently, streaming video understanding is still a daunting task for existing \emph{multimodal large language models} (MLLMs). Its difficulties not only lie in handling the ever-increasing video frames, but also in the unpredictability of future video content and input instructions. In this paper, we study this task from the perspective of constructing a dynamic but fixed-budget memory bank, and propose a novel and training-free approach termed \emph{\textbf{CausalMem}}. CausalMem is dedicated

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是流式视频理解中的固定预算记忆问题：视频帧持续增长，但多模态大模型的上下文和显存预算有限，如何在线保留最有信息量的视觉 token。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理侧系统/算法改进，而且是 training-free 方案。对做长上下文、多模态 KV/记忆压缩的人有一点参考，但它不直接触及基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 CausalMem，用一个动态但固定容量的 memory bank 在线更新视频表示。核心做法是估计视觉 token 冗余度，并通过 online semantic basis 建模当前视频流的主语义方向，再决定哪些 token 被保留、替换或压缩。整体不需要额外训练，属于插拔式推理增强模块。
summary.experiments: 方法被接到 LLaVA-OneVision 和 Qwen2.5-VL 上做 streaming video understanding。摘要强调在有限 memory 下提升信息保留和理解效果，但没有给出具体 benchmark、预算设置和提升幅度。从摘要看，更像工程上合理的 memory selection 策略，而不是会改变建模范式的结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles fixed-budget memory management for streaming video understanding, where video frames keep growing but MLLMs have limited context and memory budgets.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time systems/algorithm contribution, specifically a training-free memory mechanism. It may be mildly relevant for people working on long-context multimodal inference, but it does not directly inform foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, CausalMem, maintains a dynamic yet fixed-size memory bank for online video processing. It estimates redundancy among visual tokens and updates memory using an online semantic basis that tracks the principal semantics of the observed stream, deciding what to keep or replace under a fixed budget.
summary_en.experiments: CausalMem is applied to LLaVA-OneVision and Qwen2.5-VL for streaming video understanding. The abstract claims improved information retention and downstream understanding under limited memory, but does not provide concrete benchmarks, budgets, or gains. From the abstract, it looks more like a sensible engineering heuristic than a result that changes modeling assumptions.

recommendation.zh: 典型推理侧 memory 管理，和 pretrain 关系很弱；如果你在做长视频/多模态 serving，只看 memory update 规则，别投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: This is a standard inference-time memory-management paper with weak pretraining relevance; only skim the memory update rule if you care about long-video or multimodal serving.

paper.title: Forget Without Compromise: Nexus Sampling for Streaming KV-Cache Eviction Under Fixed Budgets
paper.abstract: Long-context and agentic LLM workloads push the KV cache past any fixed memory budget, forcing the inference stack to permanently evict tokens at every step of a continuous-inference stream. Existing methods all share the same template, a per-step direct-attention score followed by deterministic top-$K$ selection, which converts a single below-cutoff step into an irreversible verdict and permanently erases any subtly important token that direct attention cannot single out from noise. To address

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是长上下文连续推理中的 KV-cache 淘汰问题：当缓存超过固定显存预算时，系统必须永久丢弃一部分 token，而现有方法多用当前注意力分数做确定性 top-K，容易把一次低分误判成永久不重要。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对长上下文模型的 serving 和 agent 式持续交互有参考价值。它把 KV-cache eviction 明确建模成流式固定预算问题，而不是一次性的稀疏读取问题。这个区分有意义，因为训练阶段看到的是完整上下文，推理阶段的缓存删减会改变模型可访问的信息结构，进而影响长上下文能力的真实落地。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Nexus Sampling，是一个无需训练的 KV-cache 淘汰策略。它有两步。第一步是 Nexus scoring：不只看当前 query 对历史 token 的直接注意力，而是在注意力图上做短步迭代传播，用来提高“桥接 token”的权重。这类 token 单次直接注意力可能不高，但连接了一组相互关联的上下文片段，删掉后会破坏局部信息结构。第二步是 weighted reservoir sampling：用带权蓄水池采样替代确定性 top-K，使 token 的保留概率与权重相关，而不是一次低于阈值就被永久淘汰。论文的核心差异在于把选择机制从 hard cutoff 改成概率式保留，并把打分从局部直接注意力扩展到包含间接连接信息的权重。
summary.experiments: 关键结果集中在固定缓存密度下的长上下文性能。论文报告在 20% cache density 时，Nexus Sampling 在 LongBench 上与 dense attention 的差距约在 1 分以内；在 retrieval-heavy 的长上下文任务上优于基于确定性 top-K 的淘汰基线。内存方面，相比 dense FlashAttention-2，每个序列的 cache memory 可降低到约 1/10。理论分析给出的直觉是：蓄水池采样下 token 的长期存活由多步 inclusion probability 的乘积决定，而确定性 top-K 会在第一次低于 cutoff 时直接归零，因此更容易产生边缘 token 的单调流失。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 对 sparse attention 与 cache eviction 的区分，以及“monotone marginal erosion”的问题定义。方法部分重点看 Nexus scoring 的迭代传播公式和 weighted reservoir selection 的具体实现。Appendix A 的理论对比值得扫一遍，主要看 product-over-steps 与 first-below-cutoff 的差异。实验部分优先看 LongBench、retrieval-heavy tasks、不同 cache density 下的曲线；如果关注部署，还要看它与 FlashAttention-2 dense cache 的显存对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets KV-cache eviction under a fixed memory budget for long-context and continuous inference. Existing methods usually score tokens by current attention and keep the deterministic top-K, which can turn a transiently low score into irreversible deletion.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on inference-time memory management rather than pretraining. It is still relevant for foundation-model researchers because long-context capability is only useful if the serving stack preserves the right information under memory pressure. The paper makes a useful distinction: sparse attention is a read policy over a full cache, while eviction is a streaming decision problem where deletions are permanent.
summary_en.technical_approach: Nexus Sampling combines two mechanisms. Nexus scoring augments direct attention with a short iterative walk over the attention structure, raising the weight of bridge tokens that connect clusters of mutually related context tokens but may not receive high direct attention from any single query. Weighted reservoir sampling then replaces deterministic top-K. Tokens are retained with probability proportional to the Nexus weight, so marginal but repeatedly useful tokens are less likely to be lost after one unlucky step. The main design choice is to fix both the scoring myopia and the hard-cutoff selection rule.
summary_en.experiments: At 20% cache density, the method is reported to stay within roughly one point of dense attention on LongBench. It outperforms top-K eviction baselines on retrieval-heavy long-context tasks. The paper also reports up to a 10x reduction in per-sequence cache memory compared with dense FlashAttention-2. The theoretical analysis frames the difference clearly: reservoir survival depends on a product of per-step inclusion probabilities, while deterministic top-K survival drops to zero once a token falls below the cutoff.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the distinction between sparse attention and irreversible eviction, and for the monotone marginal erosion failure mode. In the method section, focus on the iterative Nexus score and the weighted reservoir selection rule. Appendix A is useful for the survival-probability argument. For practical relevance, look at the LongBench results, retrieval-heavy tasks, cache-density curves, and memory comparisons against dense FlashAttention-2.

recommendation.zh: 概率化KV驱逐思路扎实，80%驱逐率下精度损失<1%，看方法和实验即可，可在推理栈AB测试
recommendation.en: Solid probabilistic KV eviction idea with <1% accuracy loss at 80% eviction, read method and experiments, ready for inference stack AB testing

paper.title: Towards Fast and Effective Long Video Understanding of Multimodal Large Language Models via Adaptive Quasi-Gaussian Sampling
paper.abstract: Long video understanding remains a daunting challenge for \emph{Multimodal Large Language Models} (MLLMs) due to the excessive computation and memory footprint. Thus, \emph{keyframe selection} is often adopted to mitigate this shortcoming, which however still suffers from low flexibility and high noise due to its hard sampling principle. In this paper, we define video frame selection as a problem of \emph{Quasi-Gaussian Sampling}, and propose an adaptive and training-free approach termed \textbf

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频 MLLM 推理中帧数过多导致的计算和显存开销问题，同时避免硬关键帧选择带来的噪声和不灵活。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的推理侧效率方法。它不改变 MLLM 预训练目标，但对长视频多模态系统如何做输入压缩有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AdaQ，将视频帧选择建模为 Quasi-Gaussian Sampling；借鉴 Gaussian 3-sigma 规则，为局部查询使用较小采样区间，为全局查询使用较大采样区间，从而自适应地选择帧。
summary.experiments: 论文将 AdaQ 应用于 4 个 MLLM 和 3 个 embedding model。摘要称相对默认 MLLM 和已有采样方法有明显性能收益，但未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the compute and memory cost of long-video MLLM inference while reducing the rigidity and noise introduced by hard keyframe selection.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference-efficiency method. It does not modify multimodal pretraining, but it is relevant to input compression and video-token budgeting in long-video MLLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaQ formulates frame selection as Quasi-Gaussian Sampling. Inspired by the Gaussian 3-sigma rule, it adapts the sampling interval: narrower for local queries and wider for global queries.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on four MLLMs with three embedding models. The abstract reports clear gains over default MLLM inference and prior sampling baselines, but does not provide exact model sizes, datasets, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；它是输入预算启发，不是多模态预训练信号的改进。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations only; this is an input-budgeting trick, not a change to multimodal pretraining signals.

paper.title: ActiveScope: Actively Seeking and Correcting Perception for MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive vision-language understanding, yet still struggle with fine-grained perception in high-resolution images. While existing training-free methods typically rely on attention-based localization or coarse-to-fine search, they are often misled by distractors and fail to locate multiple targets. Our investigation attributes these failures to Contextual Dominance, where salient distractors overwhelm target attention and cause inaccura

summary.core_problem: 提升 MLLM 在高分辨率图像中的细粒度定位和多目标感知能力，尤其是在显著干扰物存在时避免看错或漏看。
summary.importance: 这是一个训练-free 的 MLLM 感知修正方法，价值在于对高分辨率视觉-语言模型的感知失效做了可解释拆分：Contextual Dominance 和 Semantic Bias。它不是预训练方法，但对理解 MLLM 感知瓶颈有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: ActiveScope 包含主动寻找和纠错两个思路。Semantic Anchor Localization 使用细粒度语义锚点独立定位关键目标，减少全局语义对显著概念的偏置；另一个模块用于根据定位结果修正感知，缓解注意力被干扰物主导和多对象定位不完整的问题。方法不需要重新训练 MLLM，属于推理时感知增强框架。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和数值提升。实验应比较 ActiveScope 与注意力定位、粗到细搜索等 training-free 方法在高分辨率细粒度问答、多目标定位或感知纠错任务上的表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Qingming Huang，长期从事多媒体和视觉理解研究；摘要未提供明确机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve fine-grained localization and multi-object perception of MLLMs on high-resolution images, especially under salient distractors.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-free perception correction method for MLLMs. Its useful part is the failure decomposition into Contextual Dominance and Semantic Bias. It is not a pretraining paper, but it provides a modest diagnostic signal about MLLM perception bottlenecks.
summary_en.technical_approach: ActiveScope uses an active perception-seeking and correction framework. Semantic Anchor Localization introduces fine-grained semantic anchors to localize key targets independently, reducing global semantic bias toward salient concepts. A correction component then mitigates distractor-dominated attention and incomplete localization in multi-object scenes. The method operates at inference time without retraining the MLLM.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report specific models, datasets, or numerical improvements. The experiments likely compare ActiveScope against attention-based localization and coarse-to-fine training-free methods on high-resolution fine-grained perception, multi-object localization, or perception-correction tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Qingming Huang, known for work in multimedia and visual understanding; the abstract does not specify institutional affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 只看失效归因和模块图即可；training-free 修补不改 prior，但能提醒预训练别只堆分辨率。
recommendation.en: Read only the failure analysis and module diagram; the training-free patch does not change priors, but it warns against treating resolution as the whole MLLM perception problem.

paper.title: Spectral Query-Key Product Weight Steering for Training-Free VLM Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often generate fluent but visually unsupported descriptions, especially by mentioning objects absent from the image. We propose QK Product Steering, a data-free, training-free, and zero-inference-cost weight edit for reducing object hallucination. The method directly edits the per-head query-key product, the operator that produces pre-softmax attention logits, by suppressing a small number of dominant singular modes in selected middle layers. The edited product is t

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型(VLM)常生成图像中不存在的物体，产生物体幻觉，现有缓解方法多需要训练或额外推理成本。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出无数据、无训练、零额外推理成本的权重编辑方法缓解VLM物体幻觉，兼容分组查询注意力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出QK Product Steering：在中间层注意力头中抑制QK乘积的少量主导奇异模，通过闭式更新仅修改query权重、固定key权重，实现训练无感的权重编辑；还分解QK乘积为对称/反对称分量区分内容相似与方向注意力模式。
summary.experiments: 在3个基于GQA的VLM上，CHAIR_s指标平均相对降低4.0%，随机模控制组效果可忽略，基本不损失通用生成能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-language models (VLMs) frequently hallucinate objects not present in images; existing mitigation methods usually require training or add inference overhead.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: data-free, training-free, zero-inference-cost weight edit to reduce VLM object hallucination, compatible with grouped-query attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: QK Product Steering suppresses a small number of dominant singular modes of the QK product in selected middle layers; applies closed-form query-only weight update while keeping shared keys fixed; further decomposes QK product into symmetric/antisymmetric components to separate content-similarity and directional attention patterns.
summary_en.experiments: Across 3 GQA-based VLMs, achieves average 4.0% relative CHAIR_s reduction; random-mode controls show negligible effect, with minimal loss of general generation capability.

recommendation.zh: 注意力QK谱分析+闭式权重编辑的思路干净，可迁移到纯LLM的幻觉/事实性修正，看奇异值分解部分即可。
recommendation.en: Clean approach of QK spectral analysis + closed-form weight editing transfers to hallucination / factuality correction in pure LLMs; read the SVD decomposition part only.

paper.title: Focus When Necessary: Adaptive Routing and Collaborative Grounding for Training-Free Visual Grounding
paper.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in cross-modal reasoning, they often struggle to perceive fine-grained details in complex high-resolution images. Recent training-free methods address this through image scaling and localized cropping. However, applying these manipulations indiscriminately introduces computational redundancy for simple queries and can degrade accuracy by truncating essential global context or introducing irrelevant background noise. To this end, we propose Laz

summary.core_problem: 解决现有训练-free多模态视觉grounding方法对所有样本无差别缩放/裁剪导致的计算冗余、全局上下文丢失和精度下降问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出动态自适应的训练-free视觉grounding框架，兼顾简单样本的推理效率和困难样本的精度
summary.technical_approach: 设计自适应路由模块，用单次前向的首token统计量评估预测不确定性，结合共形校准筛选困难样本；对困难样本用协作grounding模块融合跨模态注意力和多尺度裁剪结果
summary.experiments: 在高分辨率图像视觉grounding任务上测试，对比现有训练-free方法，在精度相当的情况下大幅降低计算开销，或在相同开销下提升困难样本召回率
summary.authors_note: 腾讯BAC、清华大学深圳国际研究生院、北京大学、格拉斯哥大学，无特别知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the computational redundancy, global context loss, and accuracy degradation caused by indiscriminate scaling/cropping in existing training-free visual grounding methods
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a dynamic adaptive training-free visual grounding framework that balances efficiency for simple samples and accuracy for hard samples
summary_en.technical_approach: Adaptive routing module evaluates predictive uncertainty via first-token statistics from a single forward pass, uses conformal calibration to select hard samples; collaborative grounding module fuses cross-modal attention and multi-scale crop results for hard samples
summary_en.experiments: Tested on high-resolution image visual grounding tasks; compared to existing training-free methods, achieves comparable accuracy with significantly lower compute cost, or improves hard sample recall under the same compute budget
summary_en.authors_note: Tencent BAC, Tsinghua SIGS, Peking University, University of Glasgow; no well-known researchers identified

recommendation.zh: 多模态推理时的自适应路由策略，仅看§3.1的不确定性估计方法即可，与预训练方法本身无直接关联
recommendation.en: Adaptive routing strategy for multimodal inference; only §3.1 on uncertainty estimation is worth reviewing, with no direct relevance to pretraining methodology

institutions: Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University

paper.title: Bag of Dims: Training-Free Mechanistic Interpretability via Dimension-Level Sign Patterns
paper.abstract: We show that the standard basis of transformer hidden states already provides a training-free, architecture-general feature basis. Individual dimensions encode semantic content via their signs and confidence via their magnitudes, functioning as independent binary registers. We validate this Bag of Dims framework across three model families (Qwen 3.5-4B, Gemma 3-4B, Mistral 7B) through four progressive experiments. Sign patterns alone carry predictive content: replacing all magnitudes with unity

summary.core_problem: Transformer 的隐藏状态维度是否天然具备可解释性，而无需额外的训练（如 SAE）？
summary.importance: 提出了一种免训练的机制可解释性框架 'Bag of Dims'，发现 Transformer 隐藏状态的标准基（standard basis）本身就是一个特征基，维度的符号编码语义，幅度编码置信度，挑战了必须使用 SAE 等方法才能提取可解释特征的普遍认知。
summary.technical_approach: 通过四个渐进实验验证：1) 仅保留符号（将幅度设为 1）仍能保持 72-93% 的 top-5 next-token 准确率；2) 纯 Hamming 评分（无 decoder）可达 80-90% top-4096 准确率；3) 使用单 token 类型缓存，通过每维度的符号一致性发现了 175 个语义类别（平均 AUC 0.80）；4) 训练的探针仅增加 +0.018 AUC 且收敛到轴对齐权重，证实了跨维度协同作用可以忽略不计。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen 3.5-4B, Gemma 3-4B, Mistral 7B 三个模型家族上进行了验证，证明了该现象的架构通用性。
summary.authors_note: 作者独立完成，关注机制可解释性。

summary_en.core_problem: Do the hidden state dimensions of Transformers naturally possess interpretability without the need for additional training (e.g., SAEs)?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free mechanistic interpretability framework 'Bag of Dims', discovering that the standard basis of Transformer hidden states is itself a feature basis, where the sign of a dimension encodes semantics and the magnitude encodes confidence, challenging the common belief that methods like SAEs are necessary to extract interpretable features.
summary_en.technical_approach: Validated through four progressive experiments: 1) Retaining only signs (setting magnitudes to 1) still maintains 72-93% top-5 next-token accuracy; 2) Pure Hamming scoring (without decoder) reaches 80-90% top-4096 accuracy; 3) Using a single-token type cache, discovered 175 semantic categories via per-dimension sign consistency (mean AUC 0.80); 4) A trained probe adds only +0.018 AUC and converges to axis-aligned weights, confirming negligible cross-dimension synergy.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on three model families (Qwen 3.5-4B, Gemma 3-4B, Mistral 7B), proving the architectural generality of this phenomenon.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent author, focusing on mechanistic interpretability.

recommendation.zh: 极其有趣的发现：Transformer 隐藏状态的符号本身就编码了极强的语义信息，挑战了 SAE 的必要性，强烈建议阅读实验部分以评估其在更大模型上的泛化性。
recommendation.en: Extremely interesting finding: the signs of Transformer hidden states inherently encode strong semantic information, challenging the necessity of SAEs. Highly recommended to read the experiments to evaluate its generalizability on larger models.

paper.title: Reroute, Don't Remove: Recoverable Visual Token Routing for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) project images into hundreds to thousands of visual tokens, making decoder inference expensive in both attention computation and KV-cache memory. Existing visual-token reduction methods largely follow a rank-and-remove paradigm: they score visual tokens, keep a compact subset, and permanently discard the rest. We show that this irreversible action is fragile because visual-token importance changes across decoder depth; tokens ranked low at one stage may become relev

summary.core_problem: VLM 中常见的 visual token 剪枝是一次性永久丢弃，而不同解码器层对 token 的重要性判断会变化，导致 grounding 类查询受损。
summary.importance: 提出可恢复的视觉 token 路由范式替代 rank-and-remove，属于轻量、training-free 的推理效率方法。
summary.technical_approach: Reroute 为 training-free 插件：在每个路由阶段，被选中的视觉 token 进入当前 decoder 块，延迟的 token 跳过该阶段并在下一轮路由重新进入候选池，复用已有注意力打分规则和阶段调度，保持与被增强的剪枝方法相同的渐近 FLOPs 与 KV-cache 预算。
summary.experiments: 在多种 VLM + 多种现有 token 剪枝方法上做插件式替换（摘要截断，具体数据集/数值未完整给出），在相同 FLOPs/KV-cache 预算下比永久剪枝更稳，尤其改善 grounding 敏感查询。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing visual-token reduction for VLMs permanently drops tokens, yet token importance shifts across decoder layers, hurting grounding-sensitive queries.
summary_en.importance: Proposes recoverable routing as an alternative to the rank-and-remove pruning paradigm; a training-free inference-efficiency plugin.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reroute is a training-free plug-in: at each routing stage selected visual tokens go through the decoder block while deferred tokens bypass and re-enter the candidate pool at the next stage, reusing existing attention-score ranking and stage-wise schedules, preserving the TFLOPs/KV-cache budget class of the underlying pruner.
summary_en.experiments: Plugged into multiple VLMs on top of existing pruning methods (details truncated); under matched FLOPs/KV-cache budgets it outperforms permanent removal, particularly for grounding-sensitive queries.

recommendation.zh: 对做 VLM 推理/多模态预训练的人有用："延迟而非丢弃"这个视角比剪枝更稳；纯文本 LLM 研究员看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Useful if you work on VLM inference or multimodal pretraining; the "defer instead of drop" framing is cleaner than hard pruning, but text-only pretrain folks can stop at the abstract.

paper.title: Towards Data-free and Training-free Compression for Speech Foundation Models Using Parameter Clustering
paper.abstract: This paper presents a novel data-free and training-free compression approach for speech foundation models using channelwise clustering via k-means. More fine-grained, mixed sparsity pruning by layer-level varying number of parameter clusters is also explored. Experiments conducted on the LibriSpeech dataset suggest that when operating with pruning sparsity of 50% on HuBERT-large, consistent WER reductions of 27.73%/18.61% absolute (34.37%/21.91% relative) over the magnitude-based pruning were ob

summary.core_problem: 解决语音基础模型压缩依赖训练数据与微调流程、现有幅值剪枝效果不佳的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无数据无训练的压缩范式，降低语音大模型部署的资源与时间成本
summary.technical_approach: 原创方法，基于通道维度k-means聚类实现参数剪枝，进一步探索分层可变聚类数的细粒度混合稀疏剪枝策略，全程无需训练数据与参数更新
summary.experiments: 在HuBERT-large（50%稀疏度）、Whisper-large-v3（10%稀疏度）上验证，采用LibriSpeech数据集；对比幅值剪枝，HuBERT微调前test-clean/other子集WER绝对下降27.73%/18.61%，微调后下降0.19%/0.79%，Whisper对应下降2.86%/5.02%，均无显著精度损失

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation that speech foundation model compression relies on training data and fine-tuning, while existing magnitude-based pruning delivers subpar performance
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a data-free, training-free compression paradigm to reduce resource and time costs for deploying large speech models
summary_en.technical_approach: Original method using channel-wise k-means clustering for parameter pruning, with further exploration of fine-grained mixed sparsity pruning via layer-varying cluster counts; no training data or parameter updates required
summary_en.experiments: Validated on HuBERT-large (50% sparsity) and Whisper-large-v3 (10% sparsity) using LibriSpeech; vs magnitude pruning, HuBERT WER drops 27.73%/18.61% absolute on test-clean/other before fine-tuning, 0.19%/0.79% after, Whisper drops 2.86%/5.02% with no significant accuracy loss

recommendation.zh: 语音FM的无训练聚类剪枝思路可迁移到通用LLM做快速压缩验证，仅看方法部分的通道聚类策略即可
recommendation.en: The training-free clustering pruning strategy for speech FMs can be transferred to general LLMs for quick compression validation; only read the channel clustering design in the method section

paper.title: Q-Fold: Query-Aware Focus-Context Spatio-Temporal Folding for Long Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Long-video understanding remains challenging for multimodal large language models, because temporally extended videos often contain thousands of frames and are therefore expensive to process exhaustively. Existing methods usually construct compact visual inputs from long videos under a limited visual budget. However, most of them still follow a frame-centric paradigm and apply similar representations to retained content regardless of its importance. This makes it difficult to preserve both high-

summary.core_problem: 长视频理解中在有限视觉预算下难以同时保留高保真视觉证据和广泛时间覆盖
summary.importance: 多模态推理侧输入构造方法，training-free策略有实际参考价值
summary.technical_approach: Q-Fold将连续时间片段作为建模单元，在query指导下构造异构Focus-Context表示：相关片段保留高保真Focus帧，不相关片段折叠为保持时序的Context表示
summary.experiments: 摘要被截断，实验细节未完整呈现

summary_en.core_problem: Difficulty of preserving both high-fidelity visual evidence and broad temporal coverage in long-video understanding under limited visual budget
summary_en.importance: Inference-side input construction method for multimodal models; training-free strategy has practical value
summary_en.technical_approach: Q-Fold operates on contiguous temporal segments and constructs heterogeneous Focus-Context representations guided by the query: relevant segments as high-fidelity Focus Frames, less relevant segments folded into chronology-preserving Context
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated; full experimental results not available

recommendation.zh: 训练无关的长视频输入构造技巧，对VLM推理有启发但非预训练核心，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Training-free long-video input construction trick, useful for VLM inference but not core to pretraining. Abstract sufficient.

paper.title: ALIGNBEAM : Inference-Time Alignment Transfer via Cross-Vocabulary Logit Mixing
paper.abstract: Domain fine-tuning degrades the safety of large language models: fine-tuned specialists readily comply with harmful prompts framed in domain language. Existing inference-time defenses that mix logits from a safe anchor model require both models to share a vocabulary, which rules them out for the cross-family specialists where safety is most degraded. We present ALIGNBEAM, a training-free method that lifts this restriction by translating anchor logits into the target model's vocabulary token-by-t

summary.core_problem: 现有推理时安全对齐方法要求安全锚模型与目标模型共享词表，无法适配跨模型家族的领域微调模型安全防御。
summary.importance: 提出首个训练无关的跨词表推理时对齐迁移方法，无需修改模型权重即可在部署阶段动态调整安全-效用权衡。
summary.technical_approach: 每步解码时将锚模型输出的logit逐token翻译映射到目标模型词表空间，生成K个候选续写，再用小尺寸LLM评判选择最安全的输出。
summary.experiments: 在跨词表、同词表的多组模型配对场景下测试，对抗基准上的拒答率显著提升，任务精度损失和推理开销控制在实用范围内。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing inference-time safety alignment methods require the anchor safety model and target model to share a vocabulary, making them inapplicable for cross-family domain-tuned models that suffer most from safety degradation.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first training-free cross-vocabulary inference-time alignment transfer method, allowing deployment-time adjustment of the safety-utility tradeoff without weight modifications.
summary_en.technical_approach: At each decoding step, anchor model logits are translated token-by-token into the target model vocabulary to generate K candidate continuations; a small LLM judge selects the safest candidate.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across both cross-vocabulary and same-vocabulary model pairs, substantially improves refusal rate on adversarial benchmarks while keeping task accuracy loss and inference overhead practically acceptable.

recommendation.zh: 跨词表推理时安全对齐的小增量工作，无预训练相关洞见，作为文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental inference-time safety work with no pretraining-relevant insights, only keep for literature reference.

paper.title: Mitigating Manifold Departure: Uncertainty-Aware Subspace Rectification for Trustworthy MLLM Decoding
paper.abstract: MLLMs frequently hallucinate objects inconsistent with visual inputs. This issue is typically attributed to the over-reliance on language priors, which can override the visual context. Recent training-free decoding strategies address this by penalizing language priors. However, these methods overlook the dual nature of language priors, where they can be both helpful and harmful depending on the alignment with visual evidence. In particular, blindly suppressing language priors often disrupts the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MLLM 解码阶段的目标幻觉，但切入点不是再做一轮“更强的对比解码”，而是解释为什么很多 training-free 抑制方法会在减幻觉的同时伤害正常描述。作者把问题表述为：语言先验并不总是有害；当视觉证据充分且与文本先验一致时，先验会帮助模型稳定生成。现有线性抑制方法把先验当成统一噪声做全局减法，容易把隐藏状态从正常解码的高密度语义区域推离，导致描述能力下降。作者把这个几何失效模式命名为 Manifold Departure，并据此设计只在“先验子空间”内做选择性衰减的解码干预。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限，它主要是一个 MLLM 推理期校正方法。但有两个点对预训练研究仍有启发。第一，它把“语言先验过强”从经验现象推进到表示空间几何问题，说明解码干预若不尊重隐藏状态流形，容易破坏模型已经学到的语义结构。第二，它把 hallucination 缓解从 logit 级别的统一减法，改成 hidden-state 级别的子空间选择性控制，这种思路对后续研究预训练阶段的表示解耦、模态冲突诊断、以及是否能在训练中显式塑造‘安全干预方向’有参考价值。整体看，更像一篇有想法的 decoding paper，而不是会直接改变预训练 recipe 的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 MGAP，Manifold-Guided Adaptive Projection。它分三步。第一步，估计语言先验子空间。作者构造 blind hidden states，也就是在缺失或弱化视觉条件时模型产生的隐藏状态，把这些状态视作语言先验较强的样本集合，然后对其做 SVD，提取一个低秩 prior subspace。这个设计的含义是：不去假设先验是一个固定偏置向量，而是承认先验在表示空间里更像一个低维方向簇。

第二步，在每个解码步把当前隐藏状态分解为子空间内分量和正交分量。只有投影到 prior subspace 的那一部分会被干预，正交部分尽量保留。这样做是为了避免传统方法那种对整个表示做平移，连与视觉一致的语义成分也一起削弱。

第三步，自适应衰减。作者不是固定强度地压制 prior component，而是先检测 vision-language conflict，再决定衰减幅度。冲突越强，prior 分量衰减越多；若视觉与语言一致，则尽量少动。这一点对应论文一开始强调的“先验有双重作用”。
